items.html:
What's Changed

  • Fix: Removed tool call deduplication from JSON parser that silently dropped duplicate tool calls, breaking the 1:1 pairing between tool calls and results expected by AI SDK. This caused "Tool result is missing for tool call" errors that would end the agent's turn prematurely. Consolidated three overlapping regex patterns into a single comprehensive pattern to prevent duplicate matches. Thanks to @cleyesode.

  • Fix: Added missing capture group for arguments in the consolidated JSON tool call regex pattern, which caused inline tool calls to have empty arguments instead of actual parsed values.

  • Fix: When the model batched read-only and write tools in a single response (e.g. read_file + string_replace), the auto-executed read tools would recurse into the next conversation turn, abandoning the confirmation-needed write tools. This left orphaned tool_use blocks without matching tool_result entries, triggering intermittent "Tool result is missing for tool call" errors with the Anthropic provider.

  • Dependency updates: @ai-sdk/openai-compatible 2.0.27, undici 7.21.0, @biomejs/biome 2.3.14, @types/vscode 1.109.0, @types/node 25.2.1.

What's Changed

  • Added native Anthropic SDK support via @ai-sdk/anthropic package. The Anthropic Claude provider template now uses sdkProvider: 'anthropic' for direct API integration instead of the OpenAI-compatible wrapper.

  • Fixed Kimi Code provider template to use the native @ai-sdk/anthropic SDK with correct base URL and configuration passthrough.

  • Fix: User message token count now reflects the full assembled content including pasted content and tagged file contents, instead of only counting the placeholder text.

  • Fix: Removed aggressive tool call deduplication that silently dropped duplicate tool call IDs and identical function signatures. This could cause "Tool result is missing for tool call" errors with providers like Anthropic that strictly validate tool call/result pairing.

items.html:
What's Changed

  • Added /explorer command for interactive file browsing with tree view navigation, file preview with syntax highlighting, multi-file selection, search mode, and VS Code integration. Closes #298.

  • Added task management tools (create_task, list_tasks, update_task, delete_task) with /tasks slash command for models to track and manage progress on complex work. Tasks persist in .nanocoder/tasks.json and are automatically cleared on CLI boot and /clear command.

  • Added /settings command for interactive command menu to configure UI theme and shapes without editing config files directly.

  • Added sdkProvider configuration option for native Google Gemini support. This fixes the "missing thought_signature" error with Gemini 3 models by using the @ai-sdk/google package. Closes #302.

  • Added custom headers support in provider configuration. This enables authentication through tunnels like Cloudflare. Thanks to @nicolalamacchia.

  • Added Kimi Code provider template in configuration wizard.

  • Added new themes with updated user input and user message styling for better visual clarity and consistency.

  • Added token count display after messages and completion message to provide visibility into context usage throughout conversations.

  • Refactored git tools for better consistency, improved error handling, standardized parameter handling across all git operations, and enhanced user feedback messages.

  • Added line truncation in write_file and string_replace formatters to prevent excessive output from files with very long lines and neaten user experience on narrow terminals.

  • Fix: /usage command crash when context data is unavailable.

  • Fix: String replace error handling for edge cases.

  • Fix: Multiple security audit issues resolved.

  • Fix: Various styling improvements across components.

  • Fix: Dependency lockfile issues resolved.

If there are any problems, feedback or thoughts please drop an issue or message us through Discord! Thank you for using Nanocoder. 🙌

  • Added automatic tool support error detection and retry mechanism. Models that don't support function calling are now detected and requests automatically retry without tools. Thanks to @ThomasBrugman.

  • Added --version and --help CLI command options for quick reference. Thanks to @Avtrkrb.

  • Added /quit command as an alternative way to exit Nanocoder. Thanks to @Avtrkrb.

  • Added /nanocoder-shape command for selecting branding font styles.

  • Added CLI test harness for non-interactive mode testing. Thanks to @akramcodez.

  • Added comprehensive test suite for tool error detection. Thanks to @ThomasBrugman.

  • Added DisableToolModels documentation to README. Thanks to @ThomasBrugman.

  • Fix: Corrected log directory paths and enabled file logging in production.

items.html:
What's Changed

  • Fixed search_file_contents returning excessive tokens by truncating long matching lines to 300 characters. Previously, searching in files with long lines (minified JS, base64 data, etc.) could return ~100k tokens for just 30 matches.

  • Added validation to read_file to reject minified/binary files (lines >10,000 characters). These files consume excessive tokens without providing useful information to the model. Use metadata_only=true to still check file properties.

  • Fixed web_search result count display showing mismatched values (e.g., "10 / 5 results"). The formatter now correctly uses the same default as the search execution.

  • Improved web_search and fetch_url formatter layouts to match execute_bash style with consistent column alignment and spacing.

items.html:
What's Changed

Happy New Year! We all hope you had a great holidays and are feeling refreshed ready for 2026 🌟

  • Added Catpuccin themes (Latte, Frappe, Macchiato, Mocha) with gradient color support. Thanks to @Avtrkrb.

  • Added VS Code context menu integration - you can now right-click selected code and ask Nanocoder about it directly.

  • Added comprehensive testing achieving 90%+ code coverage across components, hooks, tools, and utilities. Tests now include unit and integration coverage for critical paths.

  • Added automated PR checks workflow with format, type, lint, and test validation. Pull requests now get automatic quality checks. Thanks to @Avtrkrb.

  • Added LSP support for Deno, GraphQL, Docker/Docker Compose, and Markdown language servers with automatic project detection. Thanks to @yashksaini-coder.

  • Added auto-fetch models feature in setup wizard - providers can now automatically fetch available models during configuration. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Added git workflow integration tools including smart commit message generation, PR template creation, branch naming suggestions, and enhanced status reporting. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Added file content caching to reduce tool confirmation delays and improve performance. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Added path boundary validation to file manipulation tools to prevent directory traversal attacks.

  • Added granular debug logging with structured pino logger throughout catch blocks for better error tracking. Thanks to @JimStenstrom and @abhisek1221.

  • Added devcontainer support for streamlined development environments. Thanks to @Avtrkrb.

  • Added stylized title boxes with powerline-style shapes and real-time preview in custom commands. Thanks to @Avtrkrb.

  • Added real-time bash output progress with live updates during command execution.

  • Added inline word-level highlighting to string_replace diff display for clearer change visualization.

  • Improved code exploration tools with better tool calling prompts and descriptions and new list_directories tool. Thanks to @DenizOkcu.

  • Centralized token calculation in tools with consistent usage display in formatters. Thanks to @DenizOkcu.

  • Added AI SDK error types for better tool call error handling. Thanks to @DenizOkcu.

  • Centralized ignored file patterns usage throughout Nanocoder for consistency. Thanks to @DenizOkcu.

  • Refactored App component into focused modules (useAppState, useAppInitialization, useChatHandler, useToolHandler, useModeHandlers) for better maintainability.

  • Refactored message components to unify structure and fix memoization inconsistency. Thanks to @abhisek1221.

  • Refactored handleMessageSubmission into focused handler functions for better code organization. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Refactored health-monitor, log-query, and AISDKClient into smaller focused modules.

  • Renamed multiple files to kebab-case for consistency (AISDKClient.ts → ai-sdk-client.ts, appUtils.ts → app-util.ts, conversationState.ts → conversation-state.ts). Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Replaced sync fs operations with async readFile for better performance. Thanks to @namar0x0309.

  • Improved tool formatter indentation for better readability.

  • Extracted magic numbers to named constants for better code clarity. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Enhanced validateRestorePath to check directory writability. Thanks to @yashksaini-coder.

  • Fix: Resolved "Interrupted by user" error appearing on empty model responses.

  • Fix: Command completion now prioritizes prefix matches over suffix matches for more intuitive autocomplete.

  • Fix: Resolved duplicate React keys issue by using useRef for component key counter. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Fix: Development mode context synchronization prevents autoaccept race conditions. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Fix: Bounded completedActions array to prevent memory growth during long sessions. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Fix: User input cycling now works correctly.

  • Fix: Slash + Tab now shows all available commands instead of subset.

  • Fix: Command injection vulnerabilities in shell commands resolved.

  • Fix: Large paste truncation in slow terminals resolved. Thanks to @Alvaro842DEV.

  • Fix: find_files tool now correctly recognizes all pattern types.

  • Fix: Tool over-fetching in find and search tools reduced for better performance. Thanks to @pulkitgarg04.

  • Fix: Prompt history handling improved with better state management.

  • Fix: Paragraphs now render correctly in user messages.

  • Fix: Added helpful error messages for missing MCP server commands. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Fix: Size limits added to unbounded caches to prevent memory issues.

  • Fix: Resolved several security scanning alerts for string escaping and encoding. Thanks to @Avtrkrb.

  • Fix: Switched to crypto.randomUUID and crypto.randomBytes for secure ID generation. Thanks to @JimStenstrom and @abhisek1221.

  • Fix: Broken pino logging documentation link in README.

  • Fix: Husky pre-commit hook configuration improved. Thanks to @Avtrkrb.

  • Fix: Silent configuration issues resolved. Thanks to @sanjeev55999999.

  • Fix: Added debug logging to empty catch blocks in LSP modules to improve error tracking and debugging. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Fix: Prevented process hang when exiting security disclaimer for better user experience. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Fix: Handled line wrap in read-file metadata test to ensure proper test reliability. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Fix: Use cmd.exe on Windows for command spawning to resolve cross-platform shell issues.

  • Fix: LSP diagnostics tool now properly handles non-existent files.

  • Fix: /clear command UI display restored.

  • Fix: Bun runtime detection added to LoggerProvider. Thanks to @JimStenstrom.

  • Fix: Resolved race conditions in singleton patterns and improved VS Code integration.

  • Fix: LoggerProvider async loading completion issues resolved.

  • Fix: Cleanup timeout leak in LSP client.

  • Fix: Duplicate SIGINT handler issues resolved.

  • Fix: High severity qs vulnerability patched via pnpm override. Thanks to @Pahari47.

  • Fix: Removed line numbers from tagging files and read_file tool as it confused models when pattern matching content changes.

If there are any problems, feedback or thoughts please drop an issue or message us through Discord! Thank you for using Nanocoder. 🙌

items.html:
What's Changed

  • Refactored file editing tools by replacing line-based tools with modern content-based editing for better reliability and context efficiency.

  • Replaced create_file with write_file - a tool for whole-file rewrites, ideal for generated code, config files, complete file replacements and the creation of new files.

  • Optimized system prompt to be more concise and reduce token usage.

  • Fix: Tool call results were incorrectly being passed as user messages, causing hallucinations in model responses. This has caused great gains for models like GLM 4.6 which commonly struggles with context poisoning.

  • Fix: /usage command now correctly displays context usage information.

If there are any problems, feedback or thoughts please drop an issue or message us through Discord! Thank you for using Nanocoder. 🙌

  • Added Mistral AI as a provider template in the configuration wizard.

  • Updated Ollama model contexts.

  • Added --force flag to /init command for regenerating AGENTS.md without prompting.

  • Removed ink-titled-box dependency and replaced it with a custom implementation. Closes issue #136.

  • Fixed security vulnerabilities by addressing pnpm audit reports. Thanks to @spinualexandru.

  • Fixed README table of contents anchors for proper navigation on GitHub forks. Thanks to @Azd325.

  • Refactored GitHub Actions workflows to reduce duplication and improve maintainability.

items.html:
What's Changed

  • Decouple config vs data directories to introduce clear separation between configuration and application data directories. Thanks to @bowmanjd pushing this update.

  • Update checker now attempts to detect how you installed Nanocoder and uses that to update with CLI with. It all also presents, update steps to the user correctly to do manually. Thanks to @fabriziosalmi for doing this.

  • Added Dracula theme.

  • Fix: Command auto-complaete would only work if there was just one command left to auto-complete to. Now whatever the top suggestion is is the one it autocompletes to.

  • Fix: Improved paste detection to create placeholders for any pasted content (removed 80-char minimum), fixed consecutive paste placeholder sizing, paste chunking for VSCode and other terminals.

  • Fix: Creating new lines in VSCode Terminal was broken. This has now been fixed.

If there are any problems, feedback or thoughts please drop an issue or message us through Discord! Thank you for using Nanocoder. 🙌

npm install -g @nanocollective/nanocoder
Usage
nanocoder

items.title: Nanocoder v1.16.3 — nanocoder

items.html:
What's Changed

  • Fix: Update checker used old rendering method so it appeared broken and always checking for an update. This has now been resolved.

  • Fix: Config files now correctly use ~/.config/nanocoder/ (or platform equivalents) instead of ~/.local/share/nanocoder/, restoring proper XDG semantic separation between configuration and data. Thanks to @bowmanjd for patching this.

  • Fix: Many edge-case fixes in the markdown parser for assistant messages. Outputs are far cleaner now.

  • Removed message display limit, you can now see the entire session history. The message queue is very well optimised at this point so we can afford to.

  • Removed read_many_files tool, it's rarely used by models over read_file and provides little benefit.

  • Removed search_files tool as models often found it confusing for finding files and content.

In replacement:

  • Added the find_files tool. The model provides a pattern and the tool returns matching files and directory paths.

  • Added search_file_contents tool. The model provides a pattern and the tool returns matching content and metadata for further use.

  • Revised read_file tool to reveal progressive information about a file. Called on its own, it'll return just file metadata, the model can also choose to pass line number ranges to get specific content.

  • Update main prompt to reflect.

^ All of the above is in effort to better manage context when it comes to models using tools. Some smaller models, like Qwen 3 Coder 30B struggle from intense context rot so these improvements are the first in a set that'll help small models make more accurate and purposeful tool calls.

If there are any problems, feedback or thoughts please drop an issue or message us through Discord! Thank you for using Nanocoder. 🙌

Installation
npm install -g @nanocollective/nanocoder
Usage
nanocoder

These are the release notes for gptme version v0.27.0.

Contributors

Thanks to everyone who contributed to this release:

@0xbrayo, @erikbjare, @jrmi, @Miyou

✨ Summary

This release brings a wealth of exciting improvements and new capabilities to gptme:

🚀 Major Enhancements

  • 🔧 Pre-commit Integration: Automatically run pre-commit hooks when tool use is exhausted, keeping your code clean and consistent!
  • 🍎 macOS Computer Use Tool: Extended our powerful computer use tool to macOS users, allowing the assistant to interact with GUI applications
  • 🧠 Reasoning Models Better Supported:
    • Claude 3.7 Sonnet support
    • DeepSeek R1 support
  • 🔈 Improved TTS: Enhanced Text-to-Speech with Kokoro 1.0, better sentence chunking and device handling

🛠️ Developer Experience

  • 🌳 Context Tree: Added GPTME_CONTEXT_TREE flag to include repository structure in prompts
  • ⚙️ Feature Flags: New environment variables like GPTME_BREAK_ON_TOOLUSE and GPTME_FRESH for advanced users
  • 🔍 Enhanced RAG: Much improved document retrieval with LLM post-processing
  • 📊 Terminal Status: Real-time status updates in terminal title
  • 🔄 Auto-rename: Added script to intelligently rename past conversations

🔧 Under the Hood

  • 🐛 Bug Fixes: Fixed 65+ issues to ensure smooth, reliable operation
  • 📷 Better Image Handling: Improved vision tool with automatic rescaling
  • 📋 Model Switching: Added /model command to list and switch models in conversation
  • 🔄 Patch Recovery: New GPTME_PATCH_RECOVERY option to recover from non-matching patches

We apologize for the delay in this release. For those eager to try the latest features before the next release, we recommend running directly from the master branch:

pipx install git+https://github.com/gptme/gptme.git

These are the release notes for gptme version v0.25.0.

Summary

This release brings major improvements to the user experience with a new prompt_toolkit-based interface (better completion and highlighting), support for OpenAI/Anthropic tools APIs, and significant cost & performance improvements for Anthropic through better prompt caching. The release also includes improved path handling, workspace context, heredoc support, and numerous UX improvements and bug fixes.

macOS install note

The app isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID yet, so macOS may call a downloaded build "damaged" — it's Gatekeeper quarantine, not a bad file. After moving the app to Applications, clear the flag once, then open normally:

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/OpenHands Agent Canvas.app"

Signing + notarization is tracked in OpenHands/OpenHands#16774.

items.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • Added chips above the Web Shell composer for unfinished background workflows, shells, monitors, and local agents, replacing the status-bar task pill. (#16813) by @qqqys
  • Added Chinese localization for GitHub channel event prompts in PR-bound sessions when the channel UI language is Chinese, while other languages remain English. (#16773) by @wenshao
  • Managed MCP now counts only up to 32 live selections, retains removed entries for recovery, keeps the 16-enabled limit, and caps retained snapshots at 96 entries. (#15161) by @yiliang114
  • Added managed-agent SPIs that let embedding applications import exact Skill or extension revisions from external sources and store compiled archives in private storage. (#16882) by @doudouOUC
  • Enables Mods to rewrite displayed reply rows in the OpenTUI terminal via ui.render while preserving stored message text and /copy output. (#16873) by @qqqys
  • Records pull request states from slim listings and passes their keys to the watch so closed pull requests can leave view rotation correctly. (#16847) by @wenshao
  • Adds a sending-only dingtalk-webhook channel that posts notifications and successful task results as Markdown to configured DingTalk custom group robots. (#16802) by @jkxiao
  • Sidebar session lists now expand ten sessions per click, with labels showing remaining count, instead of showing all at once. (#16830) by @wenshao
  • Managed Sessions now store oversized resources and compacted closed journals in object storage, preserving recovery and normal reads. (#16868) by @doudouOUC
  • Adds internal event-bus primitives for the unified agent loop without changing current behavior. (#16935) by @wenshao
  • Adds DingTalk webhook configuration in Web Shell and lets Scheduled Tasks pick saved Channel destinations. (#16804) by @jkxiao
  • Lets embedding hosts add header and per-model content to the composer model picker while preserving native search, selection, and keyboard behavior. (#16933) by @callmeYe
  • Adds opt-in AgentLoopOptions.useEventBus to run the shared agent loop on event-bus handlers without changing observable behavior. (#16938) by @wenshao
  • The sandboxed /verify flow now deepens the checkout to include the PR and base history needed before verification, improving handling of force-pushes and missing commits. (#16781) by @wenshao
  • feat(cli): enable the event-bus agent loop on headless behind an experimental setting (#16994) by @wenshao
  • When experimental.unifiedAgentLoop is enabled, AgentCore model rounds now run through the shared agent loop. (#16880) by @qqqys
  • feat(workflows): allow model-requested background runs in ACP sessions (#16876) by @qqqys
  • feat(core): run AgentCore's tool batches on the shared agent loop (#17035) by @qqqys
  • feat: Manual session PR binding (/pr command + Web Shell dialog) (#16877) by @wenshao
  • Managed agent journal readers now resolve evicted records from journal packs, enabling qwen.managed-agent.session-resources.deletion-enabled. (#17047) by @doudouOUC
  • Managed Sessions now store self-paced /loop wakeups durably in the session journal so they survive restarts and takeovers. (#16835) by @wenshao
Bug Fixes
  • Fixed managed-agent session close to release the MCP owner so MCP configurations are no longer left drained or held after closing. (#16728) by @wenshao
  • Improved managed-agent reliability when parsing Harness conflict error codes, reading host command output, and reporting exception causes. (#16826) by @doudouOUC
  • Web Shell approval picker is now more compact, and Full Access (yolo) is visually marked as a destructive, high-risk mode. (#16874) by @callmeYe
  • CI ephemeral runners can now remain available past their age threshold and finish late-assigned jobs instead of being destroyed prematurely. (#16871) by @yiliang114
  • Web Shell WeChat login startup now uses the daemon's longer QR creation timeout, preventing logins from aborting when QR minting takes up to 30 seconds. (#16838) by @wenshao
  • CLI startup in Docker or Podman sandboxes now creates the sandbox home directory and tolerates a missing $HOME instead of crashing. (#16878) by @yiliang114
  • Web Shell managed model changes are now acknowledged correctly after failed reads, preventing the picker from staying stuck and avoiding duplicate resubmissions. (#16869) by @yiliang114
  • Fixed CI failures by making TUI agent-loop parity approval waits verify approved file effects and restoring checkstyle import order, improving pipeline reliability. (#16881) by @wenshao
  • Fixed CI capture tests on fork PR runners by installing the DejaVu font package so bold and plain terminal renders differ correctly. (#16864) by @qwen-code-dev-bot
  • Allows ephemeral runner managers to drain running jobs before shutdown, reducing interrupted jobs and leftover containers during restarts. (#16892) by @yiliang114
  • Fixes the shell-command explanation and thinking-translation popovers to keep their intended 480px width instead of falling back to a narrower default. (#16916) by @callmeYe
  • Fixes private CSI retirements that stalled after freezing by reading frozen commit bodies with the correct larger size limit. (#16923) by @doudouOUC
  • Allows manual workspace memory forget while automatic memory is disabled, and Direct ACP rejects it when an external tool guard provider is attached. (#16913) by @callmeYe
  • Aligns shell-command approval explanation and permission choices in one responsive footer so the approval card looks consistent on wide and narrow screens. (#16914) by @callmeYe
  • Moves sidebar session sorting next to multi-select in the session action row, keeping sort options and saved preferences unchanged. (#16776) by @deggs7
  • Raises the web-shell production build heap limit to 4096MB to prevent macOS out-of-memory failures during companion releases. (#16902) by @yiliang114
  • GitHub channel now retries stored replies in the background while running after rate-limit refusals, not only at start. (#16839) by @wenshao
  • CLI channel status now counts routes persisted by qwen serve workers, fixing underreported daemon-managed channel conversations. (#16929) by @wenshao

items.summary: Highlights Web Shell can configure WeChat, QQ, and Email channels, including QR login, scan progress, identity display, and logout where supported. (#16736, #16724, #16746) Mods can run one-off $.model.complete calls, rewrite displayed AssistantMessage text…
items.html:
Highlights

  • Web Shell can configure WeChat, QQ, and Email channels, including QR login, scan progress, identity display, and logout where supported. (#16736, #16724, #16746)
  • Mods can run one-off $.model.complete calls, rewrite displayed AssistantMessage text via ui.render, and persist plugin values with $.store. (#16737, #16794, #16791)
  • /btw side questions are replayed for context, and Managed Agent adds private follow-ups with manual or optional automatic session recaps. (#16408, #16758)
  • Pending approvals now appear in the live panel and can trigger a terminal bell or desktop notification when the terminal is unfocused. (#16800, #16809)
  • Web Shell shows turns, output speed, total tokens, and cache hit rate under the composer, with hover details and Token Usage access. (#16815)
  • Users can import a Skill from the original Runtime workspace of a selected Session and install it explicitly without re-uploading it. (#16638)

Breaking Changes

  • fix(deps)!: upgrade dependencies shipped by SDK and Web Shell (#16452) by @yiliang114

Complete Change List

Features
  • Lets users import a Skill from the original Runtime workspace of a selected Session and install it explicitly without re-uploading it. (#16638) by @doudouOUC
  • Makes /btw side questions part of the session and replays the last 20 answered side questions so follow-ups can reference earlier ones. (#16408) by @sorrycc
  • Adds Tool v4 execution measurements to Managed activity diagnostics, showing duration, valid sample counts, and proposed versus applied line changes. (#16498) by @doudouOUC
  • Daemon PR-state watch adds allowed-host discovery from gh configuration and ordered shutdown while remaining turned off. (#16732) by @wenshao
  • With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, OpenTUI model rounds now run through the shared agent loop, improving parity with Ink while keeping its own tool step. (#16743) by @qqqys
  • Mods can now run one-off text completions with $.model.complete(request, {signal}), using the session client without tools, history, or an added system prompt. (#16737) by @qqqys
  • Managed Agent adds private BTW follow-ups and manual or optional automatic session recap, with WebShell panels using persisted results; automatic recap is off by default. (#16758) by @doudouOUC
  • Goal verifier verdicts now show the Last check reason in the session output language while decision values remain accept or reject. (#15806) by @4ekuct25
  • Mods can now use the AssistantMessage render site and ui.render hook to rewrite displayed model reply text in the Ink terminal without changing stored or copied text. (#16794) by @qqqys

items.html:
Highlights

  • Managed-agent sessions can hold multiple child questions at once, answer them in any order, and keep drafts and errors separated per child. (#16484)
  • Web Shell adds a task Q&A heatmap and an Ask for details side task that explains pending Ask User Question options without answering. (#16037, #16458)
  • GitHub channel editor adds Repository Filter allowlists and blocklists, while bound PR delivery and plain comment delivery become more reliable. (#16493, #16502, #16416)
  • Shell tool edits now handle CRLF and Unicode safely in sed substitutions, and cancelled commands report as interrupted while keeping partial output. (#15701, #15836)
  • Managed-agent runtime is faster and less prone to deadlocks, with safer session rename, snapshot publication, storage admission, and lock handling. (#16480, #16478, #16376, #16489, #16447)
  • Upgrade refusals and Advisor startup errors no longer expose embedded credentials, and empty Harness user info is rejected during start and verify. (#16352, #16083)

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • Added FileChanged hooks for local non-managed sessions, reporting add, change, and unlink events for watched files and directories. (#13969) by @samuelhsin
  • CI Failure Patrol now posts visible bilingual notices when it reruns flaky failures or cannot classify them, improving PR feedback. (#16459) by @wenshao
  • feat(cli): align managed agent basic tools with daemon (#16445) by @doudouOUC
  • Moves Web Shell session search into the sidebar top row beside View activity and improves narrow-layout behavior. (#16467) by @wenshao
  • Improves CI triage security by isolating triage agent credentials and routing all triage runs to ECS. (#16468) by @wenshao
  • Managed-agent sessions can now keep multiple child questions pending, answer child questions in any order, and keep drafts and errors separated per child. (#16484) by @doudouOUC
  • With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, Ink TUI turns send the continuation round after tool batches and handle queued input and retries. (#16428) by @qqqys
  • Web Shell composer now offers a task Q&A activity heatmap; clicking a day scrolls the transcript to that day's first Q&A and highlights it. (#16037) by @samuelhsin
  • Adds a Repository Filter to the GitHub channel editor with allowlist and blocklist modes, URL-friendly entries, and skipped-notification timeline rows. (#16493) by @wenshao
  • Adds an Ask for details action to pending Ask User Question panels in Web Shell, opening a side task that explains options without answering. (#16458) by @wenshao
  • Reclaims idle channel sessions in serve so cached channel routes no longer exhaust the maxSessions budget. (#16532) by @wenshao
  • Adds a single-pull-request view by URL for daemon PR-state watch, returning state, mergeability, and head SHA. (#16530) by @wenshao
  • feat(ci): add disposable external PR runners (#16513) by @yiliang114
  • feat(web-shell): show tool arguments and result in expanded cards (#15435) by @BigDaddy1337
Bug Fixes
  • Fixed Managed Agent session rename failures by waiting for an in-flight title delivery to settle instead of returning a 503 error. (#16447) by @yiliang114
  • Fixed release blocking by moving audio capture prebuilds to macOS 15 while still producing Apple Silicon and Intel Mac artifacts. (#16464) by @liuxuely0626
  • Improved Web Shell Skill suggestions by showing the Skill name as the title and the owning Extension on a separate line. (#16451) by @callmeYe
  • Fixes CI failures on older PR checkouts by refreshing OpenTUI host assets after unpacking shared builds. (#16476) by @yiliang114
  • Fixes Web Shell sidebar layout so session search appears to the right of View activity. (#16481) by @wenshao
  • fix(channels): deliver plain conversation comments to PR-bound sessions (#16416) by @wenshao
  • Managed agent storage admission now locks rows through alias keys so concurrent storage requests queue instead of deadlocking. (#16376) by @wenshao
  • Local Managed journal reads now accept a grown journal prefix even when file timestamps do not change, preventing unnecessary read failures. (#16483) by @wenshao
  • The shell tool's sed simulation now handles CRLF files and Unicode characters correctly in substitution patterns, preventing failed edits and corruption. (#15701) by @2SinceJuly
  • CI Maven cache handling now preserves suite results and reports failures clearly when cache setup or write-back fails. (#15274) by @qwen-code-dev-bot
  • After Esc or Ctrl+C, cancelled shell commands are reported as interrupted instead of completed, preserving partial output. (#15836) by @2SinceJuly
  • Managed agent snapshot publication now waits for an in-progress claim, reducing failed publications caused by deadlocks. (#16489) by @wenshao
  • VS Code companion now writes only the selected model name and baseUrl, preserving other settings.model values when configuring providers. (#15829) by @2SinceJuly
  • Web Shell session view now names tool blocks using lifecycle toolName when no other tool name is present, preventing unknown Tool labels. (#16306) by @yiliang114
  • Interactive TUI now prompts for background workflow agent tool approvals by opening background-task details, preventing stalled runs. (#16432) by @yiliang114
  • Non-interactive, ACP, and channel runs now warn when a prompt stacks more than five skills, delivering the notice without disrupting model replies. (#16404) by @yiliang114
  • fix(serve): treat a payload-invalid start reply as a definite refusal (#16460) by @yiliang114
  • Startup errors for unavailable Advisor models now sanitize aux-model selectors, hiding embedded credentials and NUL bytes while keeping routing unchanged. (#16083) by @yiliang114

items.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Skill installation and activation

Skill ZIP uploads, daemon APIs, TypeScript SDK support, bulk activation, and recovery protections make installing and managing Skills more reliable.

  • Adds PUT /skills/activation and setUserSkillsActivation to enable or disable 1-100 user Skills in one request, with saved preferences and propagation status. (#16186)
  • Prepares Skill installation for larger archives by adding disk-based ZIP handling and recovery-backup protection to the installer. (#16421)
  • Adds daemon API routes for installing large Skill ZIPs by upload or host file path and querying installation receipts after failures. (#16422)
  • Adds TypeScript SDK support for installing Skill ZIPs from File, Blob, bytes, or host path, with attempt IDs and receipt lookup. (#16423)
  • WebShell can now upload Skill ZIP archives from the Skills page, show daemon limits, and check uncertain installation results. (#16424)

Web Shell sessions and composer

Web Shell session titles, Add menu polish, draft preservation, batch deletion, and listSessions pagination fixes improve everyday session management.

  • Keeps Web Shell sidebar session titles visible when a transcript is rebuilt, preventing session names from disappearing. (#16299)
  • Polishes the Web Shell composer Add menu with consistent icons, labels, descriptions, spacing, and improved accessibility for actions and Plan state. (#16181)
  • WebShell now preserves unsent drafts when ArrowUp or ArrowDown moves through wrapped prompt lines before history navigation. (#14909)
  • web-shell: batch session deletions at the route limit (#14637)
  • listSessions pagination no longer skips sessions when multiple session files share the same modification time. (#16024)

Managed agents and sessions

Managed agent automation, durable questions, activation renewals, writer recovery, and history caching improve hosted session reliability and speed.

  • managed-agent: support durable structured user questions (#16433)
  • managed-agent: enable automation by default (#16448)
  • Managed agent activation renewals now locate the activation lease more efficiently, reducing renewal lookup overhead. (#16336)
  • Improves managed-agent performance by removing tenant guard locks from native journal snapshot publication. (#16410)
  • Managed Session history rebuilds now cache message bodies per process, reducing repeated reads and improving performance for hosted turns. (#16337)
  • HTTP Managed Session writer recovery now keeps a live in-flight renewal grant instead of unnecessarily re-acquiring the writer. (#16287)

GitHub PR automation

Sandboxed /verify can read PR review threads, /autofix-pr refusals expose machine-readable codes, and GitHub inbound recovery retries failed reads.

  • The sandboxed /verify round can now see PR review threads, including resolved and outdated threads, so reviewer findings are available during verification. (#16300)
  • /autofix-pr helper refusals now include a machine-readable refused code and next step on stderr, making failures easier to handle. (#16238)
  • GitHub inbound recovery now retries after a failed read instead of stopping, so recovered tasks run once the task store becomes readable. (#16402)

Model and provider support

Image input fixes for Llama, LLaVA, Pixtral, Mistral Small, and Qwen VL models plus OCI Generative AI documentation broaden provider coverage.

  • Enables image input for Llama 3.2 Vision, Llama 4, LLaVA, Pixtral, and Mistral Small 3.1 and 3.2 models. (#16311)
  • core: accept images for Qwen VL models under their Ollama names (#16309)
  • providers: document OCI Generative AI under OpenAI-compatible providers (#16345)

Channels and messaging

QQ proactive delivery and richer Channel event timeline recording improve active group messaging, delivery tracking, and scan health visibility.

  • Enables QQ proactive delivery so loop messages, webhook tasks, background responses, and daemon sends can be sent as active group messages. (#15635)
  • Channel event timeline now records private bound-session deliveries, undelivered events, and scan health outcomes. (#16237)

CLI and terminal status

Interactive CLI reports working, blocked, done, or error status via OSC 7501, while experimental.unifiedAgentLoop helps Ink TUI finish tool batches.

  • The interactive CLI now reports working, blocked, done, or error status to terminals using OSC 7501 with app=qwen-code. (#16407)
  • With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, Ink TUI turns await their shared tool batch so tool continuations complete within the turn. (#16385)

Daemon, runtime, and account recovery

Faster SSH registration and MCP startup, reduced tool-execution locking, bounded daemon replay memory, and subscription recovery improve platform stability.

  • SSH registration settlement and Session worktree preparation are less serialized, allowing more concurrent Runtime work and faster workspace preparation. (#16386)
  • Loads MCP client Google auth providers on demand to reduce startup load while keeping configured server behavior unchanged. (#16242)
  • Improves ordinary session tool execution performance by reducing unnecessary locking during admission and dispatch. (#16415)
  • Daemon command and skill replay now limits snapshot memory with an 8 MiB per-session ring, configurable via --event-ring-max-bytes. (#16413)
  • subscription: isolate activation and restore sign-in recovery (#16453)

Other Changes

  • Internal test coverage for renewal recovery and writer seal handling was hardened without changing production behavior. (#14482)
  • Consolidates Web Shell sidebar test scaffolding onto a shared sidebarHarness without changing user-visible behavior. (#16016)

Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • Adds an operator-scoped model.catalogRefresh setting and lets privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled: false stop background catalog refreshes while local metadata remains available. (#16066) by @yiliang114
  • feat(managed-agent): support full model configuration at session creation (#16153) by @doudouOUC
  • When experimental.unifiedAgentLoop is enabled, ACP Goal turns run on the shared agent loop with shared rounds, tool batches, and stop points. (#16131) by @qqqys
  • Adds a Channel events page to Web Shell with a filterable, auto-refreshing timeline of Channel activity, skip reasons, replies, task transitions, and poll results. (#16106) by @wenshao
  • Adds a local /verify-pr Docker recipe that runs untrusted PR code in a container while keeping model credentials on the host through a chat-completion proxy. (#16077) by @wenshao
  • Runs Mods prompt.submit hooks in the Ink terminal before typed prompts are processed, allowing hooks to see composer text with pasted content expanded. (#16180) by @qqqys
  • Adds a managed Web Shell host entry, improves managed empty-state layout, and consolidates session-failure and unconfirmed-submission notices above the composer. (#15928) by @yiliang114
  • Adds Settings → Connections → Allow remote connections to qwen serve, enabling remote access, token use, and client disconnects without restarting. (#15887) by @yiliang114
  • With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, ACP cron and background-notification turns now use the shared agent loop for consistent rounds, tool batching, and stopping. (#16190) by @qqqys
  • Workspace uploads can now proceed concurrently while still rejecting occupied destinations and preserving directory occupancy protections. (#16212) by @doudouOUC
  • GitHub events for bound PRs now go to the associated session as untrusted prompts, and replies stay private unless published. (#16117) by @wenshao
  • Web Shell channel editor can now edit GitHub repository access, mention behavior, and notification polling settings instead of requiring manual settings changes. (#16149) by @wenshao
Bug Fixes
  • Pins the RHEL 10 EPEL bootstrap RPM and makes desktop smoke teardown treat Linux zombie processes as stopped while still reporting live daemon failures. (#16154) by @yiliang114
  • Compacts live ACP tool-result displays for session replay, so large file edit results show a saved-session preview instead of full old and new contents. (#16172) by @wenshao
  • Fixes PR review endpoint routing by selecting the cohort before the model and reports the final bucket, cohort, model, and endpoint hostname. (#16151) by @yiliang114
  • fix(serve): keep record_artifact guidance out of Managed Runtime worker results (#16148) by @wenshao
  • Binds web-shell config synchronization to the current attachment so config writes made by the first prompt are no longer silently discarded. (#16170) by @wenshao
  • Fixes tool-choice failures on Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1, and Mythos 5.1 by avoiding unsupported forced tool selection. (#15558) by @Adkid-Zephyr
  • Fixes Web Shell pasting so a single copied image with an HTTP(S) URL attaches the image, while unavailable file pastes show a warning. (#16179) by @ytahdn
  • Requires explicit folder trust before repository-supplied hooks, permission grants, and project language servers can run, improving safety for untrusted projects. (#16182) by @yiliang114
  • Anthropic-compatible requests now honor the configured transport timeout and dispatcher, preventing premature request aborts when a longer API timeout is set. (#16193) by @yiliang114
  • Remote-access error handling now hides internal error details from callers and fixes several reviewed reliability and security defects. (#16199) by @yiliang114
  • On touch devices, navigation now keeps focus on the chat pane instead of opening the composer keyboard, while desktop focus behavior remains unchanged. (#16198) by @ytahdn
  • The bundled Generated UI MCP server now runs correctly in Node mode when the CLI is launched from an Electron-based IDE companion. (#16064) by @yar3333
  • ACP bridge operations that finish alongside long-lived session or channel events now clean up their results instead of retaining them. (#15347) by @Sumire-no-kai
  • Ordinary workspace execution, member release, and file rewind no longer take the tenant-wide placement lock, reducing cross-workspace blocking. (#16205) by @doudouOUC
  • Embedded-webview bundle guard failures now show a readable assertion naming the forbidden marker instead of crashing on a large diff. (#16210) by @yiliang114
  • Project hooks in .qwen/settings.json now require explicit folder or workspace trust in interactive sessions and show a warning when withheld. (#16196) by @yiliang114
  • OpenRouter IDs with :exacto now keep the base model name, so qwen/qwen3-coder:exacto gets its 262,144-token window instead of 200K. (#16165) by @Shizoqua
  • Shell permission analysis now treats grep -n and grep --line-number as flags, so grep file reads are still checked. (#14383) by @kabishou11
  • Monitor and workflow completion notifications are attributed to the registering turn, letting active-turn results reach the next model request sooner. (#16177) by @yiliang114
  • Makes CI sandbox image builds more reliable on hosts with slow default Debian mirrors by switching to a faster mirror only when speed checks require it. (#16218) by @yiliang114
  • Scopes GitHub, GitLab, and DWS polling cursors to each workspace, preserving existing positions on upgrade while storing channel state with stricter permissions. (#16231) by @wenshao
  • Improves CI apt mirror selection by preferring the VPC intranet mirror and switching when a candidate is fast enough, even if the default mirror seems acceptable. (#16260) by @yiliang114
  • Fixes RHEL 10 desktop smoke tests by running them headless without requiring Xvfb. (#16211) by @yiliang114
Performance
  • Managed Agent resident Runtime Session claim and release no longer wait on the tenant placement lock, improving resident runtime performance without changing success behavior. (#16217) by @doudouOUC
  • Managed Agent turn submission admission and migration preparation avoid the tenant placement lock where safe, reducing wait time without changing request outcomes. (#16223) by @doudouOUC

items.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • Adds a Web Shell sidebar activity view for trusted workspace conversations, showing approval/input/error states, unread completions, running work, and bulk read/archive controls. (#16022) by @deggs7
  • Adds an "Add to Split View" option to eligible sidebar session menus in web shell, making it easier to open sessions side by side. (#15956) by @4ekuct25
  • Adds request success rate, output speed, per-model success indicators, and distinct model colors to the Web Shell token usage panel. (#16108) by @qqqys
  • Web Shell composer shows a dismissible Workflow chip that turns Workflow mode off, warns when tools are unavailable, and summarizes the mode in the + menu. (#16107) by @qqqys
  • Web Shell Token Usage now plots per-request output speed, first-token latency, and failure details by model, making session performance and errors easier to inspect. (#16111) by @qqqys
  • With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, more ACP turns, including channel prompts and Goal-proposal approvals, run on the shared loop. (#15902) by @qqqys
  • Mods can now run prompt.submit hooks in headless runs for -p prompts and stream-json user messages, allowing prompt inspection or rewriting before submission. (#15905) by @qqqys
  • Desktop releases now publish Fedora 44 and RHEL 10 x64 RPM installers alongside existing Linux packages. (#16060) by @yiliang114
  • feat(web-shell): make GitHub channel configuration usable (#16096) by @wenshao
  • feat(verify-pr): inherit --publish consent on same-session re-verification (#16112) by @wenshao
  • feat(ci): let the PR review canary cohort carry its own endpoint (#16130) by @yiliang114
Bug Fixes
  • OAuth refresh lock cleanup now removes the lock only when the current process owns it, preventing exiting processes from deleting active refresh locks. (#15661) by @2SinceJuly
  • MCP tool discovery now skips duplicate tool names but keeps all uniquely named tools, preventing one name collision from hiding an entire server's tools. (#15757) by @2SinceJuly
  • The Web Shell Plugins page now shows a back control when the navigation rail is unavailable, letting users return to chat from compact layouts. (#15651) by @2SinceJuly
  • LSP code-navigation queries now fail with an explicit reason when no language server is ready instead of returning empty results. (#15946) by @404khai
  • The verify report now counts targeted gate test-suite results separately from a round's scripted assertions, making assertion totals reflect only round checks. (#16013) by @wenshao
  • Makes long /btw answers scroll in a bounded panel with mouse wheel, Shift+Up/Down, PageUp/PageDown, and a scrollbar, while short answers remain unchanged. (#15982) by @2SinceJuly
  • Fixes verify-pr to count each suite run as one assertion and handle skip notices on closed PRs so review rounds are not rejected with zero assertions. (#16050) by @wenshao
  • Fixes Kimi K3 generation recognition so supported IDs use the 1,000,000-token context window, while k3-256k keeps its 256K window. (#16048) by @wenshao
  • Fixes review command so plain-language re-review requests target the intended PR and do not misread resume flags or file-like tokens. (#15998) by @wenshao
  • Installs DejaVu fonts in the sandbox so capture cards use the intended monospace font and render legibly. (#16032) by @yiliang114
  • Moves the Workflow mode toggle from the composer toolbar into the composer “+” menu to reduce toolbar clutter while keeping it accessible. (#16047) by @qqqys
  • Improves managed-agent recovery accuracy by blocking gap fills without child ledger evidence and clarifying unknown or never-started states. (#16015) by @wenshao
  • Fixes managed-agent child result delivery status so consumed child results are no longer marked pending. (#16074) by @wenshao
  • Fixes AI attribution notes for loosely spelled git commit --amend commands so they diff against the amended commit, not earlier commits. (#16073) by @yiliang114
  • Makes loop-protection reminder delivery and telemetry settle only when the model request carrying the reminder is accepted, preventing premature clearing or logging. (#15559) by @suzhiguo7
  • fix(core): don't treat fd duplication (2>&1) as a file write in shell permission checks (#15681) by @Suaroman
  • Sanitizes goal approval text and edit-diff file paths in Web Shell by escaping control and bidi characters so displayed approval content cannot carry hidden controls. (#16080) by @yiliang114
  • Shows Managed Session list failures as a localized Retry notice with request details and avoids the empty state until loading succeeds. (#16082) by @yiliang114
  • Fixes invalid Javadoc left after the module split so the managed-agent release profile can build documentation again. (#16099) by @doudouOUC
  • Moves the Web Shell managed session list failure notice below the Sessions / Archived tabs and prevents its request id from being cut off. (#16104) by @yiliang114
  • Fixes qwen-managed-agent-upgrade start and verify so they reach the control plane and Hosted Harness using the server's resolved endpoint configuration. (#16051) by @wenshao
  • Tightens the Web Shell mobile composer layout by aligning workspace controls, truncating long names, and centering the context-usage ring. (#16103) by @ytahdn
  • VS Code companion session history now groups This Week by the current calendar week, so earlier sessions are placed in Older instead of incorrectly appearing under This Week. (#16097) by @yiliang114
  • The bundled review skill now tells fetch-pr to re-run with both --since and --since-model and removes the retired range model, preventing incomplete anchors. (#16094) by @yiliang114
  • The Managed runtime release workflow can now rebuild the missing 0.26.5 runtime from its original tag after repairing the Javadoc issue that blocked the release. (#16114) by @doudouOUC
  • Windows installer updates now stop the bundled runtime before replacing files, reducing update failures when node.exe remains locked. (#16071) by @yiliang114
  • Channel users can now /approve or /deny their own pending one-time tool permission requests in the current attended turn. (#16087) by @BenGuanRan

items.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • Adds bounded SQL history queries for Managed local H2 and Hosted MySQL, enabling paged recent messages, journal transactions, and exact operation or command lookups. (#15839) by @doudouOUC
  • Enables Generated UI by default and lets users continue chatting with interactive card values attached as removable context above the composer. (#15856) by @qqqys
  • feat(web-shell): keyboard shortcuts for Session Overview and Split View (#14179) by @4ekuct25
  • Adds a Russian locale for the Web Shell Goal card and Goals dialog, with English fallback for untranslated strings. (#13685) by @4ekuct25
  • Extends Web Shell one-click daemon updates to pnpm, yarn, bun, and sudo-prefixed npm installs, and shows manual steps when automatic update is unavailable. (#15849) by @wenshao
  • Web Shell and Qwen Code Desktop now show active background agent counts in the status-bar task pill while agents are running. (#14002) by @4ekuct25
  • Managed WebShell now reads the latest 100 live items directly and pages upward for older messages, while live updates continue. (#15865) by @doudouOUC
  • The /verify-pr local flow now reuses the current working tree only when it is a clean checkout of the PR head and records round details. (#15913) by @wenshao
  • Archived conversations in Settings now show Export conversation and Restore inline beside More, making archive management faster. (#15872) by @deggs7
  • PR watch now merges a stale base before attempting fixes when CI failures may be caused by the branch being behind. (#15922) by @wenshao
  • Adds an experimental one-command Helm deployment for Managed Agent with Hosted Harness, MySQL, local execution, and an authenticated gateway. (#15492) by @doudouOUC
  • Adds --in-place mode to the PR-watch skill to co-drive in your checkout, push the branch, and reply on the PR. (#15929) by @wenshao
  • Keeps skill slash-command argument hints visible while typing and shrinks them to missing arguments. (#15930) by @wenshao
  • Makes context memory files in the Context Usage panel clickable to open read-only previews such as AGENTS.md. (#15932) by @wenshao
  • Makes autofix-pr post a pull-request comment when a round is blocked, stating what was attempted, what blocks it, and what human action is needed. (#15978) by @wenshao
  • Adds a retry budget to /autofix-pr so a check left failing after three fix pushes is handed to a human and shown in /autofix-pr status. (#15985) by @wenshao
  • Adds a Workflow switch in Web Shell, split panes, and VS Code chat to update saved session Workflow preferences for the next turn without interrupting responses. (#15779) by @qqqys
  • Enables channel adapters to expose tools to agent sessions and adds QQ moderation tools, including recall, mute, kick, and join approval, controlled by moderationTools. (#14348) by @Eric-GoodBoy-Tech
  • Adds a batch request and SDK method to fetch live-session snapshots for up to 20 selected workspaces in one call. (#12513) by @XIQIXIQIXIQI
  • feat(cli): support exact-version updates without npm discovery (#11486) by @XIQIXIQIXIQI
  • Improves the bundled code-review skill by re-anchoring after head drift, running actionlint checks, accounting for blockers, and refusing retries. (#16001) by @wenshao
Bug Fixes
  • Hardens the managed-agent upgrade command's check, backup, install, start, and verify phases, including cleanup after interrupted installs. (#15853) by @wenshao
  • TUI CI now runs impact-selected checks and reserves full source TUI acceptance for nightly runs, manual dispatch, and high-risk changes. (#15864) by @yiliang114
  • Main pushes now run one macOS E2E shard instead of two, while schedules, manual dispatch, and feat/e2e branches keep the two-shard matrix. (#15873) by @yiliang114
  • The Web Shell floating approval card for tool approvals now uses a single scroll region, avoiding nested scrollbars in long diffs. (#14621) by @4ekuct25
  • Release builds and eligible downstream jobs now use labelled runners on existing ECS hosts to reduce hosted-runner queue delays. (#15832) by @yiliang114
  • CUA input, window selection, and session cleanup align with 0.27.0 across CUA SDK, Browser SDK, and Node REPL for more reliable sessions. (#15784) by @LaZzyMan
  • Review command tests now pin ghApiAllNested pagination and response merging behavior to prevent regressions in GitHub API requests. (#12560) by @indexGin
  • The No-workspace sessions header now matches Pinned, Workspaces, and Recent with consistent height, muted text, spacing, chevron, and hover/focus behavior. (#15897) by @deggs7
  • E2E builds now use the same pool-first runner routing and disk gate as other jobs, reducing hosted queue delays for post-merge test signals. (#15885) by @yiliang114
  • Web Shell browser smoke tests now run on isolated ubuntu-latest runners to avoid shared-runner network failures. (#15886) by @yiliang114
  • Web Shell now hides the No-workspace sessions sidebar section when it loads empty, matching Pinned behavior. (#15916) by @deggs7
  • fix(web-shell): keep "+ Add session" clickable when the catalog is empty (#15835) by @2SinceJuly
  • fix(ci): weight PR owner assignment by open issue load (#15194) by @DragonnZhang
  • fix(cli): separate instruction files from auto memory in context usage (#15863) by @callmeYe
  • fix(core): skip memory imports of files already loaded as context files (#15687) by @tneemo
  • fix(core): retry bodyless 400 responses instead of treating them as fail-fast (#15821) by @Andrea-Bruno
  • fix(cli): share hosted harness deadlines and bail after CI retries (#14752) by @zonemeen
  • fix(web-shell): prune split panes whose session left the active catalog (#14577) by @4ekuct25
  • fix(core): stop the session LSP client on Config shutdown (#14778) by @he-yufeng
  • Session messaging guidance now explains safe-mode suppression or missing peer addresses without implying recipients do not exist. (#13948) by @haomint

items.summary: Highlights Generated UI cards keep inputs and state across navigation and split views, show live views after initial calculation, and appear only for clients that can render MCP Apps. (#15611, #15787, #15720, #15790) Persistent session Workflow mode can be…
items.html:
Highlights

  • Generated UI cards keep inputs and state across navigation and split views, show live views after initial calculation, and appear only for clients that can render MCP Apps. (#15611, #15787, #15720, #15790)
  • Persistent session Workflow mode can be enabled with --workflow-mode on, /workflows mode on, SDK, or ACP, and workflow switches now reach the CLI sandbox. (#15422, #15743)
  • Tool results shrink to remaining headroom before auto-compaction, and qwen-latest-series- or qwen4 aliases are detected with 1M-token context windows. (#13599, #15758, #15762)
  • Valid XML tool calls are recovered when parameters quote other call markup, malformed blocks are isolated, and quoted examples are not dispatched. (#13579)
  • ACP and daemon clients keep rewind identity consistent across retries, cancellations, checkpoints, recordings, and notifications, while SDK frames preserve subagent identity. (#15441, #15657)
  • /autofix-pr start stops when the PR head branch has unpushed commits or uncommitted changes, preventing the watch from overwriting unseen work. (#15736)

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • feat(memory): opt-in extraction cadence after a no-op run (#13571) by @yiliang114
  • Shrinks tool results to remaining headroom before auto-compaction, respecting explicit truncation settings and protected content to reduce unnecessary compaction. (#13599) by @yiliang114
  • Keeps eligible Generated UI cards alive across history navigation, session switching, and split-view changes in the same page, preserving inputs, controls, and runtime state. (#15611) by @qqqys
  • Adds persistent session Workflow mode through --workflow-mode on, /workflows mode on, SDK, and ACP controls, with saved mode shown in Ink and OpenTUI. (#15422) by @qqqys
  • Adds opt-in composerVariant simple to Web Shell, providing a compact input with a limited add menu and shared editor, attachments, and session actions. (#15663) by @samuelhsin
  • /autofix-pr start now stops if the PR head branch has unpushed commits or uncommitted changes, preventing the watch from overwriting unseen work. (#15736) by @wenshao
  • Adds administrator-driven reclamation and reuse of idle resident CSI Workspaces with cleanup verification and atomic release. (#15729) by @doudouOUC
  • OpenTUI terminals now draw the Mods band above the prompt and run Mod ui.render hooks there, matching the Ink terminal experience. (#15699) by @qqqys
  • ACP live frames, persisted replays, SDK normalization, and transcript reduction now preserve subagent identity for thoughts, messages, and tool frames. (#15657) by @yiliang114
  • Archived conversations are now managed in Settings → Archived conversations in Web Shell, keeping archive groups, filters, and lifecycle actions. (#15557) by @deggs7
  • Managed Agent can now be embedded opt-in in a Java host's JVM and Spring context, with dedicated connection pooling or a supplied DataSource. (#15718) by @yiliang114
  • /verify-pr now supports a failures ledger and rejects findings or blocked verdicts unless failures are attributed to the PR. (#15764) by @wenshao
  • Adds the qwen-managed-agent-admin launcher for running managed-agent offline maintenance commands by name, with help and unknown-command handling. (#15772) by @wenshao
  • feat(generated-ui): check a view's initial calculation before display (#15790) by @qqqys
Bug Fixes
  • Recovers valid XML tool calls when parameters quote other call markup, isolates malformed blocks, and prevents quoted examples from being dispatched. (#13579) by @yiliang114
  • Carries rewind identity through ACP/daemon clients so retries, cancellations, checkpoint resolution, recording, and notifications stay consistent. (#15441) by @yiliang114
  • Fixes release publishing checkout failures by using the run-scoped GitHub token for read-only checkout while keeping the bot PAT for write steps. (#15728) by @qwen-code-dev-bot
  • Pins pull request CI retries to the head SHA from the triggering event so reruns test the intended commit. (#15734) by @yiliang114
  • fix(cli): forward workflow switches into the CLI sandbox (#15740) (#15743) by @qwen-code-dev-bot
  • Recognizes invite-only qwen-latest-series- model aliases as 1M-context models in the context-window detector. (#15758) by @wenshao
  • Makes daemon-managed channels honor approvalMode even when no webhooks are configured, matching standalone startup. (#15754) by @qqqys
  • Shows the exception class in managed-agent scan summaries for non-first row failures that have no message. (#15725) by @yiliang114
  • Workspace Skill inventory queries now return a retained snapshot immediately and refresh in the background, while cold reads, deletion, and enablement wait for fresh data. (#14890) by @callmeYe
  • qwen4 model identifiers are now sized with a 1,000,000-token context window by default when no upstream catalog entry defines them. (#15762) by @wenshao
  • Acceptance tests now wait for the focused shell Tab byte to reach the child process before asserting exact input bytes, preventing flaky failures. (#15763) by @yiliang114
  • Managed runtime distribution now publishes verified server artifacts to GitHub Releases and OSS without requiring Maven Central, keeping CLI downloads unchanged. (#15782) by @doudouOUC
  • Generated UI is now offered only to sessions whose client can render MCP Apps, while unsupported clients receive a clear unsupported-client reason. (#15720) by @qqqys
  • In Web Shell, live Generated UI cards now attach and show their interactive view immediately when tool results arrive instead of requiring reopen. (#15787) by @qqqys
  • Desktop release preparation now resets Git metadata on self-hosted runners before checkout to avoid stale-workspace failures. (#15761) by @yiliang114
Documentation
  • Documents managed-agent shared-Session queue behavior and advises giving slow-probed gated definitions their own Session. (#15724) by @yiliang114
Internal Changes

items.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

  • fix(managed-agent)!: simplify Web Shell controls and retire cwd submissions (#15616) by @doudouOUC

Complete Change List

Features
  • feat(managed): add session permission rules and Auto approval (#15448) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(core): add an experimental shared agent loop and run headless on it (#15369) by @qqqys
  • Adds X-DashScope-Source-Config to matching QwenCloud and Qianwen AI Platform requests to identify site and client, without changing authentication or retries. (#15041) by @yiliang114
  • Resumed OpenTUI sessions now retain recorded text, images, tool results, and prompt identities, while rewind restores transcript, request, and draft. (#15384) by @chiga0
  • OpenTUI now captures complete checkpoints at edit approvals and restores them safely, preserving conversation metadata and blocking stale or cancelled owners. (#15389) by @chiga0
  • Adds automation.scanner-threads to run managed automation scanner rows on a dedicated pool and leases rows from claim time. (#15442) by @yiliang114
  • Adds Continue analysis with current parameters so Generated UI users can review and send frozen parameters to the original session. (#15333) by @qqqys
  • Adds an opt-in external-scratch Runtime provider that lets an operator-run HTTP service place Session workers while preserving attestation and recovery. (#15261) by @yiliang114
  • Adds a prompt argument hint for /verify-pr so users can see the PR number and supported flags such as --publish and --watch. (#15463) by @wenshao
  • Adds a durable queue for messages sent during a Managed Turn, allowing queued text and file references to be delivered, edited, withdrawn, or resumed safely. (#15449) by @doudouOUC
  • Adds /autofix-pr status to list all watches in a clone and lets users resume a watch in a later session. (#15510) by @wenshao
  • Adds a Git URL source to the Web Shell Add-workspace dialog so users can clone a repository and open it as a workspace in the browser. (#15361) by @wenshao
  • Enables image and PDF delivery for managed runtime providers with a 768 KiB base64 media limit and a 896 KiB tool-result limit. (#13606) by @water-in-stone

items.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

  • fix(qqbot)!: restore per-group session isolation under thread scope (#13882) by @Eric-GoodBoy-Tech

Complete Change List

Features
  • Adds opt-in daemon token persistence: qwen daemon start --save-token stores the bearer token in an owner-only file, qwen daemon token manages it, and daemon stop removes it. (#15023) by @wenshao
  • Adds idle-only manual context compression for Workspace-bound Managed Sessions via public API and the WebShell context-usage popover, preserving audit history. (#15104) by @doudouOUC
  • Aligns OpenTUI input, editing, drafts, and /statusline behavior with Ink, adding configurable status lines and more predictable completion, queue, and cancel handling. (#14964) by @chiga0
  • feat(shell): remind the model to record files a command writes (#15055) by @zjgzx1988
  • Managed Workspace recovery now waits for durable settlement before continuing, shows recovery reasons and valid actions in WebShell, and gates message sending. (#15131) by @doudouOUC
  • Embedding hosts can now show unavailable models as disabled rows in the composer picker, with hover or focus hints and optional host-provided actions. (#15015) by @callmeYe
  • feat(managed-agent): Add session lifecycle UI and reading exports (#15100) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(generated-ui): expose interaction outcomes and applied parameter snapshots (#15004) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): expose durable capacity observations (#15162) by @yiliang114
  • Pages Managed checkpoint history, adds durable model API error codes, and shows running indicators in Managed sidebar rows for clearer session feedback. (#15170) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(core): gate scheduled tasks on a shell command run outside the model (#15069) by @wenshao
  • Session lists now support case-insensitive title filtering before pagination, with archive filtering and a WebShell title search box. (#15157) by @yiliang114
  • feat(managed-agent): read the Harness credentials from one file (#15063) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): manage MCP servers without recreating sessions (#15119) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(cli): align OpenTUI Vim, history and live output with Ink (#15067) by @chiga0
  • feat(managed-agent): Enable public subagent delegation by default (#15171) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): Start daemon and Managed locally with one command (#14928) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(cli): ship private Bun and preserve interpreter boundaries (#14959) by @chiga0
  • feat(mods): skip hooks for Claude Code events this runtime does not run (#15273) by @qqqys
  • feat(mods): send a Mod's own tool.check ask to the user (#15306) by @qqqys
  • feat(serve): carry a scheduled-task gate through the daemon and Web Shell (#15211) by @wenshao
  • feat(ci): switchable Linux runner fleet (hosted/arm64) via LINUX_RUNNER_FLEET variable + dispatch option (#15329) by @yiliang114
  • feat(serve): bind reviewed PR when a /review prompt is admitted (#15207) by @wenshao
  • feat(cli): add a capability parity matrix against the Managed Agent path (#15085) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): Enable unified Shell session lifecycle (#15330) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed): gate managed automations on a Runtime probe run before the claim (#15218) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): let users reorder sidebar workspaces (#15360) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): Add web_fetch to Workspace Sessions (#15313) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(cli): add the PR watch probes behind the scheduled-task gate (#15057) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): Add a shared Harness pool for Kubernetes (#15255) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(verify-pr): configure the assets host and branch once (#15377) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): expose model output language in settings panel (#15363) by @wenshao
  • feat(serve): give managed workspace sessions todo_write (#15076) (#15089) by @wenshao
  • feat(serve): persist max-sessions in settings.json (#15419) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): add unified recent sessions sidebar (#14904) by @deggs7
  • feat(mods): read session facts and the clock (#15348) by @qqqys
  • feat(verify-pr): add a watch mode backed by the PR probe gate (#15409) by @wenshao
  • feat(memory): add scoped external import jobs for CLI and HTTP (#14281) by @callmeYe
  • feat(ci): fail fast when a pool host drifts off the font baseline (#15410) by @yiliang114
  • feat(cli): attach a terminal to daemon sessions (#15209) by @wenshao
  • feat(cli): add the /autofix-pr reaction layer: guarded push, sync, replies, re-runs and the skill (#15385) by @wenshao
Bug Fixes
  • Release tarball checks now verify execute bits for every spawned vendored binary, including the Landlock runner, preventing silent permission regressions. (#15008) by @yiliang114
  • Fixes an issue where directory changes could make a completed session appear interrupted, while keeping real pending prompts and tool calls recoverable. (#15012) by @ytahdn
  • Fixes CI by enrolling OpenTUI parity integration tests in the no-AK lane so required test selection passes. (#15142) by @yiliang114
  • Fixes a core TypeScript build failure by removing a duplicate import in a chat test, with no product behavior change. (#15146) by @ytahdn
  • Gives fast Java CI jobs priority for SDK Java host-lock tickets while preventing starvation of full-tier jobs. (#15035) by @qwen-code-dev-bot
  • Workflow agent subagent IDs now include the Workflow tool call ID when available, helping Web Shell link subagents to the call that started them. (#15145) by @qqqys
  • Official DeepSeek support now uses deepseek-flash, accepts images for that exact model, and aligns effort mapping with DeepSeek's API. (#15164

Highlights

items.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • Adds optional model-generated layouts to Test Failure Explorer, with validation and fallback to the fixed view (#14269) by @qqqys
  • The Web Shell mobile composer no longer shows the ↑ and ↓ history buttons, reducing clutter while keeping history search available. (#14220) by @pomelo-nwu
  • The Web Shell trajectory panel now includes a collapsible Recent executions section that shows live requests and tools with elapsed time and final durations. (#14071) by @qqqys
  • Managed sessions created from published AgentDefinitions can now load static Skills and pass pinned MCP server and Hook catalog selections to Hosted Runtimes. (#14319) by @doudouOUC
  • Files now offers New file and New folder actions, and folder Delete asks for a second confirmation before permanently removing the folder and its contents. (#14169) by @ytahdn
  • Eligible legacy cancellations now require confirmation through the daemon or WebShell Continue flow before continuing, while explicitly user-cancelled work stays blocked. (#14087) by @yiliang114
  • Hosted parent agents can launch snapshot-isolated child agents that read a frozen workspace copy without changing files, running commands, or affecting the parent. (#14265) by @wenshao
  • Clicking the workspace folder beside the chat title now opens and selects the Files tree in the right panel, with keyboard and focus preserved. (#14344) by @ytahdn
  • Managed sessions now integrate into the home and sidebar, supporting workspace creation, approval policy and model selection, and context usage in the composer. (#14316) by @doudouOUC
  • The Files panel adds a Delete menu for regular files, requiring a permanent-deletion confirmation for the selected trusted local workspace. (#14158) by @ytahdn
  • Adds resident Kubernetes Workspace file sessions that retain an original Pod and fixed CSI PVC so configured Workspaces preserve files across sessions. (#14340) by @doudouOUC
  • Adds Shell Full Access and default/auto-edit/yolo switching for built-in Workspace-bound qwen-code Sessions without losing history, Workspace, or drafts. (#14323) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(mods): support commands in interactive terminals (PR4a) (#14268) by @qqqys
  • feat(providers): add QwenCloud as the first /auth entry (#14073) by @yiliang114
  • feat(ci): route the release lane's hosted stragglers onto ECS runners (#14336) by @yiliang114
  • feat(web-shell): add side task archive controls (#14300) by @yiliang114
  • feat(managed-agent): Add SSH Tool Runtime support (#14318) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(web-shell): list every Managed task kind in the task panel (#14415) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): H4f-c public task cancel for background Shell and Monitor tasks (#14412) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): link a child task to its child Session (#13746 F2) (#14413) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): Improve workspace selection and tool progress (#14405) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): project channel deliveries as tasks and serve their cancel (#13746 F3) (#14414) by @wenshao

  • fix(ci): run three hosted control-plane jobs on the ECS pool (#14469) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): add the opt-in java_durable admission profile (D7-3) (#14470) by @wenshao
  • feat(ci): gate Managed Agent changes on a full SDK Java run before merge (#14397) by @yiliang114
  • feat(serve): attach private CSI Sessions to Hosted text turns (#14081) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): reconcile parked Session title deliveries (D7-2) (#14475) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): register the Managed engine in paired daemons (#14483) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): allow approval changes in stored agent sessions (#14484) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): support Plan mode and inline attachments (#14531) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(workflow): discover trusted ancestor workflows in local sessions (#14369) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): Support per-run automation cancellation (#14526) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): bound half-open Hosted event streams behind a keepalive capability (#14135) (#14512) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): connect the composer to pinned Skills (#14602) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(web-shell): add approval mode allowlist (#14345) by @ytahdn
Bug Fixes
  • Fixes plan approval crashes during journal-only interrupted turns so takeover can settle the session instead of failing terminally (#14160) by @wenshao
  • Fixes checkstyle build failures in the Java SDK by reordering FG8 test imports (#14305) by @wenshao
  • Standardizes Managed Agent timestamps to Unix epoch milliseconds and updates query mappings for consistent data handling (#14185) by @doudouOUC
  • Fixes CSI preparation failures by retaining input, tool declaration, and intent resources through the HTTP store (#14180) by @doudouOUC
  • Managed Hosted model prompts now stay aligned with declared tools, including empty or changed tool sets, so tool guidance and examples remain accurate. (#14306) by @doudouOUC
