Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • feat(managed-agent): H4e-b2 the lead's mailbox over Session messages (#13892) by @wenshao
  • A new private extension imports Vitest 3.2 JSON reports and exposes failures, errors, counts, and diagnostics through MCP tools with search and pagination. (#13854) by @qqqys
  • Opt-in headless Mods now support TypeScript authoring, relative imports, typed non-secret configuration, and dependency validation before startup. (#13890) by @qqqys
  • Adds a default-off option allowing authorized public REST and WebShell sessions to use foreground Shell with mandatory approval. (#13674) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): Introduce the EventTransport seam behind the after-commit publisher (#13909) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): Stop Hosted team members with request_shutdown (H4e-b3a) (#13923) by @wenshao
  • Opt-in headless Mod runtime gains ordered middleware dispatch, command interception, and bounded failure recovery without resetting module state. (#13915) by @qqqys
  • Adds a Test Failure Explorer app that lets users browse, search, page through, and copy analysis requests for up to 20 selected test failures. (#13916) by @qqqys
  • Enables H3 Monitor and background Shell capabilities, allowing background runs to outlive their turn and output artifacts. (#13889) by @wenshao
  • Adds a Java mirror of the managed-event-envelope contract with derivation, validation, deduplication, and fixture tests, without changing runtime behavior. (#13940) by @wenshao
  • Adds a selection menu to completed Web Shell assistant replies with Copy plain text and Copy Markdown actions while preserving selected formatting. (#13833) by @ytahdn
  • Adds Web Shell task reminders for tool approval or AskUserQuestion answers, with notification controls, authorization prompts, and in-panel help. (#13832) by @ytahdn
  • Enables opt-in Mods in trusted headless main sessions to intercept tool calls, rewrite arguments, refuse calls, return synthetic results, and check permissions. (#13950) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): verify tool publications asynchronously (#13654) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(web-shell): add Managed child Agent task panel (#13936) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): recover Hosted G3 parked turns (#13777) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(runtime): add private CSI file worker with local-process isolation (#13899) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): member board tools ride the session_command channel end to end (H4e-b3b) (#13928) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): add read-only Excel artifact previews (#13664) by @ytahdn
  • feat(managed-agent): H4 workflow child runtime (#13858) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): member-to-member messages ride the session_command channel (H4e-b3c) (#13955) by @wenshao

  • feat(web-shell): Reuse standard UI for Managed Agents (#13973) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): add L4 Shell and MCP session lifecycle (#13931) by @doudouOUC

  • feat(web-shell,desktop): update Qwen Code logo to the current brand mark (#14052) by @pomelo-nwu
  • feat(managed-agent): Add the public-event transport and the wake/materialization consumers (MQ2c) (#14080) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): consolidate persistence into a 32-table baseline (#14069) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(web-shell): open context details in the side panel from the ring (#14086) by @pomelo-nwu
  • feat(runtime-broker): add bounded retention for terminal JDBC history (#13642) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(web-shell): review MCP App messages before submission (PR3a) (#13958) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): H4f public task cancel for workflow tasks (#14076) by @wenshao
  • feat(mods): support selected Claude tool input contracts (PR3b) (#14027) by @qqqys
  • feat(sdk-java): add private CSI Session and native SQL authority (#13996) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): publish an experimental reference distribution (#14176) by @yiliang114
  • feat(web-shell): show a reduced header on the new-task page (#14159) by @ytahdn
  • feat(web-shell): upload files by dropping into the file tree (#14145) by @ytahdn
  • feat(web-shell): open workflow agents in the detail panel (#14175) by @qqqys
Bug Fixes
  • Runtime Broker now rejects closed or deleted managed-agent sessions with a non-retryable error, and closed Hosted Harness connectors fail immediately. (#13330) by @wenshao
  • Child worktree runs now settle correctly after merges and stopped runs discard their worktrees, preventing stale workspace state. (#13872) by @wenshao

items.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • Restores the selected text-only connection and validated session or workspace route after Android Activity recreation, while preserving explicit retry screens after failures. (#12247) by @jabrailkhalil
  • Improves mobile profile screen accessibility with clearer connection actions, editor labels, validation announcements, and scrollable storage recovery. (#12129) by @jabrailkhalil
  • Adds an experimental Kubernetes CSI-backed runtime that validates workspaces, persists pod identity, and records durable worker acknowledgements for managed sessions. (#13289) by @doudouOUC
  • Adds background Shell and Monitor capabilities to the Managed Agent runtime, enabling durable background shell sessions and task event reporting. (#13265) by @wenshao
  • Web Shell /btw side can now create independent side-task conversations in a parent session's secondary workspace, including while the parent is responding. (#13468) by @wenshao
  • Agent and Goal coordination tools are now deferred by default and discovered on demand, reducing unnecessary tool declarations in ordinary tool-call sessions. (#13033) by @yiliang114

items.title: ECA 0.171.1
items.summary: Add eca_version to every hook's stdin payload, so hooks and plugins can adapt to the running ECA version. #697 Fix tool calls with invalid JSON arguments ending the turn silently or as a connection error: the LLM now gets the error as the call's result and can…
items.html:
• Add eca_version to every hook's stdin payload, so hooks and plugins can adapt to the running ECA version. #697
  • Fix tool calls with invalid JSON arguments ending the turn silently or as a connection error: the LLM now gets the error as the call's result and can retry.
  • Fix toolCallRejected sending reason user for most rejections, and kebab-case for the rest: it now follows the protocol, with new hookStopped and invalidArguments.

items.title: ECA 0.171.0
items.summary: Send the chat id as _meta.sessionId on MCP tools/call requests, so MCP servers can keep per-chat state. #696 Fix trust toggled while a subagent runs not applying to it, e.g. turning trust off left the subagent auto-accepting tool calls. #504 Improve the task…
items.html:
• Send the chat id as _meta.sessionId on MCP tools/call requests, so MCP servers can keep per-chat state. #696
  • Fix trust toggled while a subagent runs not applying to it, e.g. turning trust off left the subagent auto-accepting tool calls. #504
  • Improve the task tool: plain integer id so servers rejecting type unions (e.g. Apple fm serve) work, and rules no longer make models redo work after a missed start. #693

items.title: ECA 0.170.6
items.summary: Remove the task tool's reminder to re-check the whole request when the last task is done; tasks are already verified on complete. Simplify the code agent's request-checking instructions: no literal reading of loose instructions, no final sweep, no handling of…
items.html:
• Remove the task tool's reminder to re-check the whole request when the last task is done; tasks are already verified on complete.
  • Simplify the code agent's request-checking instructions: no literal reading of loose instructions, no final sweep, no handling of hypothetical edge cases.

items.title: ECA 0.170.5
items.summary: Fix releases since 0.170.2 shipping no binaries: build macOS arm64 on macos-15 as GitHub retired macos-14, and target macOS 14+ for both macOS binaries. #691
items.html: • Fix releases since 0.170.2 shipping no binaries: build macOS arm64 on macos-15 as GitHub retired macos-14, and target macOS 14+ for both macOS binaries. #691

items.title: ECA 0.170.1
items.summary: Serialize concurrent edits to the same file and preserve the latest pre-edit content for rollback. #621 Fix auto-compaction running only once per turn: long (e.g. steered) turns now compact again when the context refills, up to autoCompactMaxPerTurn (default…
items.html:
• Serialize concurrent edits to the same file and preserve the latest pre-edit content for rollback. #621
  • Fix auto-compaction running only once per turn: long (e.g. steered) turns now compact again when the context refills, up to autoCompactMaxPerTurn (default 3).
  • Fix chat/rollback with a null contentId truncating history at the first message without one and reverting later file changes; invalid targets now return an error. #669

items.title: ECA 0.170.0
items.summary: Fix compaction reusing an old summary when the model returns text without calling compact_chat; report failure instead. #629 Preserve hosted web search and image generation in Codex parallel requests without changing Lite routing. #628 Fix auto-approved tool…
items.html:
• Fix compaction reusing an old summary when the model returns text without calling compact_chat; report failure instead. #629
  • Preserve hosted web search and image generation in Codex parallel requests without changing Lite routing. #628
  • Fix auto-approved tool calls waiting on an earlier call's manual approval; they now start right away while approvals are still asked one at a time.
  • Fix calls to the same MCP server running one at a time across all chats; only stdio writes are serialized now.
  • Support MCP progress notifications: each progress report resets the tool-call timeout, and timed-out calls are cancelled on the server.
  • Forward MCP tool progress to clients: toolCallRunning is re-sent with a progress field (progress, total, message), at most once per second per call.

items.title: ECA 0.169.1
items.summary: Add eca-cli as an official client in docs and landing page. Fix landing page hero clipping the editor tabs and demo on tablet and small laptop widths. Enable built-in web search for OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna. Fix no models discovered for…
items.html:
• Add eca-cli as an official client in docs and landing page.
  • Fix landing page hero clipping the editor tabs and demo on tablet and small laptop widths.
  • Enable built-in web search for OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna.
  • Fix no models discovered for providers whose models.dev API URL has placeholders, like Cloudflare Workers AI's account id. #662
  • Fix Anthropic API-key requests failing with "credit balance is too low": send the "You are Claude Code" system block only with OAuth logins. #666
  • Docs: Persistent Documentation sidenav
  • Fix Mistral reasoning models failing after the first answer: send past reasoning back as thinking chunks, not reasoning_content. #674
  • Fix missing chat titles and inline completions with Mistral reasoning models, like Mistral Large 4, which reply with thinking + text chunks.
  • Fix Mistral rejecting a chat that switched from a Gemini model: do not send Gemini thought signatures to Mistral.

items.title: ECA 0.169.0
items.summary: The finished progress of a turn that failed (provider or network error, context overflow…) carries an error with its message and type, so clients can tell it from a successful turn (e.g. a headless run's exit code). A chat renamed with chat/update while its…
items.html:
• The finished progress of a turn that failed (provider or network error, context overflow…) carries an error with its message and type, so clients can tell it from a successful turn (e.g. a headless run's exit code).
  • A chat renamed with chat/update while its title is being generated keeps the new title.
  • Official support for eca-cli as an official client.
  • Docs: Fix landing page hero clipping the editor tabs and demo on tablet and small laptop widths.
  • Docs: Add logo wall and improvements in home page. #676

items.title: ECA 0.168.0
items.summary: Discover global skills from ~/.agents/skills and keep one skill per name, with workspace skills overriding global ones. Fix compaction, auto-continue and subagent LLM calls in long prompts sending a ${cmd:...} provider key resolved at prompt start, failing…
items.html:
• Discover global skills from ~/.agents/skills and keep one skill per name, with workspace skills overriding global ones.
  • Fix compaction, auto-continue and subagent LLM calls in long prompts sending a ${cmd:...} provider key resolved at prompt start, failing with 401 once the token expires. #634
  • Stop re-syncing models, provider catalogs and quotas whenever a ${cmd:...} provider key prints a new token; only setting or clearing a key re-syncs them.
  • Fix Anthropic chats hanging forever when the model stalls mid-response but the API keeps sending pings: pings no longer reset streamIdleTimeoutSeconds, so recovery kicks in.

items.title: ECA 0.167.0
items.summary: Show output tokens per second (TPS) in the chat usage payload for streamed model responses. Fix ChatGPT subscription quota showing an empty secondary window with no value for plans without a 5h limit. General improvements to docs webpage. #663
items.html:
• Show output tokens per second (TPS) in the chat usage payload for streamed model responses.
  • Fix ChatGPT subscription quota showing an empty secondary window with no value for plans without a 5h limit.
  • General improvements to docs webpage. #663

items.title: ECA 0.166.0
items.summary: Fix resuming a chat restoring the default agent instead of the chat's own agent when it was picked before the first message. #657 Fix the "dropped N history entries from a previous provider" note repeating on every prompt after a model swap; it now shows once…
items.html:
• Fix resuming a chat restoring the default agent instead of the chat's own agent when it was picked before the first message. #657
  • Fix the "dropped N history entries from a previous provider" note repeating on every prompt after a model swap; it now shows once per swap. #660
  • Fix install script exiting silently when unzip is missing; report missing tools and download errors clearly, and keep the existing binary on failure. #655
  • Fix context-overflow auto-recovery not triggering for llama.cpp's llama-server, whose "exceeds the available context size" error went unrecognized.
  • Speed up rollback, flags and forks on long chats via the incrementalUpdates capability: chat/truncated, positioned flags, and paged /fork, /btw and chat/fork.
  • grep no longer reports no matches as a failed tool call; backend errors still fail with the backend message.

items.title: ECA 0.165.1
items.summary: Add toolCall.askUser.trustModeTimeoutSeconds: in trust mode, an unanswered ask_user question times out and the LLM continues with its best judgment. Fix OpenAI-compatible chat splitting text around a duplicate thinking block, or dropping a few characters, when…
items.html:
• Add toolCall.askUser.trustModeTimeoutSeconds: in trust mode, an unanswered ask_user question times out and the LLM continues with its best judgment.
  • Fix OpenAI-compatible chat splitting text around a duplicate thinking block, or dropping a few characters, when one stream chunk carries both reasoning and text.

items.title: ECA 0.165.0
items.summary: Fix "Waiting for tool call approval" progress being replaced by "Generating" when another tool call finishes while one still waits for approval. eca-emacs#334 Retry or auto-continue Anthropic streams that fail mid-response with an api_error, overloaded_error…
items.html:
• Fix "Waiting for tool call approval" progress being replaced by "Generating" when another tool call finishes while one still waits for approval. eca-emacs#334
  • Retry or auto-continue Anthropic streams that fail mid-response with an api_error, overloaded_error or timeout_error SSE event, instead of ending the prompt.
  • Refill the maxAutoContinues recovery budget once a response completes and its tools run, so long turns aren't stopped by failures spread across many steps.
  • Show consecutive thinking blocks as a single block in chat, live and on resume, without changing the history sent to providers. #643
  • Show subscription quota (Claude Pro/Max, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot) with reset times instead of costs in chat usage and provider status, plus a /quota command. #641

items.title: ECA 0.164.0
items.summary: Fix "Waiting for tool call approval" progress being replaced by "Generating" when another tool call finishes while one still waits for approval. eca-emacs#334 Scope "approve & remember" approvals to the chat and its subagents instead of all chats, add…
items.html:
• Fix "Waiting for tool call approval" progress being replaced by "Generating" when another tool call finishes while one still waits for approval. eca-emacs#334
  • Scope "approve & remember" approvals to the chat and its subagents instead of all chats, add /approvals and /forget-approvals commands to list and forget them. #639

items.title: ECA 0.163.1
items.summary: Stop the shell_command prompt from asking for a description of the command, as the tool has no such param and calls with it now fail.
items.html: • Stop the shell_command prompt from asking for a description of the command, as the tool has no such param and calls with it now fail.

items.title: ECA 0.163.0
items.summary: Add subagent timeoutSeconds; on timeout or max steps the subagent gets a final no-tools turn to report findings, and a parent stop keeps its partial output. #625 Fix tool-call continuations sending the provider key resolved at prompt start, so a ${cmd:...} key…
items.html:
• Add subagent timeoutSeconds; on timeout or max steps the subagent gets a final no-tools turn to report findings, and a parent stop keeps its partial output. #625
  • Fix tool-call continuations sending the provider key resolved at prompt start, so a ${cmd:...} key that prints a short-lived token no longer expires mid-prompt; continuations read the key from the current config. #634
  • Support multiple accounts of the same provider (e.g. work and personal subscriptions) via provider inherit, like "anthropic-work": {"inherit": "anthropic"}. #617
  • Fix ECA processes overwriting each other's refreshed provider logins in the global cache.

items.title: ECA 0.161.2
items.summary: List the new OpenAI gpt-6-sol/gpt-6-luna models for ChatGPT OAuth accounts by bumping the Codex client version the backend gates on. Fix /agent, /model and remote UI agent changes being reverted by the editor's next prompt; /resume now also restores the chat…
items.html:
• List the new OpenAI gpt-6-sol/gpt-6-luna models for ChatGPT OAuth accounts by bumping the Codex client version the backend gates on.
  • Fix /agent, /model and remote UI agent changes being reverted by the editor's next prompt; /resume now also restores the chat agent. eca-emacs#327
  • Retry transient openai-chat post-tool failures (e.g. 502) before new output without rerunning tools, so sub-agents survive flaky gateways. #620

items.title: ECA 0.161.1
items.summary: Add Claude Opus 5.5 support.
items.html: • Add Claude Opus 5.5 support.

items.title: ECA 0.161.0
items.summary: Pin plugin sources to verified commits, add explicit /plugin-update, and preserve marketplace identity when installing plugins. Retry transient Anthropic post-tool failures before new output without rerunning tools; show recovery counts and explain exhausted…
items.html:
• Pin plugin sources to verified commits, add explicit /plugin-update, and preserve marketplace identity when installing plugins.
  • Retry transient Anthropic post-tool failures before new output without rerunning tools; show recovery counts and explain exhausted or disabled recovery.
  • Expand @file references in custom-command and parameterized-skill arguments into file content before sending the prompt. #163
  • Fix steered native commands (e.g. /sync-system-prompt) being sent to the LLM as text while the chat runs: run them at the next turn boundary or refuse chat-changing ones. #610
  • Return globalConfigPath in the initialize response so clients open the config file the server actually reads.

items.title: ECA 0.160.3
items.summary: Fix built-in GPT-5.x/GPT-6 variants on openai-chat providers (e.g. LiteLLM/Azure gateways) sending the Responses reasoning object (Unknown parameter: 'reasoning'); they now send reasoning_effort. #609
items.html: • Fix built-in GPT-5.x/GPT-6 variants on openai-chat providers (e.g. LiteLLM/Azure gateways) sending the Responses reasoning object (Unknown parameter: 'reasoning'); they now send reasoning_effort. #609

items.title: ECA 0.160.2
items.summary: Retry one transient GitHub Copilot token-renewal gateway/service failure. #551 Build native binaries with GraalVM for JDK 25: fixes the idle server burning one CPU core per HTTPS connection closed by a gateway mid-stream. #608
items.html:
• Retry one transient GitHub Copilot token-renewal gateway/service failure. #551
  • Build native binaries with GraalVM for JDK 25: fixes the idle server burning one CPU core per HTTPS connection closed by a gateway mid-stream. #608

items.title: ECA 0.160.1
items.summary: Fix answering pending questions from the remote UI without SSE subscribers; the first editor or HTTP answer wins. Fix GitHub Copilot gpt-5.6-*/gpt-6-* models sent to Chat Completions (unsupported_api_for_model) when the /models catalog is unavailable: gpt >=…
items.html:
• Fix answering pending questions from the remote UI without SSE subscribers; the first editor or HTTP answer wins.
  • Fix GitHub Copilot gpt-5.6-*/gpt-6-* models sent to Chat Completions (unsupported_api_for_model) when the /models catalog is unavailable: gpt >= 5.3 route to Responses by name.
  • Keep the catalog API and reasoning variants of hidden GitHub Copilot models (e.g. disabled policy) that are listed explicitly under the provider models config.

items.title: ECA 0.160.0
items.summary: Fix context usage counting only output tokens on anthropic-compatible providers that report input usage in message_delta (e.g. Z.AI). #604 Accept unescaped square brackets, non-ASCII and other reserved chars in workspace file URI paths. #594 #605 Fix inflated…
items.html:
• Fix context usage counting only output tokens on anthropic-compatible providers that report input usage in message_delta (e.g. Z.AI). #604
  • Accept unescaped square brackets, non-ASCII and other reserved chars in workspace file URI paths. #594 #605
  • Fix inflated costs for OpenAI-compatible providers (e.g. Synthetic); count usage once per request before completion and retain received usage on stream errors.
  • Tool prompts: push, git config, shell search/read and sub-agents run on explicit request; rule headings are tool-scoped.
  • Recover Anthropic streaming responses interrupted by transient TLS bad_record_mac failures.
  • BREAKING: plugins.install now appends across config layers. Set plugins.installMode to replace beside the list to exclude inherited plugins as before.
  • Add mcpToolSearch config to keep MCP tool schemas out of context until the LLM loads them with the new eca__search_tools tool.
  • Fix /compact steered while the chat is running: compact with its instructions at the next turn boundary and resume the task, instead of sending it to the LLM as text. #600
  • Hide GitHub Copilot models the account can't use (model_picker_enabled: false or a disabled policy) instead of listing the whole catalog, and don't fall back to models.dev when none is usable. #601
  • Pick the GitHub Copilot default model from the account's catalog (versatile, then powerful, then lightweight category) instead of hardcoding gpt-5.5, which some plans don't include.
  • Fix remote MCP servers whose SSE events omit the space after event: (e.g. Z.AI) hanging on initialize; bump plumcp to 0.2.3. #586

items.title: ECA 0.159.0
items.summary: Fix spawn_agent details to include the agent's configured variant; it was only sent when the LLM passed the variant argument explicitly. Add gpt-6-astra support: built-in variants low, medium, high, xhigh, max (no none), Codex Lite/context fallbacks, web…
items.html:
• Fix spawn_agent details to include the agent's configured variant; it was only sent when the LLM passed the variant argument explicitly.
  • Add gpt-6-astra support: built-in variants low, medium, high, xhigh, max (no none), Codex Lite/context fallbacks, web search and image generation.
  • Fix directory_tree hiding gitignored files but not their directories (e.g. .git, target); listing an ignored dir directly now shows its contents.
  • Honor no_proxy/NO_PROXY when routing HTTP and HTTPS requests through environment-configured proxies. #583
  • Stop retrying provider 429 errors that report exhausted usage or billing quota. #405
  • Add /agent to switch a chat's primary agent without resetting its established model or variant. #428
  • Add autoCompactTokensLeft to auto-compact when a fixed number of context tokens remain instead of a percentage. #582
  • Add view_image tool so the agent can load png/jpg/gif/webp files from disk into context as images for models with image input.

items.title: ECA 0.158.1
items.summary: Echo user prompt and show a "Loading config" progress before resolving config, so slow ${cmd:...} keys no longer delay the chat UI. Fix config cache thrashing on unrelated db changes, which re-ran ${cmd:...} commands on every request and poll; cache successful…
items.html:
• Echo user prompt and show a "Loading config" progress before resolving config, so slow ${cmd:...} keys no longer delay the chat UI.
  • Fix config cache thrashing on unrelated db changes, which re-ran ${cmd:...} commands on every request and poll; cache successful ${cmd:...} results for 5 minutes.

items.title: ECA 0.158.0
items.summary: Build fallback variants from /v1/models advertised reasoning efforts (OpenRouter, Synthetic) when no built-in or user variants exist. Add /chats command listing chats from all workspaces grouped by workspace path, with optional title filter. Workspace roots…
items.html:
• Build fallback variants from /v1/models advertised reasoning efforts (OpenRouter, Synthetic) when no built-in or user variants exist.
  • Add /chats command listing chats from all workspaces grouped by workspace path, with optional title filter. Workspace roots are persisted in the chats index or hash-recovered.
  • Add Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 support.

items.title: ECA 0.157.3
items.summary: Add built-in effort variants for Claude models on openai-chat providers like OpenRouter, using the verbosity param which maps to Anthropic's output_config.effort.
items.html: • Add built-in effort variants for Claude models on openai-chat providers like OpenRouter, using the verbosity param which maps to Anthropic's output_config.effort.

items.summary: Set ECA_AGENT=1 and ECA_CHAT_ID env vars on commands spawned by shell, git, custom tools and hooks so external tooling can detect ECA-spawned commands.
items.html: • Set ECA_AGENT=1 and ECA_CHAT_ID env vars on commands spawned by shell, git, custom tools and hooks so external tooling can detect ECA-spawned commands.

items.summary: Improve subagent failure result: rate-limit reset time, parsed Anthropic error code, and retry guidance so the parent agent can re-spawn or switch model.
items.html: • Improve subagent failure result: rate-limit reset time, parsed Anthropic error code, and retry guidance so the parent agent can re-spawn or switch model.

items.title: ECA 0.157.0
items.summary: Add chat/inlinePrompt protocol method: inline editor prompts backed by regular chats, optionally forking an existing chat without replay. New chatInline config for model/agent/variant defaults. Return the new chatId in the chat/fork response and tag inline…
items.html:
• Add chat/inlinePrompt protocol method: inline editor prompts backed by regular chats, optionally forking an existing chat without replay. New chatInline config for model/agent/variant defaults.
  • Return the new chatId in the chat/fork response and tag inline chats with kind in chat/list.

items.title: ECA 0.156.0
items.summary: Add /btw command to ask a side question in a forked chat, keeping the current chat history clean. Runs immediately even while the chat is running (steered /btw is not queued). Add /delete-chat command to permanently delete the current chat or a chat-id from…
items.html:
• Add /btw command to ask a side question in a forked chat, keeping the current chat history clean. Runs immediately even while the chat is running (steered /btw is not queued).
  • Add /delete-chat command to permanently delete the current chat or a chat-id from the /resume list, asking confirmation first.

items.title: ECA 0.155.2
items.summary: Discover model context limit from llama.cpp/llama-swap /models meta.n_ctx/n_ctx_train, enabling usage limit and auto-compaction for local providers. #577 Restore parallel function-call batching for ChatGPT OAuth models that advertise Responses Lite and…
items.html:
• Discover model context limit from llama.cpp/llama-swap /models meta.n_ctx/n_ctx_train, enabling usage limit and auto-compaction for local providers. #577
  • Restore parallel function-call batching for ChatGPT OAuth models that advertise Responses Lite and parallel tool-call support. #572
  • Increase chatRetentionDays from 14 -> 30.

items.title: ECA 0.155.1
items.summary: Fix Anthropic streaming dropping tool calls when providers report end_turn/stop stop_reason with pending tool_use blocks. #576
items.html: • Fix Anthropic streaming dropping tool calls when providers report end_turn/stop stop_reason with pending tool_use blocks. #576

items.title: ECA 0.155.0
items.summary: Add editor_definition and editor_references tools backed by the editor's language server, behind new client capabilities and toolCall.editorNav.enabled config. #351
items.html: • Add editor_definition and editor_references tools backed by the editor's language server, behind new client capabilities and toolCall.editorNav.enabled config. #351

items.title: ECA 0.154.2
items.summary: Retry LLM requests on network failures (VPN/wifi drops: DNS, refused or timed-out connects) with "Network issues" progress, instead of failing or hanging. Add connectTimeoutSeconds config (default 15) so requests fail fast instead of hanging when the network…
items.html:
• Retry LLM requests on network failures (VPN/wifi drops: DNS, refused or timed-out connects) with "Network issues" progress, instead of failing or hanging.
  • Add connectTimeoutSeconds config (default 15) so requests fail fast instead of hanging when the network black-holes connections.

items.title: ECA 0.154.1
items.summary: Skip redundant MCP tool/serverUpdated notification after prompts/resources listing when the server has none. Chat retention (chatRetentionDays) now considers when the chat was last updated instead of when it was created, keeping old but still active chats.
items.html:
• Skip redundant MCP tool/serverUpdated notification after prompts/resources listing when the server has none.
  • Chat retention (chatRetentionDays) now considers when the chat was last updated instead of when it was created, keeping old but still active chats.

items.title: ECA 0.154.0
items.summary: Improve /login UX: markdown links, provider/method selection via chat/askQuestion when supported by client, GitHub Copilot login completes automatically, secrets not echoed. Mark MCP servers as running right after tools listing, fetching prompts/resources…
items.html:
• Improve /login UX: markdown links, provider/method selection via chat/askQuestion when supported by client, GitHub Copilot login completes automatically, secrets not echoed.
  • Mark MCP servers as running right after tools listing, fetching prompts/resources afterwards so slow/unresponsive list requests don't delay server startup.
  • Ask user consent and enable the GitHub Copilot per-model policy when a request fails with model_not_supported, instead of surfacing the raw 400 error.

items.title: ECA 0.153.1
items.summary: Apply mcpTimeoutSeconds to MCP tools/prompts/resources listing, avoiding servers stuck in starting state when a list request never gets a response.
items.html: • Apply mcpTimeoutSeconds to MCP tools/prompts/resources listing, avoiding servers stuck in starting state when a list request never gets a response.

items.title: ECA 0.153.0
items.summary: Store chats in per-chat cache files with a lazy-loaded index instead of one whole-workspace blob, fixing CPU spikes and slow startup as history grows; legacy caches migrate automatically. #557 Hooks db_cache_path now points at the workspace cache dir instead…
items.html:
• Store chats in per-chat cache files with a lazy-loaded index instead of one whole-workspace blob, fixing CPU spikes and slow startup as history grows; legacy caches migrate automatically. #557

  • Hooks db_cache_path now points at the workspace cache dir instead of db.transit.json; read-chat --db-cache-path accepts the dir or a legacy file. #557

  • Keep compact_chat in the tool schema across normal and compact requests, preserving prompt-cache prefixes while rejecting calls outside active compaction.

  • Provide token metrics for ollama provider. #567.

items.title: ECA 0.152.0
items.summary: Share chat history across git worktrees of the same repo, and merge workspace cache writes from concurrent servers instead of overwriting. #558 Cache models.dev catalog on disk and fall back to it when the fetch fails, avoiding model capabilities silently…
items.html:
• Share chat history across git worktrees of the same repo, and merge workspace cache writes from concurrent servers instead of overwriting. #558
  • Cache models.dev catalog on disk and fall back to it when the fetch fails, avoiding model capabilities silently degrading (e.g. no image input) on transient network failures.
  • Fix ChatGPT OAuth routing and Responses Lite payloads for GPT-5.6 models. #563
  • Retry overloaded OpenAI post-tool requests without rerunning completed tools. #563

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI v1.0.111
items.summary: 2026-11-13 Add regular expression support to enterprise-managed Shell, Bash, and PowerShell permission rules Add --host-allow-session-creation to let remote clients create sessions on CLI hosts for one launch without changing saved settings Refresh /usage…
items.html:
2026-11-13

  • Add regular expression support to enterprise-managed Shell, Bash, and PowerShell permission rules
  • Add --host-allow-session-creation to let remote clients create sessions on CLI hosts for one launch without changing saved settings
  • Refresh /usage premium request usage so percentages stay current.
  • Prevent duplicate MCP OAuth reconnects and keep servers in needs-auth after canceled authorization
  • Markdown tables containing a wide symbol followed by the text variation selector, such as ⌛︎, render with correctly aligned rows
  • The footer.showCodeChanges setting description now says it shows the lines added and removed by Copilot's file edits in this session, not pending changes
  • The /usage activity graph now fits narrow terminals by showing fewer weeks, instead of wrapping every day row in two
  • Shell output and custom status lines display correctly when terminal control sequences appear, without applying unintended text styles
  • /rewind with Conversation + files no longer counts, lists or reports as restored a file that later turns had already put back or deleted again
  • Interactive /plugin marketplace commands find repository-local marketplaces when the CLI starts in a subdirectory
  • Keep selection labels readable and rows aligned in /environments when using --screen-reader
  • /skills get without a skill name and the /mcp usage text name the get and remove verbs instead of the retired info and delete
  • /diff shows a clear notice for binary files instead of garbled text or an empty pane
  • The /usage activity graph hides its legend in narrow panes to prevent it from wrapping onto extra lines
  • The $ shell shortcut reports launch failures once with a clear reason, including when Ctrl+G opens the editor at the same time.
  • /mcp search installs registry servers with URL variables using the values you enter
  • Custom status lines render terminal colors and formatting correctly, without stray characters after color resets.
  • Hook approval dialogs show control characters in tool names and arguments as visible text instead of hiding or restyling them
  • /session delete-all, /session prune, and /session delete preserve sessions running in the background in the same window
  • Text that fits on one row stays on one row after resizing the terminal
  • In /workflows, a run's Agents list no longer runs off the bottom of a short terminal: the selected agent stays on screen, and a long phase title stays on one row
  • copilot plugin enable, disable, update and uninstall now fail and name config.json when it cannot be parsed, instead of reporting success without a change or that the plugin is not installed
  • --no-color preserves text styling while disabling colors, even when FORCE_COLOR is set
  • Pasted image paths attach correctly when you press Enter immediately after pasting in terminals that mark pasted input
  • Keep the selected /share action visible when navigation keys cannot move the selection in short terminals
  • MCP forms show validation errors immediately for answers edited in an external editor with Ctrl+G
  • Running copilot --continue with no previous session shows the welcome header and Getting started box.
  • Keep the Sessions tab responsive when dialogs open during navigation, and show pending dialogs where they can be answered
  • Keep the highlighted confirmation option visible in the Sessions tab and /environments on short terminals
  • Keep the /theme picker's title and border on screen in narrow terminals and beside the docked Sessions sidebar, dropping the preview instead
  • The /share screen keeps the selected action visible in narrow terminals
  • /ask and /btw show answers correctly beside the Sessions sidebar in narrow terminals
  • Keep the /tasks title and borders visible when the task list is longer than the terminal can display
  • copilot -p "/compact" --silent no longer prints the compaction result line to stdout, so --silent output stays limited to the agent's response
  • Keep the prompt, tab bar, and status line visible when typing a multi-line draft during the startup animation on short terminals
  • /diff shows staged renames under their new names, including edits made while renaming
  • With experimental dynamic workflows, a workflow's own agent can no longer start or resume workflow runs, so a workflow can no longer start copies of itself without limit when all tools are allowed.
  • With the high-contrast theme on a 16 or 256-colour terminal, the Sessions tab shows the status icon of the selected row instead of drawing it blue on blue
  • Follow-ups typed while the agent is working now run in the order they were typed; one that reached the session between two turns is no longer overtaken by follow-ups typed after it.
  • The /usage activity graph counts only the prompts you typed, not sub-agent or autopilot prompts, and its message total matches the days the graph draws
  • Pasted escape sequences no longer change text colours or hide text in search fields
  • copilot -p with --trust-folder, run from a subdirectory of a repository, now warns that the hooks at the repository root were not loaded and says how to load them
  • Custom status lines display non-ASCII characters correctly even when commands write them in pieces
  • Copying inline code from wrapped rows after resizing the terminal no longer includes extra non-breaking spaces.
  • Queued slash commands now show an error when they fail instead of disappearing silently
  • Prompts sent as a turn finishes now run without waiting for background agents to complete
  • Dragging the sessions divider or scrollbar now ends cleanly when the left mouse button is no longer held.
  • Allow your own scratch files under /tmp on macOS without path permission prompts unless --disallow-temp-dir is set
  • Re-attaching an image or document after switching models or compacting a session sends its content to the model
  • Show an error when /update cannot download a release instead of leaving the download progress message indefinitely
  • Sessions started with /new or from the Sessions tab can be controlled from GitHub when remote sessions are enabled
  • Expand ${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT} in plugin hook working directories and environment values
  • Push-to-talk preserves dictated text when held Space key repeats pause and resume
  • OAuth sign-in for remote MCP servers works through proxies that require Kerberos (Negotiate) authentication
  • Show permission prompts, questions, and confirmations directly in the sub-agent view so you can respond without leaving it
  • Keep text after terminal control sequences visible in labels and output, and hide embedded image data
  • Search in /skills, /mcp, and /plugin matches visible text instead of words hidden inside terminal escape sequences
  • Clear the previous profile's routed model from the footer and custom status line when switching Copilot Fusion profiles
  • Prevent @ file mentions and /sandbox path completion from selecting outdated suggestions when typing quickly
  • The /sandbox Credentials tab counts masked environment variables separately from unmasked suggestions
  • /resume keeps session rows aligned and columns visible with --screen-reader, and announces unread status once
  • Show all rows of wrapped Japanese, Chinese, and Korean text without clipping the last row or leaving extra blank rows
  • Resizing the terminal during a text-selection drag preserves the clipboard instead of copying empty lines or unhighlighted text
  • Keep the @ file picker up to date when ignore files change above the working directory
  • Autopilot confirmation hides Assisted Permissions when disabled by administrator policy and explains why they are unavailable.
  • Keep /config view tabs and the selected view readable in screen-reader mode on narrow terminals
  • Exiting the CLI on macOS and Linux now stops attached background shells even when they ignore termination signals.
  • Sandboxed MCP startup errors identify refused filesystem operations even when the server prints a stack trace
  • /mcp token counts exclude tools deferred by client-side tool search
  • Preserve freshly pasted text when stashing or opening the external editor, and prevent Ctrl+D from exiting while a paste is pending
  • Prevent the # issue and pull request picker from selecting outdated results when typing quickly

…

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI v1.0.110
items.summary: 2026-11-12 Experimental: answer git, ssh, and sudo password prompts from agent commands in a masked dialog (enable with /experimental on) Avoid unnecessary error popups during Microsoft Entra sign-in when an organization account is available Screen readers…
items.html:
2026-11-12

  • Experimental: answer git, ssh, and sudo password prompts from agent commands in a masked dialog (enable with /experimental on)
  • Avoid unnecessary error popups during Microsoft Entra sign-in when an organization account is available
  • Screen readers identify the current session and announce when sessions need attention or are idle in the Sessions list
  • /usage model rows wrap at the terminal width instead of breaking at 100 columns
  • The / command picker no longer lists, preselects or runs a skill for a word that the skill's description hides inside a terminal escape sequence; only words the description shows match
  • Preserve keys typed just as the Ctrl+X shortcut window closes
  • Keep session rows and the selection cursor visible in the Sessions tab in narrow or short terminals
  • Preserve existing MCP configuration when /mcp add or /mcp edit encounters an invalid configuration file, and show a save error
  • Hide empty Thought rows when reasoning contains only invisible characters
  • Label partial responses and reasoning from interrupted or failed attempts as incomplete while preserving their text
  • Starting copilot from a directory that has since been deleted now says the directory no longer exists and how to recover, instead of crashing with a Node stack trace, and -C <directory> now works from there.
  • The workflow run tool no longer tells the model that a user reviews every run's limits when all tool permissions are pre-approved.
  • /compact respects the session AI credit limit, preventing additional charges once the limit is reached
  • Vim normal mode keeps j/k at line ends after $ or End and preserves the cursor column when using Up/Down across shorter lines
  • Plugin listings show enabled local marketplace plugins with missing directories as enabled but not loaded, with an explanation
  • /init suppress immediately hides the Getting started /init tip and keeps it hidden when returning to the folder.
  • Copying wrapped prompt text preserves typed line breaks without adding newlines at visual wraps
  • /worktree HEAD and /move HEAD create a worktree using the normalized branch name "head" instead of failing.
  • /session prune and its dry run skip sessions open in other processes and report how many were skipped
  • The /statusline preview keeps footer segments readable on narrow terminals
  • Ctrl+S in the /mcp add and edit forms saves once, with a single success message and server reload.
  • Ctrl+Y and /share research show their usual no-report messages instead of raw filesystem errors when the research folder cannot be read.
  • /lsp list and /lsp reload report syntax errors in your LSP configuration instead of a misleading missing-key error.
  • Unnamed sessions show their short ID in the Sessions tab and /resume list, keeping the same label after resuming
  • Assistant replies no longer indent or wrap the row after an inline code span that ends exactly at the right edge
  • With the Sessions sidebar docked, /lsp logs, the /every schedule manager, /workflows and the /mcp add form fit the pane beside it instead of being cut off at its edge
  • Mouse selections in scrolled-up conversations copy only highlighted text when released over the prompt or status line
  • Searches in /agent and the Sessions tab match visible text rather than hidden escape sequences.
  • Ctrl+R history search highlights, scrolls to, and places the cursor on matches with decomposed accents.
  • Installing, uninstalling, enabling or disabling a plugin, or adding or removing a marketplace, no longer erases your other plugin and marketplace settings when settings.json has an invalid value; the command now reports the error and leaves the file unchanged
  • Slash commands that fail at an idle prompt now show an error with the command name and reason
  • The slash-command picker underlines matching characters correctly in descriptions containing a capital dotted I.
  • /cwd, /cd, and /add-dir use the path you type when you press Enter before directory suggestions update
  • Pressing Enter twice on a permission prompt approves the request without showing a false retry warning
  • Prompt text wraps without splitting words that fit on a line, wrapping early, or adding stray leading spaces and blank lines
  • Keep accented and CJK characters intact when typing after keyboard shortcuts or pasting over slow terminal connections
  • Read JSON-valued settings, such as hook definitions, with copilot config <key> and /settings show <key>.
  • Ctrl+C stops a ! shell command even when pressed immediately after submitting it
  • Memory changes in /settings take effect without restarting the CLI
  • Preserve exact numbers, duplicate keys, and key order when displaying JSON tool results in previews and expanded views
  • Warn when repository settings override the reasoning effort for new sessions after saving a default with /model --global or /model --repo
  • /context shows loaded custom instructions as a separate token count instead of including them in System Prompt
  • Make /restart work when the CLI is launched with an attached directory argument such as -Csub or -C=sub
  • Show a single status entry when /compact is cancelled or has nothing to compact, without treating nothing to compact as an error
  • Keep /config and /settings readable beside the docked Sessions sidebar by fitting the layout to the available pane width
  • Show a warning when --yolo or --allow-all flags are ignored because bypass permissions mode is disabled, including in non-interactive runs
  • Shell completion works after --effort, --no-remote-export, and bare --sync-session flags; regenerate your completion script to apply
  • Report missing MCP servers as not found in copilot mcp remove and /mcp delete instead of suggesting a disable command that cannot find them
  • Show the MCP reload notice only once when /new worktree, /fork worktree, or /resume opens a session in another directory
  • Correct highlighting and emoji display in directory and agent pickers for names containing a capital dotted I.
  • /skills reload reports the same skill count as /skills list.
  • Allow copilot mcp enable for most servers even when mcp-config.json is invalid
  • Dialogs and tables fit beside the Sessions sidebar without clipped text or columns, and /sandbox fits narrow terminals.
  • Show custom agents marked user-invocable: false in /subagents so you can configure their models and turn them on or off
  • Show which plugin rules are off by default in copilot instruction list
  • Show names and file paths containing Markdown characters exactly as configured in /env
  • Keep text selections visible without adding color when NO_COLOR is set
  • Keep attachments and pasted text intact when clicking inside their labels in the prompt and typing
  • A postToolUse hook that rewrites a shell command's output, for example to redact a secret, again changes what the Shell row and copilot -p print, not only what the model receives
  • Apply URL rules saved in /settings to the active session without requiring a restart
  • Keep /model details visible when the Sessions sidebar is docked
  • Show changed files with non-UTF-8 filenames in /diff, including their patches
  • Preserve blank lines when copying text from the prompt with the mouse
  • Mouse scrolling and clicks in /settings and /config work correctly with the Sessions sidebar docked
  • Keep typed text visible and the cursor aligned after completing folder or agent names containing control characters
  • Show cancellation only once when interrupting a turn with Esc Esc while a /model switch is queued
  • Removing a problem in /settings keeps the selection on the first remaining row instead of jumping to an unrelated one

items.summary: 2026-11-10 Add IPv4/IPv6 CIDR support for sandbox host allow and deny rules in settings. Add support for Claude Fable 5.2 in the model picker under New models copilot help input now says that Backspace at the start of shell input leaves shell mode and keeps…
items.html:
2026-11-10

  • Add IPv4/IPv6 CIDR support for sandbox host allow and deny rules in settings.
  • Add support for Claude Fable 5.2 in the model picker under New models
  • copilot help input now says that Backspace at the start of shell input leaves shell mode and keeps the typed text, not only on an empty prompt
  • /subagents keeps its Overridden and Status columns readable on narrow terminals and aligns agent names with wide characters
  • Removing a built-in MCP server with copilot mcp remove or /mcp delete explains how to disable it instead
  • Selecting a directory next to your home directory in /cd ~ or /add-dir ~ uses the correct full path
  • Trusted-folder and worktree confirmations keep Windows path separators
  • Hide empty assistant reply bullets when a response contains only whitespace
  • Choosing "don't ask again" for parallel file operations approves all covered requests without prompting again
  • Make /terminal-setup configure Shift+Enter in the correct location for VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf on Linux when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set
  • The footer's AI credits now update as soon as /compact finishes instead of after the next turn
  • Prompt mode with --output-format json emits a final result record with an exit status even when a run fails early
  • Rate-limit errors now name the same mode as the switch dialog (Copilot Fusion mode or auto mode) instead of "auto model"
  • In a multi-line prompt, Up and Down now start from the cursor after Left, Right, Backspace, Delete or a similar key that had nothing to act on at the start or end of the text, instead of jumping to the column of the previous Up/Down run
  • Number keys keep working in shell and URL approval dialogs after pressing the number of the "No, and tell Copilot" option and moving back up
  • /cd . and /add-dir . now keep the current directory in a git repository instead of selecting .git; the directory picker lists ./ first and still offers hidden directories below it
  • In ACP mode, a preToolUse hook that answers ask now asks the ACP client to allow or deny the tool call instead of denying it as host policy
  • /voice immediately reports an overly long socket path and how to fix it, instead of waiting before showing a generic error.
  • File move permission prompts show both source and destination paths, and pure renames no longer show an empty diff.
  • Session history keeps every turn when a second window works on a session another window still has open
  • The beepOnSchedule setting description now says it controls the beep when a scheduled /every or /after turn finishes, and only while beep is on, instead of a beep when the prompt fires
  • The companyAnnouncements setting description now says one message, picked at random, appears in the timeline as a Company announcement notice, not in the startup banner
  • copilot help config no longer says turning off compactPaste shows every paste in full; pastes over 20 KB are still saved to a workspace file
  • copilot help config now names the home screen tabs as they appear, Current and Sessions, instead of Session and Agents
  • The ctrl+h entry in the keyboard shortcut help now says it deletes the previous word in local Windows terminals, where the terminal sends the same key for ctrl+h and ctrl+backspace
  • The footer.showModelEffort setting description now says it toggles only the reasoning effort label next to the model name, which always shows, and that the effort shows briefly after it changes when the setting is unset
  • copilot help config no longer names staff-only and internal settings, such as taskbarPresence, showTipsOnStartup and streamerMode
  • The ide.openDiffOnEdit setting description now says the IDE diff opens for a file edit waiting for your approval, and that accepting or rejecting it answers that prompt, instead of a diff on every edit
  • Text typed after /init now reaches the model as extra guidance for the generated instructions file and appears in the timeline, instead of being silently dropped.
  • The /init usage hint now shows [suppress|<instructions>], since text after /init guides what it writes, instead of listing only suppress
  • The inlineImages setting description no longer says images render with Sixel graphics by default; Sixel is used only with experimental features on
  • MCP tool results that return text as a base64 blob resource with a text MIME type, such as text/plain or application/json, now reach the model instead of arriving as an empty result
  • copilot help providers-env and copilot help environment no longer say COPILOT_PROVIDER_BEARER_TOKEN always takes precedence over COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY: it does for openai and azure, but anthropic sends both
  • copilot help providers-env and copilot help environment now say COPILOT_PROVIDER_MODEL_ID and COPILOT_PROVIDER_WIRE_MODEL default to the --model value before COPILOT_MODEL, and that the wire model falls back to COPILOT_PROVIDER_MODEL_ID
  • copilot help providers-env and copilot help environment now say COPILOT_PROVIDER_TRANSPORT=websockets works only with provider type openai and the responses wire API, instead of implying it works for azure and anthropic too
  • copilot help providers-env no longer says COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY_COMMAND output is always sent: it says the command does not run when COPILOT_PROVIDER_BEARER_TOKEN is set, and that a custom credential header's precedence depends on the provider type
  • copilot help providers-env and copilot help environment now say that COPILOT_PROVIDER_* variables take precedence over a saved providers.json, unless COPILOT_PROVIDERS_CONFIG names the file
  • copilot help providers-local now says Copilot looks for Ollama only on this machine, and that an OLLAMA_HOST on another machine is ignored
  • Running /research again on the same topic, or on a topic that starts with the same words, now saves a new report instead of trying to write over the earlier one.
  • The sandbox.auth.git setting description now says sandboxed git gets a masked credential that the sandbox proxy swaps for the real one only at that HTTPS origin, and that hosts other than GitHub use your own git credential helper, instead of saying the GitHub token is injected
  • The sandbox.userPolicy.network.proxy.url setting description now says sandboxed traffic always reaches the configured proxy through the built-in local proxy, which keeps proxy credentials away from sandboxed commands, instead of saying traffic without host rules uses the proxy directly
  • Sessions closed or disposed outside the sessions API no longer stay in memory in the CLI's embedded SDK server
  • A collapsed grep or glob row now counts only the files or lines a search found, not the summary lines of a large result or an appended warning, which made an empty search read "3 files found".
  • The search subagent's semantic_search tool now tells the model it returns up to 5 excerpts from GitHub's code index for the repository, instead of claiming to search the local workspace and return its full contents when small.
  • The /settings value column, the footer's model name and the startup warning for an invalid allowedUrls or deniedUrls entry no longer pass control characters from settings.json to the terminal.
  • The subagents.maxConcurrency and subagents.maxDepth setting descriptions now say the settings are ignored on Copilot plans without usage-based billing, instead of saying they apply only to usage-based billing users
  • copilot update --help no longer calls stable the default update channel: with no channel argument and no autoUpdatesChannel setting, a prerelease build stays on prerelease
  • A mistyped server in your own mcp-config.json is now reported at startup and in mcp list, and an mcp-config.json that cannot be used names the file and the real problem.

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI v1.0.108
items.summary: 2026-11-09 Add sandbox.userPolicy.filesystem.enumeratePaths in settings.json for Windows enumerate-only directory grants Add /index commands and enable managed shared tgrep indexing by default for eligible repositories PDF attachments on Grok 4.7 and Grok 4.6…
items.html:
2026-11-09

  • Add sandbox.userPolicy.filesystem.enumeratePaths in settings.json for Windows enumerate-only directory grants
  • Add /index commands and enable managed shared tgrep indexing by default for eligible repositories
  • PDF attachments on Grok 4.7 and Grok 4.6 fall back to file references instead of failing the turn
  • With the sandbox on, a running local MCP server is now restarted after /cd, so it follows the new directory's denied paths instead of keeping those of the directory the session left.
  • A file attachment sent through the SDK that points at a named pipe, socket or device is now tagged as an error instead of stalling the turn until something writes to the pipe.
  • The canvas tools now tell the model which instance IDs open_canvas accepts, instead of calling them free-form.
  • /model now lists models when Copilot answers the model list request with 421 Misdirected Request, for example after a plan change, by re-resolving your account's endpoint as chat turns already do instead of showing "Error loading model list".
  • Requests to OpenAI-compatible chat-completions providers no longer include an internal message field on skill and tool messages.
  • Ctrl+C now stops a running /compact, as Esc Esc does, instead of only arming the exit hint and quitting the CLI on a second press.
  • The /config help no longer shows literal backticks or uses a model outside the model list as its example.
  • Your defaultMode setting now applies when you close the startup session picker while the session is still loading its model, instead of the session staying in its previous mode.
  • A disabledSkills entry, skills.disable and skills.enable now match a skill name in any letter case, as invoking the skill does, instead of silently doing nothing when the case differs.
  • Creating or resuming an SDK session, or replacing its tools, with two custom tools of the same name is now an error. Before, the model was offered the first definition while some SDKs ran the handler of the last one.
  • Copilot no longer crashes with an unhandled exception at startup when it cannot save its first-launch timestamp, for example because the disk holding the Copilot home directory is full. The failure is logged and startup continues.
  • The Getting started box no longer suggests /init in a folder where you ran /init suppress, in a repository that already has Copilot instructions, or outside a git repository.
  • copilot help config now names the .claude/rules instruction files and the .claude/settings.json repository settings the CLI reads.
  • copilot help input now says that esc esc also stops a running /compact, and that in shell mode a single esc or ctrl+c on an empty prompt leaves shell mode
  • /help now describes ctrl+d (exits only on an empty prompt, otherwise deletes the next character) and ctrl+z on Windows correctly, and lists ctrl+j, ctrl+v, ctrl+y and the voice input keys.
  • copilot help limits now quotes the rate-limit prompt as local sessions show it, "Switch to Copilot Fusion mode?", instead of "Switch to auto mode?".
  • copilot help mcp now says that a directory's .github/mcp.json is ignored when the same directory has a .mcp.json, instead of implying the two files are merged
  • copilot help monitoring now describes the github.copilot.sandbox.operation.count metric as counting every sandbox decision by kind, not only deduplicated posture changes.
  • Pasting an image path again after clearing its [image: ...] label with Ctrl+U, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+W or an Up-arrow history recall attaches the image again instead of inserting the plain path.
  • Backspace, an arrow key, Ctrl+U or Shift+Enter pressed right after a paste now acts after the pasted text instead of on the text in front of it.
  • Picking an MCP server type by its number in the add or edit form now moves focus to the next field for that type.
  • /permissions default in Autopilot now asks again how to handle permissions on the next prompt, as /permissions manual does, instead of leaving Autopilot to deny every tool request.
  • A queued /ask or /btw that runs while another side answer is open now shows that it is still thinking, instead of showing the previous answer as its own finished answer for Ctrl+Y to copy.
  • copilot --resume and /resume now find a session whose name has an accent typed precomposed or decomposed, whichever spelling the session was saved with.
  • In /search, Up, Down and Enter bring a single match back into view after you scroll away, and a shorter terminal no longer leaves the current match off screen.
  • /security-review help now says it reviews the branch diff when the working tree is clean, not only staged and unstaged changes
  • Escape sequences in checkpoint titles, file names, Copilot home paths and generated agent names no longer restyle /session info or the /agent wizard.
  • Long values in /session info, such as the log and session file paths, now wrap under their own column instead of back under the label
  • Switching to another session no longer occasionally replaces that session's model with Auto while the model list reloads.
  • /share usage no longer implies that /share alone exports a markdown file; it shows that a bare path must contain /, . or ~.
  • A path or URL route in a prompt, such as /docs/setup.md, no longer loads a skill named after its first segment (docs) as if you had invoked that skill.
  • Subcommands of /pr, /lsp, /skills, /plugin, /user and /collect-debug-logs now match in any letter case, so /lsp TEST my-server runs the test instead of showing usage text.
  • Help for /experimental and /theme now marks /experimental on|off and /theme <mode> as deprecated and points at /settings, and /mcp disable is no longer described as temporary: it is saved across sessions.
  • A repository sessionStart prompt hook that runs /clear <prompt> or /new now starts one new session instead of starting another one in every session it creates.
  • The duration shown on a sub-agent no longer counts the time its tool calls spent at permission prompts.
  • The /subagents help no longer promises a default subagent model. It now says the command configures each subagent's model and settings and turns subagents on or off.
  • Tab characters in replies, error messages, agent names and other text are now shown as spaces instead of being dropped, so tab-separated words no longer run together.
  • The duration shown on a tool call no longer counts the time spent at its permission prompt, and it does not tick while the prompt is open.
  • The /update channel choices now say that picking stable or prerelease also saves it as your update channel for future updates.
  • Preserve input queued behind a paste when resizing the terminal
  • Memory import reports malformed repository scopes without a false unsupported host error
  • Show a warning when a selected custom agent's configured skills are missing or cannot be loaded
  • Include session start, resume, and model-change events in -p --output-format json output
  • Keep built-in agents selected with --agent active when opening /agent or refreshing available agents
  • Interactive CLI sessions pass local MCP server environment values literally; use ${NAME} to reference a host environment variable
  • Allow semantic code search to find renamed repositories when the checkout still uses the old name
  • Use Ctrl+T to show and hide First Pass reasoning when Fusion is selected through a routing profile
  • Keep the selected match in view when opening /search or /find instead of jumping to the bottom of the conversation.
  • Allow the system to sleep again after a background MCP reload finishes when using /keep-alive busy.
  • Keep the footer's plan hint visible when a nonempty plan is available
  • Interactive Autopilot waits for your response to MCP input and consent requests instead of automatically declining them
  • /mcp enable now respects repository settings that disable an MCP server
  • Renaming files with the patch tool now succeeds without requiring changes to their contents

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI v1.0.107
items.summary: 2026-11-06 Rex terminals render inline images using Kitty direct placements. Add /code command to open the current session in VS Code Add a Fusion tier setting to copilot config. Make /settings open the unified dashboard for all users and add global search…
items.html:
2026-11-06

  • Rex terminals render inline images using Kitty direct placements.
  • Add /code command to open the current session in VS Code
  • Add a Fusion tier setting to copilot config.
  • Make /settings open the unified dashboard for all users and add global search across settings and local resources.
  • Interactive CLI reports program status to supporting terminals, including when attention is needed.
  • Add opt-in session management tools and @mentions for opted-in local sessions
  • Add COPILOT_SESSION_CWD for launching and expanding LSP and local MCP server configs
  • Add GPT-6.1 Terra as a selectable model under New models when available to your account
  • Add a Sandbox extensions setting to run extension processes inside the sandbox
  • Add MATS telemetry for Entra authentication through OneAuth, respecting client telemetry opt-out.
  • An image removed from the prompt with Ctrl+U, Ctrl+K or Ctrl+W, or replaced by a recalled history entry, is no longer sent with the message, and Ctrl+S can stash the prompt afterwards.
  • Pasted text containing NEL, Unicode line or paragraph separators now fills separate prompt lines, and pasted DEL and C1 control characters are dropped, instead of being kept in the prompt and cutting characters off the end of the row.
  • In copilot -p --plan, the agent is no longer told to suggest Shift+Tab to leave plan mode, which only works in the interactive interface, and is asked to include the plan's key points in its reply instead.
  • copilot --resume <id> no longer waits with no output and no end when the Copilot task service does not respond; the task lookup now gives up after 10 seconds and resolution continues.
  • Sandboxed grep, rg, and glob now report Windows launch failures instead of silent no-match results
  • Model picker shows context window size for flat, unpriced, and single-tier models
  • Sandboxed local MCP servers respect relative filesystem permissions from the session directory, even when configured with a different working directory.
  • PowerShell commands work on Windows when the CLI is installed in a long directory path
  • Switching sessions while other sessions are busy no longer crashes the CLI and leaves a blank terminal
  • Keep readable image attachments when retrying a prompt that contains a corrupt image
  • MCP Entra authentication now falls back to the VS Code registration when Copilot CLI preauthorization is unavailable.
  • Sandboxed local MCP servers now start correctly when configured with a relative cwd.
  • On Windows, sandboxed sessions in nested Git directories can change to and write at the repository root
  • Autopilot no longer starts implementing its own recommendation after a request that only asked for a review or analysis
  • Suppress unnecessary MCP reload summaries when plugin servers remain unchanged
  • A model request that Copilot's service answers with an empty 404 while under load is now retried instead of ending the turn with "Execution failed: 404".
  • copilot help config now lists every setting the settings catalog offers, including the ones that were missing from its hand-written text, such as askUser, effortLevel, planModel, toolSearch and worktreeBaseRef
  • ACP clients can switch a session started with --yolo out of autopilot, and allow-all stays on, instead of the switch failing as blocked by policy and a second attempt turning allow-all off.
  • The @ file picker now underlines a name with a capital dotted I, such as İstanbul.txt, when the query is typed without the dot, and no longer shortens that row's matched folder.
  • The @ file picker now underlines matches in names stored with decomposed accents or found by a query typed without accents, and no longer shortens such a row's matched folder.
  • Up and Down in a multi-line prompt keep the column you started from when they pass through a shorter line, instead of leaving the caret near the start of the line.
  • Ctrl+Y and /share research skip research folder entries that are not readable files, such as a broken link or a folder named like a report, instead of failing or offering them.
  • Show each agent's selection ID in /agent when multiple agents share a display name.
  • The edit tool now fails at once on a named pipe, socket or device instead of waiting forever for the other end of a FIFO, which stalled the turn.
  • An empty plan.md no longer shows the ctrl+y plan hint or Plan: yes in /session, and ctrl+y opens the research report instead, matching /session plan.
  • The footer keeps the "N scheduled", sandbox, YOLO and CI status items whole on narrow terminals by shortening the directory and branch first, instead of cutting the items off the end of the row.
  • Pull request, issue and gist details, and their load errors, no longer let escape sequences in titles, names, branches, gist files or server messages restyle the terminal.
  • Show the saved paused goal and continuation guidance when resuming an autopilot session.
  • Issues and pull requests picked with # are no longer dropped from the message when another one is picked in front of them, and an issue picked twice is sent once.
  • copilot help billing now says the footer shows the AI credits used in this session (nothing by default on the legacy billing platform), and that the /statusline quota item is off by default and ai-used is on.
  • copilot help config now says copyOnSelect is on by default on macOS, that /keep-alive changes only the current session, that logLevel is set in the /settings dialog or settings.json rather than copilot config, and that trustedFolders lives in config.json and is filled by the folder-trust prompt.
  • copilot help environment now says a COPILOT_AUTO_TIER value of "fast" is ignored with a notice rather than rejected, and that USE_TGREP=true does not override whether indexed search is available for your account or USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP=false.
  • copilot help config, copilot help environment and copilot help acp no longer name the hidden --prefer-version, --server and --stdio options.
  • copilot help limits shows a status example at the real minimum AI credit limit and says the final-call warning appears when 10% or less of the limit remains
  • copilot help monitoring now says an http:// OTLP endpoint disables export only when an OTLP CA certificate or client certificate/key variable is set, not for every http:// endpoint.
  • copilot help permissions now documents glob patterns in write(path) and read(path) rules, lists the read and memory kinds, and explains that an unscoped write rule approves shell output redirection but not the command itself; it no longer says wildcard matching is coming in the future.
  • copilot --help and copilot help --help now list the acp help topic, and copilot help --help no longer prints its description and topic list with stray indentation.
  • Form and settings text fields show the control characters of a stored value, such as an MCP server command, instead of letting them recolor or hide its text.
  • Issue and pull request details on the home screen hide HTML comments from the description, as GitHub does, instead of printing template instructions as text
  • Issue and pull request details also hide an HTML comment that a blank line splits inside a <details> or other HTML block, instead of showing its opening and its text.
  • Assistant replies keep angle-bracket words that are not HTML, such as Vec<String>, Set<T> and <file> placeholders, instead of silently dropping them from the sentence.
  • Removing a local marketplace now refuses while one of its plugins is enabled, --force also clears that plugin, and /plugin marketplace remove accepts --force before the name.
  • A follow-up sent while an earlier one is pending is no longer rejected with "Submission failed" when it mentions a file with a very long number after a colon (@file:99999999999999999999).
  • The model picker keeps its Context and Reasoning column labels when a search or scroll hides the first model group.

…
