items.title: Oh My Pi v18.19.0
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-ai Added Added the liquid-systemone judgment API for Liquid AI decision models, including validation that rejects image sets exceeding Liquid’s 10,000 32×32-patch request limit before submission. Fixed Fixed Gemini CLI and Antigravity responses…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added the liquid-systemone judgment API for Liquid AI decision models, including validation that rejects image sets exceeding Liquid’s 10,000 32×32-patch request limit before submission.
Fixed
  • Fixed Gemini CLI and Antigravity responses losing or misordering thought signatures and reply text, including responses that follow tool calls.
  • Fixed Gemini CLI and Antigravity merging reply text around a thought signature, dropping signatures at the start of a reply or after a tool call, and placing a thought ahead of reply text that streamed before it (#18942 by @JustasMasiulis)
  • Fixed Google Antigravity judging Gemini models by quota buckets they do not consume: Gemini 3.x requests ignore the Gemini 4 Argon weekly bucket, and Argon requests ignore gemini-weekly, so an exhausted or low bucket no longer blocks, reserves, or caps an account for the other models (#16104).

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added Liquid AI provider support with the d1.1 and d1-ultra judge models and Liquid authentication via /login liquid using LIQUID_API_KEY.
Fixed
  • Fixed Google Antigravity Gemini 4 Argon models sharing the general Gemini quota scope instead of their dedicated weekly bucket (#16104).

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Breaking Changes
  • Changed the browser open API: ignore_https_errors is now insecure, allow_file_access has been removed, and file: pages can access other local files.
  • Changed the browser open and targets app option from an object to a string or CDP endpoint/executable path. Use argv instead of app.args and the top-level target instead of app.target.
  • Removed task.file and the task tool's taskFile field; subagent instructions must now be provided inline.
  • Removed blocked todo tasks and the blocked status/blocker metadata. Existing blocked tasks are restored as pending.
Added
  • Added systemPromptTemplates, which maps model-selector patterns to Handlebars template files for customizing system prompts. Templates re-render when switching models, with warnings and fallback to the bundled prompt for missing or invalid templates.
  • Added ordered multi-step tasks through task.steps. Subagents receive steps sequentially, and the final step determines the task result; interrupted tasks resume with their remaining steps.
  • Added Liquid AI judge models liquid/d1.1 and liquid/d1-ultra, including image resizing for Liquid's request limits.
  • Added per-step progress, state, and duration reporting for GitHub Actions watches, with expandable details and native Tern Surface Protocol views.
  • Added task.autoParallel (off, suggest, or on) to identify subtasks that can run concurrently and optionally delegate them in a single parallel task call.
  • Added portable awk, tar, lsof, shasum, md5, and strings support to the bash tool, including Windows support and internal-URI paths.
Changed
  • Browser sessions now prefer the bundled ABKit WebKit engine when available, with automatic installation and SHA-256 verification. WebKit provides headed, user-visible tabs and broader browser compatibility; Chromium remains the fallback and can be selected explicitly with app: "chromium", while app: "webkit" requires WebKit. Configure this behavior with browser.webkit and browser.webkitPath or the corresponding environment variables.
  • Browser visibility controls now show or hide WebKit tab windows immediately. Headed WebKit tabs can be interacted with directly, while Chromium tabs retain their existing mode-switching behavior.
  • In Tern environments with native DOM access, browser observation and interaction use trusted native input across frames and closed shadow roots, with caret-aware typing and case-insensitive text selectors.
  • edit.modelVariants now uses the longest matching model pattern, so specific patterns take precedence over generic ones regardless of configuration order.
  • The ask tool now submits the form's current values when its timeout expires; updated settings and documentation reflect this behavior.
  • The read tool loads detailed format selectors and URI sub-path syntax on demand, reducing the default request description while retaining inline details when read is disabled.
  • The default system prompt and tool descriptions have been streamlined, with guidance moved closer to the tools and detailed task/procedure references provided when relevant.
  • The bash pseudo view renders words built from literals and expansions as f-strings (f"repos/org/{r}/rulesets") instead of concat(...) calls.
Fixed
  • Fixed computer.close() so subsequent computer-control calls start a fresh desktop session instead of failing.
  • Fixed extension providers with oauth.modifyModels so they do not load the full model catalog before login.
  • Fixed resuming sessions so it no longer scans unrelated later session transcripts.
  • Fixed session saving on Windows to avoid UI stalls caused by repeated session-file access.
  • Fixed automatic chart selection so generated charts use compatible data and chart types.
  • Fixed bash previews for env -i commands so they display the requested command rather than generated shell setup code.

@oh-my-pi/collab-web

Fixed
  • Fixed task tool cards so spawned tasks consistently display their name, assigned agent, and instructions, with steps spawns shown as numbered stages.

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Added
  • Added shellBuiltins(sessionEnv?) to list commands provided by the embedded shell, including process controls and utilities.
  • Expanded the embedded shell with awk, tar, shasum, md5, strings, and lsof across Linux, macOS, and Windows. Destructive utilities can be disabled with PI_DISABLE_UUTILS_DESTRUCTIVE; when disabled, tar is delegated to the system.
Fixed
  • Fixed macOS text entry in Chrome and other Chromium-based applications so typing followed by Return opens the entered text instead of reloading the current page.

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Added
  • GitHub Actions watch cards now show current-step progress and can be expanded with Ctrl+O to display ordered step states and durations in ANSI and native Tern views.
Fixed
  • Fixed comparison charts mislabeling gaps against a rival column as improvements or regressions.
  • Fixed Tern edit diffs showing unrelated one-line hunks and incorrect line numbers around distant changes.
  • Fixed table charts incorrectly interpreting words such as “with,” “to,” and “from” in column names as comparison conditions.
  • Fixed chart row names containing trailing numbers, such as “EmbeddingGemma 2” and “Jev 15,” being split or incorrectly nested.
  • Fixed read rejecting colon-separated line ranges and displaying a single requested range as multiple rows.
Removed
  • Removed the blocked status from TodoStatus, the blocker field from TodoItem, and the block/unblock operations from TodoOperation.

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Added
  • Added browser utilities exposing trusted browser archive extraction limits and the installed WebKit host executable path.

What's Changed

  • feat(ai,catalog,coding-agent): add Liquid AI (d1-ultra, d1.1) judge provider by @SuperUserA in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18100

…

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Added Tool calls get ctx.toolCall.earlierEffectsSettled, which settles once the earlier calls of their message that run beside them and may write files (their approval, asked with their arguments, is not read) have finished; speculative…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added
  • Tool calls get ctx.toolCall.earlierEffectsSettled, which settles once the earlier calls of their message that run beside them and may write files (their approval, asked with their arguments, is not read) have finished; speculative results wait for those effects before validation, and cancellation while waiting prevents their commit (#16274 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added SOFYA_API_KEY as the env key for the sofya provider (#18185 by @yusufgurdogan)
Fixed
  • Devin requests no longer send temperature: 0: the catalog's temperature-floor raises it to 0.0001, so session titles and Mnemopi memory extraction work on Devin instead of failing with Cascade's opaque invalid_argument and silently falling back to another model (#18423)
  • Auth-gateway /v1/messages now answers 400 invalid_request_error for output_config.format (and the pre-GA output_format) instead of returning 200 with output the schema never constrained, so structured-output clients fall back to prompt-side schemas (#18842)
  • Auth-gateway requests denied only the requested model (Codex ChatGPT account, Cursor plan) now switch to another account and keep the denied one usable for other models, instead of marking a working credential suspect; gateway rotation now follows the same rules as local sessions, including waiting out a sibling's short usage block

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added the web/sofya search model (#18185 by @yusufgurdogan)
  • Added the temperature-floor compat axis, assigned 0.0001 on Devin so a request that pins temperature: 0 reaches Cascade as a value it accepts (#18423)
  • Added the keyless web/hackernews search engine model for Hacker News stories and comments
Fixed
  • Devin requests now identify as Devin CLI 3000.12.43, the current stable release, instead of 3000.11.205 (#18766 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon on Command Code showing no reasoning levels; both now offer low, medium, and high
  • Fixed OpenCode Zen Gemini 4 Carbon requests going to the chat-completions endpoint instead of the native Gemini endpoint Zen serves it on
Removed
  • Removed Devin's retired SWE-1.6 Fast from the models omp lists before Devin's live model list loads (first start, or when Devin is unreachable) (#18795 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Added Sofya as a web search engine (web/sofya), using SOFYA_API_KEY or a stored sofya credential (#18185 by @yusufgurdogan)
  • Documented autoresearch mode in docs/autoresearch.md: activation and its git gates, the three stop conditions, the per-segment iteration cap that defaults to none, the harness METRIC/ASI contract, and the on-disk store that OMP_AUTORESEARCH_DB_DIR relocates (#18655 by @sjawhar)
  • Extensions can import the form theme, the native span helpers (styledSpans, compactText, rowsText and the rest of the ANSI/span conversions), the xd:// URL helpers (parseXdUrl and friends) and the cfgExtensionTranscriptPresenters setting handle from @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent instead of internal module paths, which stop the extension from loading when a file moves (#18849 by @materemias)
  • /context shows loaded instruction files and skills in their own categories; System Prompt marks where each one sits without counting it twice, and notes when an extension or SDK callback changed the prompt after it was built (#17971 by @c-w-z)
  • Added Hacker News search (web/hackernews): web_search queries scoped to site:news.ycombinator.com now search HN stories and comments through the keyless HN Search API before the configured engines
Changed
  • A role edit in another omp instance no longer rewrites the task and eval tool descriptions of every running session, which was invalidating the Anthropic prompt cache from the tool definitions onward and dropping signed thinking blocks on prefix-bound models; the per-call model advertisement is now frozen into the base prompt surface and changes only when that surface rebuilds (#18716, #18732 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Agent-to-agent messages now always reach the recipient as user turns: one that ends a wait arrives right after it instead of inside the wait tool result, and none is sent with developer or system authority
  • Launch services now persist for non‑interactive sessions
  • The shell's built-in jq now behaves like jq 1.8.2 instead of jaq: the same output (number formatting, colors, -S, --indent, --seq, --stream), error messages and exit statuses, jq's full option set (--version reports jq-1.8.2), and its grammar and builtins (?//, $__loc__, modules, getpath/setpath creating missing paths, |= deletions, Oniguruma regexes, dates); it passes jq 1.8.2's own test suite
Fixed
  • Nix builds with withAppleFm = false no longer compile the Apple Foundation Models bridge with the host's Xcode (#18911)
  • Apple Silicon Nix builds include Apple Foundation Models support instead of silently building without it (#16584 by @honsunrise)
  • On Windows, the bash tool runs external commands when omp itself runs in an AppContainer sandbox, instead of failing every one with Permission denied (exit 126) (#18800 by @devjay4561)
  • Explicit Bash prompt rules remain enforced in yolo mode when a command also matches a critical pattern (#18788 by @jasonharrison).
  • Fixed job widgets and captions failing outright when the widget model errors: they now try the role's next model (retry.fallbackChains.widget, else the built-in smol defaults) and fail only once every candidate has (#18793)
  • Failed job-widget, job-caption, cache-warm, composer-prediction, and subagent completion-probe calls now keep the provider's error message in their session usage records (#18792)
  • /changelog, /changelog full, and /changelog last N now list releases newest-first, matching CHANGELOG.md and the startup release notes (#18809)
  • Fixed a read placed after a bash

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.18.8
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-ai Fixed Fixed concurrent OAuth requests rejected as claude_code_version_too_old failing instead of retrying with the required version (#18651) Chat Completions gateway requests preserve explicit tool strict-mode choices, so Codex tools can omit…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed
  • Fixed concurrent OAuth requests rejected as claude_code_version_too_old failing instead of retrying with the required version (#18651)
  • Chat Completions gateway requests preserve explicit tool strict-mode choices, so Codex tools can omit optional arguments when callers set strict: false (#18672 by @0xeb).

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added Muse Ember (muse-ember-1.0) on Meta Model API and Muse Code with the minimal–max reasoning effort ladder and its >200K long-context pricing
  • Added Gemini 4 Carbon pricing on the Gemini API, Vertex AI, Google Antigravity, and Cursor ($2 input / $0.10 cached / $10 output per 1M tokens through 2026-11-30, then $4 / $0.20 / $20), instead of showing $0 (#18734 by @eggpeat)
Fixed
  • Fixed regenerating the catalog marking 18 reasoning models as non-reasoning when NanoGPT's <id>:thinking sibling row had larger limits (#18673, #18728)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Changed
  • curl -fsSL https://omp.sh/install | sh and install.ps1 now install the standalone binary by default, even when bun is present, so installs get delta updates; pass --source/-Source for a bun package install
  • Ask forms can attach notes to selected options; those notes accompany the answers separately from submitted form values (#18779 by @Shadorain)
Fixed
  • Claude auto-redeem now spends a full saved reset on an account blocked by its weekly limit when the reset also clears the Fable cap; such resets were treated as Fable-only and skipped while Fable usage had room (#18801)
  • Fixed agents showing as idle in the Agent Hub while still running after a failed streaming edit preview (edit.streamingAbort) auto-recovered the turn (#18790 by @H4vC)
  • A browser call on a tab that is not open now says to open it with await browser.open({ name }) (Python: await browser.open(name=…)) and the url and app it was opened with, instead of pointing at the removed action:"open" (#18739 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed computer.window({ app }) and computer.windows({ app }) matching similarly named apps when the exact app name has an open window, such as Google Chrome alongside Google Chrome for Testing (#18744 by @will-bogusz)
  • In Tern, browser role/ selectors keep input roles and names under Turkish and Azeri locales (#18658 by @will-bogusz)
  • Chrome role/RootWebArea waits with visible return the document instead of failing, and hidden waits keep waiting (#18658 by @will-bogusz)
  • An omp -p or other omp that your session's bash tool or eval cell starts inside Tern or cmux no longer picks Tern or cmux from the pane it inherited, so its browser tabs stop floating over your pane (#18773 by @will-bogusz)
  • Browser relay connections sharing a tab no longer lose cross-site frames when another connection disables auto-attachment on its page; automatic children detach locally when their last armed page leaves, while explicitly attached frame subtrees remain usable after opting out (#18657 by @will-bogusz)
  • Browser agents now say when a step can't be done through the page, instead of patching the page with scripts and reporting the step as done (#18761 by @will-bogusz)
  • An extension's assistant_message rewrite now reaches the next Codex Responses request: same-model native replay used to resend the captured original text while the transcript showed the rewritten one (#18312)
  • MCP reconnects and tool-list refreshes now keep extension-deactivated tools inactive while enabling newly discovered tools (#18678).
  • Exiting after aborting a bash command now waits for its TERM-resistant foreground processes to be killed (#18669).
  • An edit touching several files that anchors lines no read displayed now reveals those lines for every file in one rejection, so the identical resend applies instead of being rejected again for the next file (#18742 by @MaisonnatM)
  • omp auth-gateway stdio now serves judge, image, speech, embedding, rerank and video models: /v1/models lists them, and /v1/systemone answers typesafe/jev-* or @judge instead of 404, or 422 from a chat model (#18740 by @andyhite)
  • omp auth-gateway stdio no longer cuts its last responses off at 128 KiB when its input ends before a slow reader has read them (#18740 by @andyhite)
  • omp --session <id> --restore restores that session, as omp --restore --session <id> does, instead of opening the session picker: a bare --restore keeps a session --session or --resume already named (#18685 by @AdamDureyAtWillship)
  • The legacy Pi virtual module now builds in an npm install that keeps the bundled Pi packages nested: it is anchored to the installed package, so its imports resolve through that package's own dependency graph (#15208, #18733 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • User-level agents, commands, and other ~/.omp/agent config (including agents saved from the agents hub) now follow PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, matching where omp agents unpack writes (#18684)
  • Fixed grep and glob treating a ; list that starts with an internal URL and includes a local path, such as artifact://1;notes.txt, as one address; each listed target is now searched (#18714 by @eggpeat)
  • Isolated tasks that edit a file whose name contains spaces now commit that file, including in a nested git repository, instead of leaving it unstaged or committing a different file that shares part of the name (#18715 by @eggpeat)
  • A disposed or switched session now releases every persistent shell it owns, including the ones a surface keeps under a name of its own (/loop conditions), instead of holding one native shell per surface for the life of the process (#18717 by @eggpeat)

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.18.7
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-ai Added LiteLLM usage adapter (@oh-my-pi/pi-ai/usage/litellm) reporting a gateway's key and user USD budgets (#17873 by @maykonmichel) UsageApi.replaceConfiguredProviders registers configuration-sourced usage providers between runtime overrides…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • LiteLLM usage adapter (@oh-my-pi/pi-ai/usage/litellm) reporting a gateway's key and user USD budgets (#17873 by @maykonmichel)
  • UsageApi.replaceConfiguredProviders registers configuration-sourced usage providers between runtime overrides and the built-in resolver, and UsageProvider.usesRequestKey makes aggregate usage probe only the key inference would send (#17873 by @maykonmichel)
Changed
  • Providers with a login-warning auth rule show their account risk before a new login and start it only after the user answers yes; any other answer or a cancel stores nothing, and their login-list entry is marked "(at your own risk)" (#18499)
Fixed
  • Claude Fable launch resets now report the Fable weekly limit they clear instead of an unknown window (#18661 by @TheAifam5)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added Muse Ember (muse-ember-1.0) on Meta Model API and Muse Code with the minimal–max reasoning effort ladder and its >200K long-context pricing
  • Added the login-warning "<text>" auth rule, which makes a new login accept the stated account risk first (#18499)
Changed
  • Resumed Google Antigravity behind a login warning instead of pausing it (#18499)
Fixed
  • Morph (api.morphllm.com) requests now send x-session-id, keeping a conversation on the worker that holds its prompt cache (#18704 by @wolfiesch)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • /usage and omp usage show LiteLLM key and user budgets for the built-in litellm provider and every models.yml provider with discovery.type: litellm, unless listed in disabledProviders (#17873 by @maykonmichel)
  • Extensions can ask the operator before an interactive quit, or cancel it, with session_before_shutdown; a further /exit or Ctrl+D skips the pending prompts and closes (#18424 by @aw1cks)
Changed
  • Saved-reset auto-redeem is set per window: codexResets.autoRedeem5h/autoRedeemWeekly and claudeResets.autoRedeem5h/autoRedeemWeekly/autoRedeemFable replace each provider's autoRedeem, whose value migrates into the 5h and weekly keys; a Claude Fable launch reset is governed by autoRedeemFable alone and spent only for a block that includes the Fable weekly cap, or before expiry when Fable usage is above zero (#18661 by @TheAifam5)
  • Sessions without a prompt UI (such as omp -p) no longer spend saved resets while auto-redeem is unset, even ones about to expire (#18661)
  • Google Antigravity is back in /login and omp login, marked "(at your own risk)": a new login first explains that Google may suspend accounts that sign in from third-party tools and continues only after you type yes; saved Antigravity logins work again (#18499)
  • On Windows, the bash tool's description tells the model it runs in an emulated bash environment, not cmd or PowerShell, so it writes bash instead of dir, %VAR% and other cmd syntax
Fixed
  • Extension prompts shown from session_before_* handlers no longer time out after 30 seconds while the operator is still answering (#18424 by @aw1cks)
  • A second exit request now skips pending worktree.onExit prompts and keeps those worktrees instead of waiting for an answer (#18424 by @aw1cks)
  • Advice that makes the agent keep working after it finished no longer comes back a second time, often as a blocker, while the agent is fixing it: advisor reviews of the earlier answer are cancelled and the advisor reviews the fix instead (#18735 by @H4vC)
  • On Windows, the bash tool's shell resolves MSYS drive paths (/c/Users/..., /mnt/c/...) everywhere, so running /c/.../tool.exe, cd /c/..., [ -f /c/... ] and < /c/... reach drive C: like they already did for ls and other built-in utilities
  • On Windows, cmd-style command lines such as dir | find /c /v "", sort /r, timeout /t 5 and whoami /all in the bash tool run the Windows programs they were written for, instead of pi's GNU-style find/sort/timeout/whoami (which read /c as drive C: and could walk the whole drive)
  • Changing or unsetting PATH in the bash tool's shell now forgets remembered command locations, as bash does, so a command no longer runs from a directory that has left PATH
  • One slow or flooding collab guest no longer ends sharing for the room: the host drops that guest's backlog and asks it to rejoin, sessions larger than the send budget can be joined, and guest questions nobody received settle as unavailable (#18629 by @iliaal)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Changed
  • grep and ast_grep results with no matches render as one line with 0 matches in the warning color, dropping the separate No matches found row (#18700 by @JustasMasiulis)
Fixed
  • Saved-reset messages name the Claude Fable weekly limit as "Claude Fable weekly" instead of its raw id (#18661 by @TheAifam5)

What's Changed

  • feat(extensions): add an interactive pre-shutdown hook by @aw1cks in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18424
  • fix(tui): show grep's 0 matches in yellow on one line by @JustasMasiulis in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18700
  • fix(shell): resolve MSYS drive paths (/c/...) in the engine on Windows by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18703
  • fix(catalog): pin Morph conversations to one worker with x-session-id by @wolfiesch in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18704
  • fix(shell): run cmd-syntax command lines through the Windows programs pi's utilities shadow by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18711
  • feat(coding-agent): split saved-reset auto-redeem into 5h, weekly and Claude Fable settings by @TheAifam5 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18661
  • fix(advisor): stop superseded reviews from re-raising advice the primary is already fixing by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18735

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog Fixed LiteLLM lists only the models the configured key can call (its authenticated /v1/models), keeping the proxy's metadata for them; a proxy whose /v1/models fails now lists no models instead of every model it serves (#18601)…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Fixed
  • LiteLLM lists only the models the configured key can call (its authenticated /v1/models), keeping the proxy's metadata for them; a proxy whose /v1/models fails now lists no models instead of every model it serves (#18601)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • In Tern, a turn's long-press menu on a phone can edit and resend a prompt, retry the turn, open the rewind page on it, or fork the session from it into a new session
  • A rewind from the transcript says how many turns it dropped and offers Undo on its toast in Tern, which puts the turns and your draft back
Changed
  • Browser role/ selectors in Chrome tabs now match the role and name Chrome's accessibility tree reports, so they reach open shadow roots and skip hidden elements; in Tern every name observe() reports selects its element again (#18632 by @will-bogusz)
Fixed
  • A late usage-limit error from a previous provider no longer blocks or cools down the selected provider; when the old provider has spent its retry budget, a replay-safe turn still tries the selected model without the old quota delay (#17098, #17571 by @Bensonluo)
  • Multi-question ask forms in Tern show Submit on the last question tab, not only on the Review tab
  • MCP headers and stdio env values that use !command now run again on a 401/403 (the request is retried once), on /mcp reconnect and other reconnects, and on /mcp reload, so servers whose command mints short-lived tokens keep working past expiry instead of staying 401 until restart (#18631)
  • Pausing an unapproved plan no longer tells the agent that the draft was approved or to continue executing it, and pausing with /plan closes an open plan review so it can no longer save and execute the plan (#18610).
  • Turning off lsp.enabled now also stops write and edit from starting language servers for diagnostics or formatting; previously only the lsp tool was disabled (#18205, #18490 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Fixed background tabs omp borrows (relay app.target, app.cdp_url) ignoring omp's clicks and keys or timing out on hover and drag; the page reads as visible while omp drives it and hidden again once released (#17831 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed the transcript jumping at the screen's top edge while scrolled back during a streamed reply, and the screen dropping two rows when a reply finished (#12307, #16117 by @galtamam-cmyk)
  • Focusing a subagent or returning to the main session no longer loses or freezes the next assistant reply when a fast tool turn finishes before the previous reply's links finish resolving, and messages and tool runs that arrive during the switch show exactly once, in order (#18564 by @eggpeat)
  • omp gc --strip now keeps every response of the latest replay turn (including earlier tool-call steps joined by their tool results), reference-only images, and the transcript's file permissions (#18636 by @eggpeat)
  • Session files whose entries were written without ids are re-indexed when loaded, and migrating old sessions no longer gives two entries the same id (#18636 by @eggpeat)
  • wait and write proc://<id>/kill now say how a settled job's result reached the caller: delivered by the call itself (it finished while the call ran), handed over by this snapshot (it superseded the job's queued completion push, so no duplicate follows), or genuinely late — the last keeps its "not auto-delivered; recovered by this snapshot" warning and adds how long before the call it had finished (#16052, #18635 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Fixed ask notes added with n right after picking an answer landing on the previous question instead of the one shown; a Tern click then Note still notes the answer just clicked, and the Note button names it (#18317 by @DonMikone)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Fixed
  • Fixed GTK4 apps such as Files (Nautilus) on X11: element clicks and computer.elementAt() now find their elements where they are on screen, and ax() no longer marks their enabled controls (disabled) (#18643 by @will-bogusz)
  • grep no longer searches the file its own output is redirected into, nor standard input redirected from that same file: both are refused with input file is also the output, as GNU grep does (#14808, #16489 by @yuzu-octopus)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Added
  • The wait result's JobSnapshot now carries settledAtMs (epoch ms when the run settled, absent while it is still running), so a snapshot can tell a result that finished during the call from one recovered from an earlier, never-delivered completion (#18635 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Added a thinking.set composer action so Tern's phone effort menu can pick a thinking level in one tap
  • Added All, Running, Done and Parked status scopes with counts to the agent hub's roster, so Tern's phone can filter agents by status
  • A prompt and a turn's answer list their actions for a phone's long press (actions.hold): Copy, Edit & resend (a prompt's), Retry turn, Rewind to here… and Fork from here; the desktop keeps its hover toolbars
  • A click or tap on a turn on the native rewind page picks it, and the rewind selector can open on a given turn (startAt)
  • A status notice can carry a button on its native toast (StatusNoticeAction), such as the Undo after a rewind
Fixed
  • Fixed streamed rows being clipped above the screen before they reached scrollback while the working row was up, so a scrolled-back terminal saw rows jump at the screen's top edge and the whole screen dropped when a run ended (#12307, #16117 by @galtamam-cmyk). Composer.setRuntimeChildren takes a billedChrome option for roots billed at their current height instead of through the floor.
  • Fixed rows of a streaming reply, and the top rows of a table taller than the screen, going missing from both the screen and scrollback with tui.completeScrollback on; such a table now keeps the column widths it had when it outgrew the screen (#16355 by @galtamam-cmyk)

@oh-my-pi/pi-wire

Added
  • actions.hold (TspMenuEntry[]): what a long press on a touch screen offers, beside actions.menu

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.18.4
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-ai Added Added the base64SkipThoughtSignature compat flag so Gemini gateways that decode thoughtSignature as base64 (such as the Hyperspace AI LLM proxy) can receive the unsigned-tool-call bypass sentinel without rejecting the request with a 400…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added the base64SkipThoughtSignature compat flag so Gemini gateways that decode thoughtSignature as base64 (such as the Hyperspace AI LLM proxy) can receive the unsigned-tool-call bypass sentinel without rejecting the request with a 400 (#18586 by @tuandinh0801).
Changed
  • Providers paused by a disabled auth rule (currently Google Antigravity) are left out of the built-in login list, refuse login, token refresh and usage probes, resolve no key from any source, and refuse requests and image generation with the pause reason; stored logins are kept and work again once the rule is removed, and an extension that registers its own login under the paused id takes it back (#18622 by @H4vC)
Fixed
  • Exclusive tools (edit, write, eval, …) called as Cursor MCP tools now keep their place in the tool batch, so a shell or read sent with an edit no longer runs against the old file or starts before an earlier call finishes (#18502 by @eggpeat)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added Otari gateway provider: /login otari with OTARI_API_KEY, models discovered live per workspace (#17841 by @tbille)
  • Added the base64SkipThoughtSignature Google compat flag, which sends the Gemini unsigned-tool-call bypass sentinel base64-encoded for gateways that decode thoughtSignature as bytes (#18586 by @tuandinh0801).
  • Added a disabled "<reason>" auth rule that pauses a provider: no login offers it and nothing calls it, while its code and users' stored logins stay in place (#18622 by @H4vC)
Changed
  • Paused Google Antigravity, since Google may restrict accounts that use it outside its own apps (#18622 by @H4vC)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • SDK: PromptOptions.followUps queues prompts to run after the prompt, in order; if the prompt never reaches the agent they come back with it in DroppedPrompt.followUps
Changed
  • The task tool no longer advertises a per-call model field unless task.perCallModel is on or the bundled seance is spawnable; a model sent anyway is still refused before dispatch (#18554 by @xiangnan0811)
Fixed
  • /usage, session statistics, and omp stats now include session title spend from both the default fork title and the tiny title model, and tiny-model titles count toward --max-cost (#18177, #18491 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Retries after --model pi/<role> (or @<role>, <role>) now walk that role's retry.fallbackChains entry instead of the default chain, including on --continue (#18389, #18534 by @harshaygadekar)
  • Fixed a -> / => list sent to an idle session running its second item before its first; if the first item can't start (Esc, a refused or failed setup), the whole list goes back to the editor (#10802)
  • Fixed auto-compaction repeating every turn when the system prompt and tool schemas alone exceed the compaction budget; it now warns once instead (#18589).
  • Fixed a blank per-call model ("" or whitespace) failing the gate for task calls, eval agent() and eval workpool() instead of using the agent's configured model (#18576 by @iwangjie)
  • task tool calls with an empty model string or empty model array now use the agent's normal model routing (#18554 by @xiangnan0811)
  • Fixed todo append without a phase failing instead of adding tasks to the active phase, the last phase, or a new Tasks phase (#17265, #18575 by @taotao7).
  • Learned-only memory guidance no longer tells the model to read a missing memory_summary.md (#18523 by @nick-maderight).
  • A wait that times out now says how long it waited and how long a back-to-back wait allows, instead of returning a bare still-running snapshot that agents read as an empty result, and the back-to-back reminder tells agents not to start sleep jobs to wait longer (#18612 by @alphastorm).
  • auth-gateway stdio now follows a role's configured fallback chain even when modelRoles does not set the role (a chat role without its own chain inherits the default chain) (#18509 by @enieuwy)
  • In the Pseudo shell visualization, a ;-separated chain no longer draws its statement separators as rows of their own, so echo a; echo b reads as two statements (#18258, #18497 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Autoresearch update_notes with append_idea now creates an ## Ideas section instead of inserting the bullet before the first heading when notes contain only a similarly named heading such as ## Ideas backlog or ### Ideas (#18505 by @eggpeat)
  • Exclusive tools (edit, write, eval, …) called as Cursor MCP tools now keep their place in the tool batch, so a check sent right after an edit sees the new file and an edit no longer starts before an earlier read finishes (#18502 by @eggpeat)
  • Quarantined Hindsight memories are now deleted once their 30-day review period ends even when no new memory is quarantined (#18504 by @eggpeat)
  • The compaction display summary no longer requests reasoning, so thinking models return a summary instead of spending the 512-token cap on reasoning and returning nothing (#18541 by @phillipxkang)
  • Retries on the same model now stop after three consecutive generic aborts instead of spending the whole retry budget (#18535 by @nick-maderight)
  • lsp.formatOnWrite

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.18.3
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog Changed Added a balanced delegation bias between eager and restrained; models without a delegation-bias rule now resolve to it instead of eager @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent Breaking Changes The ask tool takes one HTML form ({ html }) instead…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Changed
  • Added a balanced delegation bias between eager and restrained; models without a delegation-bias rule now resolve to it instead of eager

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Breaking Changes
  • The ask tool takes one HTML form ({ html }) instead of questions[]: the model writes a <form> of radios, checkboxes, selects, text inputs and textareas with its recommendation preselected, and receives the submitted form data as JSON. AskToolDetails is now { answers: { name, question, answer }[]; timedOut? }; QuestionResult, the "Other", "Chat about this", answer-note and answer-image paths of the tool are removed, and /tree re-answer reopens the original form (NavigateTreeResult.reopenAsk carries html).
Added
  • In Tern, right-clicking an ask answer offers Note, which annotates that answer without picking it (#18551 by @H4vC)
  • task.eager (preferred/always) now shapes only the main agent's system prompt; subagents fall back to their model's own delegation policy instead of being pushed to spawn further subagents
  • ask forms can show pictures: <img src> from an http(s) URL, a data: URI or a local file (relative to the session's working directory), and inline <svg> diagrams, drawn in the terminal form and natively in Tern
  • ask forms give every radio and checkbox group a free-text "Other" answer: its text is the radio's value or is appended to the checkbox group's array (field-by-field fallback, collab guests and ACP elicitation included)
  • Extension UI gains optional ui.formDialog(html, options), which renders an HTML <form> and resolves to { data, timedOut? } (undefined when cancelled). The interactive TUI renders it as a form dialog, ACP clients with form elicitation get one elicitation with a property per field, and hosts without it (RPC) answer the ask tool field by field through select/input/editor.
  • Eval cells can run shell commands with sh: sh("git status") in Python, await sh`ls ${dir}` or await sh("make", { cwd }) in JavaScript. Commands run on the embedded bash engine to completion (never auto-backgrounded), return their output, and raise ShellError with the exit code on failure.
  • omp zsh on Windows runs omp's builtin utilities (ls, cat, head, jq, …) for commands PATH does not have, unless a command_not_found_handler handles them (#18532 by @H4vC).
Changed
  • Clarified tool and internal-URL descriptions for history:// concise transcripts, proc:// job retention and parked-agent lookups, and read JSON query text output (#18553 by @xiangnan0811)
  • Models without a delegation rule (Claude, Gemini, …) no longer get pushed to delegate: the "map unknown code via task" rule and the "Task + scout" nudges in search tool descriptions are replaced by a light suggestion to explore unfamiliar subsystems with a scout
  • In Tern, clicking an ask answer and then Note now annotates the answer highlighted on the question shown instead of the one just clicked (#18551 by @H4vC)
Fixed
  • Fixed ask notes added with n right after picking an answer landing on the previous question instead of the one shown; a Tern click then Note still notes the answer just clicked, and the Note button names it (#18317 by @DonMikone)
  • Fixed /export failing on Windows when saving in the current directory, including relative paths such as sub/../session.html; the export message now shows the full path of the written file (#18369, #18525 by @minhngoc25a).
  • Todo initialization now names empty phases Tasks, so subsequent updates can address them (#18552 by @xiangnan0811)
  • omp zsh and the bash tool on Windows: background commands without job control ignore Ctrl-C (INT, and QUIT in zsh) as zsh and bash do, so the console's Ctrl-C leaves them running (#18532 by @H4vC).
  • omp zsh finds the system zsh's function library (compinit loads) on Debian, Ubuntu and Arch, and on Windows from an MSYS2, Cygwin or Git for Windows zsh (#18532 by @H4vC).
  • omp zsh on Windows: typed commands no longer end in ^M, programs are found through Path, piped scripts run every line, cd takes C:\…/C:/…, .. and ~ (keeping $PWD as C:/…), >/dev/null works, the prompt is % rather than root's #, $OSTYPE is msys, and no USERNAME warning is printed (#18532 by @H4vC).
  • omp zsh on Windows edits lines with ZLE (history, Tab completion, key bindings, $COLUMNS); Ctrl-C abandons the line, runs an INT trap, or interrupts a read that then goes on, instead of ending the shell (#18532 by @H4vC).
  • omp zsh on Windows: Ctrl-C interrupts the foreground program, jobs, fg and bg work (a job brought back with fg gets Ctrl-C too), and process substitution reaches Windows programs (diff <(…) <(…), prog >(…)) (#18532 by @H4vC).
  • On Windows, /dev/null works in the bash tool (>/dev/null, cat /dev/null, [ -c /dev/null ]) (#18532 by @H4vC).
  • On Windows, /dev/tty opens the console in omp zsh and the bash tool (prog >/dev/tty), and an MSYS or Cygwin program killed by Ctrl-C reports status 130 instead of 512 (#18532 by @H4vC).
  • omp zsh prints the [n] pid line for a background pipeline under job control, as it does for a single command (#18532 by @H4vC).
  • omp zsh starts compinit many times faster: single array and association elements are assigned and read without copying the whole parameter, and autoload -r no longer re-reads the .zwc digests in $fpath for every function it resolves (#18533 by @H4vC).
  • omp zsh's read -k and read -q read a key from the terminal without waiting for Enter, as zsh does, instead of reading standard input (#18533 by @H4vC).
  • omp zsh completion listings mark file types again (dir/, exe*

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.18.2
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Added Added canReplayRemoteCompactionFrom() to determine whether a model can replay provider-native compaction produced by another model. Fixed Fixed GenAI message-content capture configured in omp's own .env files so it continues to…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added
  • Added canReplayRemoteCompactionFrom() to determine whether a model can replay provider-native compaction produced by another model.
Fixed
  • Fixed GenAI message-content capture configured in omp's own .env files so it continues to apply when those values are no longer exposed through the process environment.
  • Fixed compaction preparation for remote OpenAI compaction that the active model cannot replay, ensuring the content is expanded and remains available for compaction.
  • Fixed generic remote compaction requests to /chat/completions so gateway sessions retain the correct per-request model attribution.

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added edit execution context support for Cursor handlers, allowing integrations to identify frames that materialize native file edits and detect when server-side edits have settled.
  • Exported Responses replay utilities so callers can determine which turns are sent as native payload items when estimating or trimming context.
Fixed
  • Fixed rotated credential pools reporting a stale sibling credential's authentication error instead of the exhausted credential's usage-limit status and reset time.
  • Fixed OpenAI image edits with multiple input images failing because image parameters were duplicated.
  • Fixed Cursor-provider reads of xd:// devices failing due to incorrect device URL handling.
  • Fixed Anthropic sessions getting stuck after refused turns containing thinking or redacted-thinking blocks when followed by a steer, reminder, or new prompt.
  • Fixed Codex Responses requests losing tool namespaces and developer-provided additional tools when replayed through the authentication gateway.
  • Fixed Gemini malformed responses being treated as unhandled stop reasons and losing token usage; they are now handled as transient transport errors.
  • Improved Cursor compatibility with TLS-intercepting proxies that block HTTP/2 by falling back to HTTP/1 for subsequent turns.

@oh-my-pi/browser-relay

Added
  • The browser extension now requests Chrome’s downloads permission so relay tabs can report where downloads were saved to omp.

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Fixed
  • Fixed model catalog pricing and output-limit metadata for Mistral alias IDs, including the Mistral Vibe CLI default model, by applying the metadata of their aliased models.
  • Updated xAI Grok 4.20 beta and multi-agent aliases to use the current Grok 4.20-0309 pricing, including the higher rates for prompts exceeding 200K tokens.

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Breaking Changes
  • logoutCredential() now accepts an AgentSession instead of a model registry and session ID. Hosts must install a scoped-model refresher with AgentSession.setScopedModelsRefresher(); InteractiveMode and InteractiveModeContext no longer accept refreshScopedModelsAfterLogin.
  • SessionStorage.hasAssistantTurn() is replaced by the optional scanLines(path, visit), which session listings use to recover both a missed assistant record and a first prompt past the 4 KB head; custom storages that implemented hasAssistantTurn() must implement scanLines() instead.
Added
  • The shell's ls builtin supports macOS/BSD -O: a long listing gains the file-flags column (hidden, compressed, uchg, restricted, …) instead of rejecting the option, so ls -lO works and flags are visible again.
  • The shell ships sd as a builtin, so sd FIND REPLACE [FILES]… find-and-replace (regex or -F literal, in place or -p preview) works without the binary installed.
  • Added omp gc --strip (or gc.strip), which removes provider replay data (thinking signatures, encrypted reasoning, cached native responses, request controls) from sessions idle for gc.stripAfterDays (default 30, --strip-after-days), including subagent and archived transcripts; stripped sessions still resume on any model.
Changed
  • The sloppy edit tool (*** Find/*** Replace) now rejects only the operations that fail to match and applies the rest, including across files; the result lists each rejected operation against the file as written, and the call fails only when no file changes. Payloads that do not parse still apply nothing.
  • A bash call that overlaps another one (parallel calls, or a call while one runs in the background) now runs in a copy of the session shell, so it sees the session's variables, functions, options, and working directory from before the other command; what it sets still does not persist.
  • The ./c continue shortcut now interrupts a running turn and continues it, in the main session and in focused subagent views, instead of failing with "Agent is already processing" or doing nothing.
  • Updated system prompts with the ⁂ section marker and improved task completion guidance, including proportional verification, efficient file reading, batching independent operations, and stopping after changes are verified.
  • Added faster isolated-subagent startup for ovnfs-backed checkouts, while preserving the existing baseline behavior for repositories with nested repositories or submodules.
  • Improved extension and plugin management: /extensions now lists and toggles extensions from configured extension packages and installed plugins, and marketplace sources resolve relative and bare-name paths consistently with Claude Code.
  • Scoped model lists now refresh after logout, model-catalog refreshes, and RPC login or logout, so available models stay synchronized with authentication and provider changes.
  • Added source actions to LSP code_actions, including actions such as Organize Imports, with application by title or index.
  • Browser automation now supports downloads from relay tabs and broader role/ selectors for implicit landmarks and structural roles.
  • Improved skill and session workflows: skills created or installed during a session become immediately discoverable, and user-attributed custom messages that start a turn receive the appropriate prompt setup.
  • Validated security findings now display validation status, timestamp, and summary information.
  • Dual-mode language servers retain pushed diagnostics alongside pull diagnostics, preserving build and lint errors across edits.
  • Improved session navigation and reliability when switches, forks, branches, context resets, or new sessions overlap; requests are processed in order without freezing or misrouting messages.
  • Improved eval and interactive execution behavior, including preservation of JavaScript state and output across asynchronous failures, clearer startup and runtime errors, and better reporting when kernels or runtimes terminate.
  • Parent-to-subagent messages now appear as IRC cards in live and Agent Hub transcripts.
  • Paused agent turns can allow the machine to sleep at safe boundaries and restore sleep prevention when resumed.
  • Improved JSON-mode shutdown handling so final tool events and buffered output are preserved.
  • Improved task efficiency and responsiveness for isolated subagents, file search, browser guidance on Linux/X11, and long-running or cancellable operations.
  • Updated the tui.mouse setting documentation to accurately describe wheel-scrolling behavior.
  • mnemopi.dbPath values beginning with ~ now resolve relative to the home directory.
  • Disabling the Codex provider now prevents its configuration from overriding omp settings, and providers can be disabled without applying their other settings.
  • omp gc now shows a progress bar for each slow step (listing and scanning sessions, scanning transcripts for blob refs, archiving) on interactive terminals.
  • omp gc --strip and --compress start work immediately instead of first reading every session's metadata, and --strip processes several sessions at once with a running tally of transcripts stripped.
  • omp gc without --apply now says up front that it is a dry run.
Fixed
  • Fixed omp --resume showing (no messages)

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-ai Fixed Cursor exec frames keep tool-batch order: a file mutation (native StrReplace and Write, write, delete, pi_edit, pi_write) waits for the calls issued before it, and the calls issued after it wait until it lands, so a Shell sent in the same…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed
  • Cursor exec frames keep tool-batch order: a file mutation (native StrReplace and Write, write, delete, pi_edit, pi_write) waits for the calls issued before it, and the calls issued after it wait until it lands, so a Shell sent in the same batch as a StrReplace no longer runs before the edit's write (#18434 by @KadirBerkpolat1)
  • ChatGPT Pro Max (promax) counts as Pro for Codex account routing, so a blocked Pro account no longer wins over an open or pinned Pro Max account (#18399 by @serverinspector)
  • Cursor Shell results no longer end with Timeout clamped to 3600s (requested 86400s; …): Cursor's 24 h hard_timeout is capped at the bash tool's 3600 s ceiling before it reaches the tool (#18433 by @KadirBerkpolat1)
  • A 429 or 402 worded like a context overflow (Bedrock's "429 Too many tokens, please wait…") is treated as a rate limit, so it retries and walks the fallback chain instead of compacting (#18345 by @nick-maderight)
  • auth-gateway stdio and serve no longer reject credentialless Apple on-device models (#18370)

@oh-my-pi/browser-relay

Changed
  • The extension now requests scripting and access to all sites (Chrome lists "Read and change all your data on all websites"); it uses them only to empty another extension's frames in a tab omp is driving, when Chrome refuses it the debugger there (#16908 by @will-bogusz)
Fixed
  • Fixed a password manager's inline autofill menu locking omp out of a tab it drives: the extension empties and hides such frames in that tab and retries the attach or command Chrome refused (#16908 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Fixed
  • Corrected Devin SWE-2 Flash and SWE-2 Fast token pricing, and SWE-2's promotional rates and end time (#18332 by @eggpeat)
  • DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ids spelled with a hyphen (deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017 on Mistral and Venice) keep image attachments instead of being stripped to text-only (#18405)
  • compat.disabledThinking in models.yml now applies to anthropic-messages models, so a custom Anthropic provider can switch thinking off when Off is selected (#18412 by @farnoy)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Breaking Changes
  • Rust SDK: BashCommand and ReadyEvent struct literals need exclude_from_context: None and supports_bash_exclude_from_context: None (#18206 by @andrebrait)
Added
  • RPC bash accepts excludeFromContext: true to keep a run out of model context like terminal !!; runtimes advertise support with supportsBashExcludeFromContext in the ready frame, and the Python SDK exposes that frame as client.ready (#18206 by @andrebrait)
Changed
  • Agent bash commands run with LANG/LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 on every platform instead of the inherited locale, so sort order, number formats and tool messages no longer vary by machine; a locale in the command's env or .envrc still wins, and ! commands keep yours
  • omp's built-in shell (omp bash/omp zsh and the bash tool) parses scripts about a third faster, sources large function libraries about 20% faster, and re-runs a repeated eval or source without recompiling it.
  • The computer tool's el.perform() takes any spelling of an action ax() lists (perform("open")), and computer.backgroundFallback: refuse refuses every spelling of a raise, open, context menu or popup press (#15282 by @will-bogusz)
  • The computer tool no longer takes over your screen for a macOS win.drag across the text of a native text view, such as a TextEdit document; it selects that text in the background and returns the selection (#16223 by @will-bogusz)
Fixed
  • A browser relay tab stays usable after a password manager's inline autofill menu opens in it; the call that opened the menu still fails once (reinstall the extension with omp browser-relay install and reload it) (#16908 by @will-bogusz)
  • A %%bash cell in Python eval no longer prints its exit status (a stray 0) after the command's output; a failing cell reports %%bash: exit status N on stderr instead.
  • Reusing an already running omp stats dashboard now exits successfully without stopping the existing server (#18443).
  • A function defined inside a command substitution in a here-document body (cat <<E / $(f() { …; }; f) / E) no longer crashes the built-in shell.
  • A Cursor tool call sent in the same batch as a native StrReplace or Write no longer runs before the edit is written, so a check right after an edit sees the new file (#18434 by @KadirBerkpolat1)
  • Pinned sessions color their pin icon with the theme accent in the status line and the band composer's title instead of taking the title's color or dim style, matching the resume picker (#18401 by @SuperUserA)
  • An ovnfs checkout stays recoverable with omp worktree clear when removing it fails, or when creating it fails after the daemon may already have it, instead of being forgotten (#18337 by @eggpeat)
  • A retain call that fails midway no longer delivers part of itself to the Hindsight server while telling the model nothing was queued (#18440 by @eggpeat)
  • A bash.patterns deny rule now blocks a command anywhere in a ;, |, || or && line even when an earlier prompt rule matches another part of it, and project settings can no longer override the operator's deny or prompt patterns with allow (#18349 by @asuffield)
  • A subagent stopped by the session cost cap (--max-cost / session.maxCost) now reports the cap's refusal instead of "Subagent ended without a final message" (#18362)
  • ERB templates open in ruby-lsp as erb, so valid templates no longer report dozens of bogus Ruby errors, and a diagnostics pull ruby-lsp answers with null

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.18.0
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog Fixed Fixed Mistral discovery listing embedding, OCR, moderation, transcription, and speech models as chat models; only rows with capabilities.completion_chat are offered, with context, image input, and reasoning read from the row (#18244…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Fixed
  • Fixed Mistral discovery listing embedding, OCR, moderation, transcription, and speech models as chat models; only rows with capabilities.completion_chat are offered, with context, image input, and reasoning read from the row (#18244 by @VeigaPunk)
  • A failed refresh no longer replaces a cached catalog whose models carry request headers with an empty snapshot; the next launch refetches it instead (#18227)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Fixed
  • Fixed transcript output freezing after provider restarts or switching sessions mid-stream (#18358 by @JustasMasiulis)
  • Bash tool cards for a command whose leading cd <dir> && / cd <dir>; was hoisted into the working directory show that cd again above the visualized command, with the separator the model wrote, instead of dropping where it ran
  • Bash commands starting with cd <dir>; ... now run in <dir> as their working directory when it exists, so its direnv environment loads and the directory shows on the tool card (#18329 by @harshaygadekar)
  • Task-file approvals show and keep the checked file target through dispatch, so retargeted symlinks cannot silently substitute another assignment; replaced files require a retry (#18314 by @iliaal).
  • Subagents receive task instructions with their blank lines, Markdown hard breaks, and table spacing intact, whether given inline or via taskFile.
  • Hindsight retain and learn memories are no longer lost when delivery fails or omp exits: they are kept on disk, retried, and delivered by the next session without duplicates (#18176 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed the session crashing with Native shell returned an invalid execution trace when a bash command assigned a long value containing multi-byte characters such as Chinese text (#18259)
  • grep -e and rg -e in the bash tool accept patterns that start with - (e.g. grep -e "--canary") instead of failing with an unknown-option error.
  • The bash execution visualization keeps updating, and saved traces still restore, after a command handles bytes that aren't valid UTF-8 (e.g. v=$(printf '\377'))
  • On Windows, grep, glob and isolated subagents no longer flash a console window when they query or start the ovnfs daemon.
  • A bash command containing a bare [ (e.g. a && [ while still streaming) no longer crashes omp in the Pseudo shell visualization (#18320)
  • Fixed a prompt that mentions an internal-scheme URL with @ (e.g. @local://x, @vault://x) aborting the run with "uses internal scheme ... not as a filesystem path"; such a mention is now left as plain text (#16071)
  • Fixed MCP OAuth login and token refresh failing with JSON Parse error: Unexpected identifier "access_token" against GitHub's token endpoint (#18292)
  • MCP OAuth requests tokens for the MCP server's own resource (from its protected-resource metadata) instead of a different resource advertised by the authorization server, fixing 401 invalid_token after /mcp reauth on servers such as Firecrawl's hosted MCP (#18315)
  • Concurrent subagent MCP calls now grant newly loaded tools to the session that made each call, even when providers reuse call IDs. (#18324 by @eggpeat)
  • LSP document symbols now show identifier lines, so those lines work with references, definition, and rename (#18257).
  • Subagents on worker threads no longer fail with Cannot send … instance across threads when their model comes from an extension-registered provider with its own streamSimple (#18310 by @Dangerboi)
  • ⌘V in terminals with kitty enhanced paste (OSC 5522, e.g. Ghostty 1.4) now attaches macOS TIFF screenshots instead of reporting "Clipboard paste has no supported text or image data" (#17696, #18203 by @roboomp)
  • Disabling display.shellVisualization now omits bash execution traces from tool updates and saved sessions, including in ACP (#18267).
  • /quit and /exit no longer wait several seconds for an unresponsive OTLP telemetry collector (#18255).
  • Cancelling a Python eval cell right as it starts now stops the cell cleanly instead of letting it run and killing the kernel (#18242 by @eggpeat)
  • Browser open now returns the same tab with a recovery notice when Chrome detaches the relay during navigation and omp successfully reattaches, instead of failing the open and closing newly opened tabs (#18252 by @will-bogusz)
  • tab.errors() keeps the fields of plain-object and other non-Error rejections, bounded like console arguments, instead of reporting only Object (#16959) (#18251 by @Alex-Wengg)
  • An extension provider with authHeader: true keeps its cached fetchDynamicModels catalog when omp models refresh fails, instead of showing 0 models until the next successful forced refresh (#18227)
  • A session whose request carries no titleable text of its own — an attached @brief.md, a greeting, a bare number — is now named once from the assistant's reading of it, instead of staying untitled until the next message that happens to be titleable (which, for an agent launched from one brief and left to run, never came) (#18238 by @sjawhar)
  • Prewalk no longer hands a subagent to its cheap model when the subagent messages its parent or another agent (write agent://…) before its first file edit (#18322 by @1vivy)

@oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

Fixed
  • Fixed embedding rebuilds failing on hosted APIs that cap the inputs per request: embed() now splits large lists into requests of at most MNEMOPI_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE texts (default 64; set 10 for DashScope) or the embeddings.batchSize runtime option, and returns null when the API returns a different number of vectors than texts (#18278 by @aleister1102)

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Added Added Agent.queuedMessageGate to filter queued messages before delivery and observe claimed messages returned undelivered. Added wireToolsFingerprint(), returning a hash of the tool specs sent with a request. @oh-my-pi/pi-ai Added…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added
  • Added Agent.queuedMessageGate to filter queued messages before delivery and observe claimed messages returned undelivered.
  • Added wireToolsFingerprint(), returning a hash of the tool specs sent with a request.

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added opt-in standard Responses WebSockets for catalog-supported models, with incremental turns and automatic HTTP/SSE fallback; enable through OMP settings (#17354 by @TatsukiMeng)
  • AuthStorage can now be constructed over an AuthStorageBackend instead of a credential store, so another thread's instance can serve every call
  • Anthropic official-API sessions use message threads, sending only new messages per turn for faster first tokens; toggle with statefulResponses: false or PI_ANTHROPIC_MESSAGE_THREADS=0/1
  • Added devin-cli (Devin CLI seat key) and devin-windsurf (Windsurf Enterprise sign-in) logins, both stored as a devin API key (#13637 by @pavel-kalmykov, #13288 by @pavel-kalmykov)
  • Factory Droid Gemini 4 Argon requests now match Droid's request and conversation handling (#17861 by @will-bogusz)
Changed
  • Changing the Codex ultrafast service tier now opens a connection for the selected tier, so requests route correctly
  • Factory Droid requests and login now match the current Droid client
  • Codex HTTP requests (turns, compaction, image generation, web search, model discovery) no longer send OpenAI-Beta: responses=experimental, matching the official Codex client
Fixed
  • Fixed account switching stopping at rate-limited accounts; other eligible stored accounts are now tried first
  • Fixed OpenRouter Decisions judges ignoring compat.openRouterRouting and compat.extraBody, including @provider pins (#18140)
  • OAuth broker now validates residency, inference-region, and selected-organization metadata in uploaded credentials and remote snapshots
  • Fixed Muse Code subscription sessions failing with 403 client_attestation_denied when tools were available (#17435, #17515 by @harshav167, continued in #18053 by @abilliontokens)
  • Fixed xai-tts failing with 422 missing field language; language now defaults to auto (#17992 by @Mirceone)
  • Fixed Codex WebSocket turns sending malformed incremental input after reconnects or onPayload edits, and prewarming busy sockets (#17809 by @xiangnan0811)
  • API-key logins now store keys under the auth rule's store-as provider (#13637 by @pavel-kalmykov)
  • Fixed openai-responses, Codex, and Muse Code continuations after an output limit cut a tool call, including reasoning-first models (#17847, #18189 by @mttzzz)
  • Gemini and Vertex malformed-response finishes now report the correct stop reason and keep token usage; RPC prompt errors are reported as retryable
  • Fixed reranking when Cohere-compatible responses omit the model field
  • Reranking requests now send configured model headers, including custom Authorization
  • Provider retries no longer retry responses explicitly marked non-retryable

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added tool-name-prefix compat axis for Responses hosts that reject certain tool names; Muse Code sets it to _ (#17435, #17515 by @harshav167, continued in #18053 by @abilliontokens)
  • Added supports-message-threads compat axis (supportsMessageThreads), enabled for Claude 4.5+ on first-party Anthropic
  • Added opt-in Responses WebSocket capability via OMP settings or SDK preferences, off by default (#17354 by @TatsukiMeng)
  • Added Factory Droid Gemini 4 Argon on Global inference for accounts with the feature flag (#17861 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added Factory Droid Muse Spark 1.3 (Global region, muse_spark_1_3 flag) with low to xhigh effort (#17862 by @will-bogusz)
Changed
  • Updated Factory Droid client version reporting; improved tool-input streaming for Claude via Azure Foundry
Fixed
  • Fixed newly published Azure models missing after catalog refresh (#18173, #18174 by @dunkpi)
  • Fixed Factory Droid hiding models when the live-routing family default yields no usable upstream; explicit empty per-model routes still hide them (#17862 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Bash commands, foreground and background, now show a live execution visualization in Raw or Python-like Pseudo view, with variable values and replay history; disable with display.shellVisualization (default on).
  • grep and glob inside an ovnfs checkout ask the ovnfs daemon to search the checkout in-process, avoiding per-file mount round trips; the daemon and its mount come from ovnfs --json status when the ovnfs binary is found. They fall back to the native search when the daemon is unavailable or rejects the request, and cancelling the tool cancels the daemon's search. ovnfs with admin protocol 5 is required.
  • Added skills.manualSkills glob patterns to hide skills from the model catalog while keeping them manually invocable (#18114 by @Shadorain)
  • Added Keenable web search (web/keenable), using KEENABLE_API_KEY or a stored keenable credential, or a keyless public endpoint when explicitly selected (#17953 by @KGKallasmaa)
  • web_search results list failed providers with reason and status code in details.failures (#18124 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added opt-in background auto-update (update.auto, offered in setup) that installs new releases via your install method and runs them next launch; skipped on Nix, source checkouts, and Tern.
  • omp update refuses to run while another update (including auto-update) is installing.
  • Added none to edit.mode (and PI_EDIT_VARIANT) to remove the edit tool; bash stays available even if bash.enabled is off.

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Changed Deprecated createFileOps, computeFileLists, formatFileOperations, upsertFileOperations, isUrlSchemePath and FileOperations in @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core/compaction; they now re-export @oh-my-pi/snapcompact, which callers should…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Changed
  • Deprecated createFileOps, computeFileLists, formatFileOperations, upsertFileOperations, isUrlSchemePath and FileOperations in @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core/compaction; they now re-export @oh-my-pi/snapcompact, which callers should import directly
Fixed
  • Context estimates for a model without a known tokenizer family (Gemini, Grok and the like), and token counts made without a model (compress metrics, the legacy estimateTokens export), count text in o200k_base instead of guessing 4 bytes per token, which undercounted what those providers bill by 11–48% on code-heavy sessions and let compaction fire late after a switch to them (#17607 by @will-bogusz)
  • Context estimates no longer charge a reader another model's thinking signatures or redacted thinking, which the request strips: a Claude session switched to Grok or Gemini, including Gemini through Factory, counted them as text (#17607 by @will-bogusz)
Removed
  • Removed PI_TOKENIZER_ACCURATE: every model is now counted with a native tokenizer (#17607 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • /login mistral signs in through the browser like the Mistral Vibe CLI and stores the minted API key, whose usage counts against the plan's Vibe Code quota instead of pay-as-you-go API credits; MISTRAL_API_KEY still works (#13875 by @Gauthier-Huguenin, continued in #17672 by @abilliontokens)
  • Added dropsForeignReasoningPayload(turn, model), which tells whether transformMessages certainly strips a turn's thinking signatures and redacted thinking on the way to model, and, for Factory Droid's Gemini wire, isFactoryDroidGeminiWire(model) and keepsFactoryGeminiReasoning(turn) (#17607 by @will-bogusz)
  • Factory Droid Beam 1.0 requests accept tool-call turns that arrive without reasoning (#17766 by @will-bogusz)
Changed
  • Deprecated formatError on the embeddings, images, rerank, speech, transcriptions, video, pi-native and SystemOne server modules (now aliases of codedErrorResponse / noStoreErrorResponse in auth-gateway/http) and asStrict in providers/aws-sigv4 (now asStrictBytes from @oh-my-pi/pi-utils)
Fixed
  • Fixed Factory Droid Fable requests offering Opus 5 as the refusal fallback when your organization's model policy excludes Opus 5; Claude requests now offer only fallback models your account can use, and a request served by another organization's login than the one your model list came from offers none (#17772 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • /login mistral now offers the Mistral Vibe browser sign-in beside MISTRAL_API_KEY (#13875 by @Gauthier-Huguenin, continued in #17672 by @abilliontokens)
  • Added revisionAtLeast to compat/revision and exported withOpenAICompatibleDiscoveryTimeout from discovery/openai-compatible
  • Added the Factory Droid models droid 1.1.0 serves: GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-6 Sol and Luna Fast Mode, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra Fast (after the organization's high-cost opt-in), Nemotron 3.5 Super, Muse Spark Open, Muse Spark 1.2 and Beam 1.0, each listed once the account may use it (#17766 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added Factory Droid's dated credit rates: the credit rate follows Factory's promotions, discounted from a promotion's start and back to the base rate at its end, using the same dated rate cards as dollar prices (currently GPT-5.6 Sol and Gemini 3.7/3.8 Flash) (#16309 by @will-bogusz)
Changed
  • Factory Droid lists Opus 5.5 Fast, GPT-6.1 Sol and MiniMax M3 without the feature flags Factory retired, and no longer routes GPT-5.5 to Snowflake (#17766 by @will-bogusz)
  • Factory Droid Opus 5.5 now falls back to Opus 5 when Anthropic refuses a request, as droid does, while your account can use Opus 5 (#17772 by @will-bogusz)
Fixed
  • GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 (Turbo) resolve the cl100k tokenizer, so their context estimates count in cl100k_base rather than the o200k_base default for models without one (#17607 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added Scaleway Generative APIs as a built-in provider with 12 serverless chat models (glm-5.3 default), API-key login, and live model discovery (#16687 by @reda-maizate)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • With the Hindsight memory backend, retain and learn can now store a memory with scope: "global" so every project recalls it. It is opt-in through the new hindsight.globalScope setting (off by default) and needs global or per-project-tagged scoping (#17706 by @alphastorm, from #15030 by @kithawk).
  • Added btw.inject (off by default; /settings → Interaction → "/btw Steering Inject"): when you ask /btw for a steering prompt, it drafts one in an <inject> block shown behind a pink rail, and Alt+I (app.btw.inject) sends it to the main session (as a steer while the agent runs, else as a new turn) from the inline answer or the BTW history sheet, once per answer from the current run. Once sent, the block turns green with ➤ on each line and "Injected into main session" below it; if the main session drops or refuses the send, the block turns back to pending and the same key retries (#17618 by @apullin)
  • With OTLP metrics export configured (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT), composer predictions export content-free omp.composer.prediction.* metrics by serving model: requests by outcome (offered, skipped, stale, cancelled, timeout, error) with their duration, predictions shown (counted on the first frame that paints them), shown predictions by whether they were accepted with Tab or Right, and the time from first display to acceptance (#17739 by @wolfiesch)
  • Bash results the output minimizer rewrote now keep which filter ran and the bytes before and after in the session, and the bash card shows them (Minimized: git 120.4KB → 3.2KB) (#16586 by @will-bogusz)
  • Eval completion handles expose attempts (JS await handle.attempts()
