items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Fixed Fixed OpenAI remote compaction (/responses/compact) replaying backend-only internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough metadata that Codex rejects as an unknown parameter (#17590 by @briankeefe) @oh-my-pi/pi-ai Fixed Fixed Codex…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Fixed
  • Fixed OpenAI remote compaction (/responses/compact) replaying backend-only internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough metadata that Codex rejects as an unknown parameter (#17590 by @briankeefe)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed
  • Fixed Codex conversation replay failing with an unknown internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough.content_token_count parameter by omitting backend-internal response metadata from replayed input (#17590, #17597 by @briankeefe).
  • Fixed service_tier: "ultrafast" being dropped for OpenAI-family models on custom providers even when the model's serviceTiers lists it (#17577 by @jakehemmerle)
  • Fixed Google Vertex requests with Workforce Identity Federation ADC failing token refresh against the wrong endpoint (#17447).
  • Fixed Anthropic (and other rotating-token) OAuth accounts being signed out automatically when a background usage poll's token refresh got invalid_grant, including refreshes a client delegates to an auth broker; usage polling no longer disables credentials, so only a real request's refresh can do that (#17468)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added Modular Cloud (modular) as a provider: /login modular with an API key, models and prices from the models.dev modular entry, and per-model reasoning controls for MiniMax M3.1 Flash, MiniMax M3, and Gemma 4 31B (#17334 by @tommyjtl)
  • SambaNova Cloud follow-up turns now reuse the provider's prefix cache, so multi-turn conversations stop re-processing earlier context (#17555 by @rjuez00)
Fixed
  • Fixed newly discovered OpenAI-compatible models ignoring provider-reported context and output token limits (#17561 by @wolfiesch)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Long or multi-step background shell commands get a one-line caption saying what they do and when they end, written once per job by the widget model role when the job, after running 15 seconds, is shown in a live widget or listed by /jobs full; the jobs sheet and /jobs full show it under the job's purpose. It follows the Live Job Widgets setting (async.widgets), and CreateAgentSessionOptions.jobCaptionWriter replaces the model call (#17649 by @wolfiesch)
Changed
  • In a source checkout, the error for a missing HTML export viewer now names the script that builds it, packages/collab-web/scripts/build-export-viewer.ts, beside bun gen:export-viewer (#17636 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed an eval cell running silently on a new kernel after the session's Python kernel or JS worker died between cells (a crash, a kill, an out-of-memory kill, or a cancelled JS cell): the first cell on the replacement now carries Kernel restarted: … state is unavailable. Re-run needed setup ahead of its own output, instead of failing with a bare NameError on a variable an earlier cell set (#17595 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed a task worker messaged (write agent://<id>) while still starting up running on the shared context alone and never receiving its tasks[].task assignment; the message now waits for the assignment's turn (#17587)
  • lsp reload now discovers Rust crates created after rust-analyzer started, so hover and other analysis work without restarting omp (#17658).
  • A model without image input (GLM, DeepSeek, Grok Composer and the like) reads a snapcompact archive's full kept text instead of image-omitted placeholders for its frames, after a model switch, on resume and in side requests (#17510 by @will-bogusz)
  • Snapcompact no longer refuses a new archive as "would not reduce context" when it shrinks a session that already holds one (/compact snapcompact, idle and pre-prompt compaction) (#17490 by @will-bogusz)
  • A failed /compact snapcompact now reports its reason once instead of twice, and names the /compact mode to run instead (#17490 by @will-bogusz)
  • Background bash and eval jobs now carry the purpose the model gave for the call: /jobs, /jobs full, proc:// listings, wait and job results, and the jobs HUD hover lead with it ahead of the raw command line (#17649 by @wolfiesch)
  • The seance guidance in the task tool and the archive docs now say that a question about an earlier session is answered by the seance agent, and that reading the session's raw JSONL belongs to narrow mechanical checks only, so a consult is no longer duplicated by transcript reads and re-run checks (#17523 by @iacore)
Fixed
  • A prompt on a model whose provider has no usable credential (logged out, refresh token expired, or an auth broker holding none) now switches to the first retry.fallbackChains candidate that has one instead of failing with "No API key found", and switches back on the first prompt after the credential returns (#17559 by @wolfiesch)
  • Fixed background results arriving during manual /compact starting turns on stale history or disappearing from the saved session (#17599).
  • Fixed isolated tasks on fuse-overlayfs leaving their overlay mounted and the fuse-overlayfs daemon running when the unmount hit a transient "Device or resource busy"; a failed unmount now reports fusermount's error and keeps the workspace for omp worktree clear instead of deleting its layers under the live mount (#17644)
  • Usage-limit retries now count system sleep toward the quota-reset deadline instead of re-arming the remaining uptime delay after the countdown reaches zero (#17606 by @zhiland).
  • Fixed role assignments to a models.yml model whose id differs only by case from a bundled model of the same provider (such as xiaomi/MiMo-V2.6-Pro beside xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro) silently staying unset (#17580)
  • Fixed Eval's direct browser wait helpers (tab.waitForSelector, tab.waitForText, …) giving up after 29 s when passed a longer { timeout }; the requested timeout is now honored up to the browser tool's 300 s cap (#17617)
  • Fixed browser.open

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Added The soft steering signal a tool sees as toolCall.steeringSignal now aborts with the source of the queued message ("user", "irc", …) as its reason, so a tool can yield only to the sources it should (#17537) Fixed Reject incomplete…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added
  • The soft steering signal a tool sees as toolCall.steeringSignal now aborts with the source of the queued message ("user", "irc", …) as its reason, so a tool can yield only to the sources it should (#17537)
Fixed
  • Reject incomplete local compaction, turn-prefix, handoff, and branch summaries ending with stopReason: "length" instead of using truncated text as complete context. Omit incomplete display-only short summaries without discarding a completed full summary (#17499 by @Xytronix).

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Breaking Changes
  • Replaced isLoopGuardedModel with loopGuardLevel, which returns "off", "exact", or "semantic" from the model's thinking-loop-guard catalog rule
Added
  • Added disableServerSideFallback to FactoryDroidOptions and SimpleStreamOptions: a Factory Droid request leaves out the server-side refusal fallback chain and fails, before any of its content is streamed, if another model answers it (#12229 by @Xytronix)
Changed
  • DeepSeek and Grok models on Amazon Bedrock now get the same near-duplicate reasoning-loop checks as on other hosts
Fixed
  • Fixed Claude turns failing with "Thinking loop detected" when summarized thinking repeated a progress line such as "Still writing the parser..."; Claude models no longer run the loop guard
  • Fixed the loop guard discarding turns from other models whose reasoning summary repeats one status line a few times; whole-line repetition now has to cover about 1 KB before it counts as a loop
  • Fixed per-request OpenAI-compatible headers being combined with differently cased model headers instead of overriding them (#17513 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed a stalled Anthropic stream that keeps sending empty content deltas never timing out, because those deltas were treated as stream progress (#17484 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed Anthropic-compatible endpoints that put a thinking signature on the streamed content block losing it, so replayed reasoning keeps its signed block (#17483 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed AuthStorage.close() and replaceStore() losing a rotated OAuth refresh token when a refresh was still in flight, with or without durable refresh leases; the store now stays open until that token is saved, and new refreshes are refused (#17518)
  • Fixed /usage showing Cursor's "Other Models" meter as an inflated dollar amount; it now shows the percentage Cursor reports, like Cursor Models (#17462 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed the omp auth-gateway Responses endpoint rejecting documented null values for temperature, top_p, output limits, reasoning, and reasoning summaries (#17466 by @Xytronix).
  • Fixed provider HTTP errors printing the response body twice when the thrown error already carried it, including responses with a retry header (#17503 by @metaphoric-dev)
  • Fixed Gemini tool calls through the omp auth-gateway chat-completions endpoint failing on the next turn: the gateway now returns each call's thought signature in extra_content and replays the one a client sends back (#17509 by @justdoGIT)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Breaking Changes
  • Removed thinkingLoopGuard from compat records; thinking-loop-guard is now a catalog axis that applies on every host, with "semantic" for Gemini, DeepSeek, and Grok and "off" for Claude
Fixed
  • Fixed GitHub Copilot Claude 5.x base models (claude-opus-5, claude-opus-5.5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-sonnet-5.5) reporting the 1M window of their -1m variants once the model list was read from cache; discovered limits now survive cached reads instead of reverting to bundled values (#17481)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Added task.perCallModel (off by default, eval, on) so a task item or an eval agent()/workpool() call can run on one exact model the operator already names: a chat role from your own (non-project) settings, the selected agent's own model, or the parent's current model. Glob values (anthropic/*) never approve a model. task.perCallModelAllow narrows that list, task.maxEffort caps the worker's effort, and the worker never switches to another model. Project settings can only narrow this: they never turn it on or approve a model (#12229 by @Xytronix)
  • Added Settings.reloadFromDisk({ includeParents: true }), which reloads the persisted settings behind an overlay while keeping the overlay's own overrides (#12229 by @Xytronix)
Changed
  • model is now declared in every task schema: a task call, eval agent() or workpool() that passes a model the operator's configuration does not allow is refused with an error (#12229 by @Xytronix)
  • Viewing a subagent or returning to the main session no longer posts a "Viewing agent …" / "Returned to main session" status (a popup in Tern); the status line and Tern's composer already show which agent is in view
  • In a Tern pane, omp stats shows the dashboard in place of the block it runs in, with a Close button (or Esc, or Ctrl+C) that stops it and brings the terminal back, and /stats opens it in a browser block beside omp, instead of the system browser
  • bash tool commands now see PI_TOOL_CALL_ID, the id of the call running them, so a script the agent runs can point at that call in the session transcript (#17489 by @will-bogusz)
  • Native judgments with a configured fallback now move to it after a 3-second candidate deadline (configurable with judgment.attemptTimeoutMs) and briefly skip the timed-out route; without a configured fallback a slow judge is never cut off or replaced (#17465 by @Xytronix).
Fixed
  • Fixed a ! or $ command run while the agent works floating over the composer in Tern, where expanding its output covered the conversation; it now sits at the end of the conversation
  • Fixed out:// replies sent from an eval cell (tool.write to out://, or tool.bash with > out://) never appearing even though the write reported "Shown to the user."; they now draw as replies after the eval card, and are refused where nothing would show them (a backgrounded cell, a browser tab script)
  • Fixed a write to out:// (such as out://baselines.md) drawing as a Write card with line numbers instead of a reply streaming as prose
  • Fixed table charts drawing a ratio or speedup

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Breaking Changes SentToolDefinitions.inactiveFor(messages, tools) is replaced by withInactiveTools(context), which also clears a stale inactiveTools; transformProviderContext now receives the request's inactiveTools (#17492) Fixed Long…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Breaking Changes
  • SentToolDefinitions.inactiveFor(messages, tools) is replaced by withInactiveTools(context), which also clears a stale inactiveTools; transformProviderContext now receives the request's inactiveTools (#17492)
Fixed
  • Long tool-call intents no longer block tool execution when intent tracing is enabled (#13140).

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added the codexAccessPrograms stream option and configureCodexAccessPrograms() process default to turn off the automatic Daybreak Blue access_programs request on Codex (#17508 by @H4vC)
  • Added waitForSibling to RotateCredentialOptions; set it to false to skip the short sibling-unblock wait in limits.rotate() while still blocking the failed credential (#17439 by @wolfiesch)
Changed
  • Cursor runs served through omp auth-gateway are limited to the client's own tools, all advertised as MCP; Cursor's built-in tools (file, shell, edit, todo, web fetch, SCM) are no longer offered on that path (#17382 by @eggpeat)
Fixed
  • Fixed native judgment requests (TypeSafe, OpenRouter Decisions, OpenAI Decisions, Workers AI) sending credentials in their state unredacted while credential redaction was on (#17443)
  • Fixed every new Codex session, including each subagent, losing a response and retrying when the native turn lane refuses live steering; once refused, later sessions on the same account, endpoint, and model queue follow-ups for four hours (#14158, #17438 by @wolfiesch)
  • Fixed Cursor models served through omp auth-gateway being told their file and shell tools were unavailable while the client ran the calls anyway, in Cursor's own argument shape (edits failed validation); each call now reaches the client as one of its own tools and the turn stops with toolUse until the result comes back (#17382 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed Cursor models served through omp auth-gateway being told each tool call was handed off, which left Composer issuing calls blind and answering their results with empty stops; the gateway now keeps the Cursor run open while the client runs a step's calls and answers them in-band with the client's results on its next request (up to 30 minutes; otherwise the turn is rebuilt from history as before) (#17382 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed Anthropic-compatible endpoints behind a relay opening a new connection for every turn: the response body is now drained for up to 2.5 s after message_stop instead of being cancelled, so the kept-alive connection is reused (#17432 by @flosrn)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Changed
  • Clamping a requested thinking effort now resolves through the model's effortMap alias first, so the request lands on the tier the model serves instead of the nearest lower one (#17395 by @Maziar123)
  • Long image-heavy conversations on the official Anthropic API now keep up to 120 MB of inline images before evicting older ones, following the Messages API request limit increase from 32 MB to 128 MB
  • The official Anthropic API now records its 128 MB request limit (request-body-byte-limit), so the newest message's images can use the 8 MB reserve and long text cannot push images past the limit (#17492 by @will-bogusz)
Fixed
  • Fixed Cursor's DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 reporting zero cost; every effort level now bills at Cursor's API rate of $0.30/$1.20 per million tokens, with cache reads at $0.006 (#17390 by @eggpeat)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Added the providers.openai-codex.daybreak setting (default on) to stop omp from automatically requesting the Daybreak Blue cyber access program on eligible ChatGPT accounts; each session follows its own value (#17508 by @H4vC)
  • Added queueable compaction: /compact sent with the follow-up key (Ctrl+Q) while the agent works now runs when it yields instead of interrupting it (#17397 by @H4vC)
  • Added omp session lease [--json] -- <session-id>... and the RPC command get_session_lease, which report which sessions a running omp owns ({"held": [...], "unknown": [...]}) without taking ownership, so another program can check a session without forking it (#17428 by @andrebrait)
  • Added opt-in title.refreshAfterPrompts: every N operator prompts, the judge model checks whether a generated session title still fits the conversation and regenerates it when it does not; user-set titles are never replaced (#17443 by @wolfiesch)
  • Gateway rows discovered from /v1/models now keep the reasoning_effort_map and reasoning_required facts they advertise: a route that serves only low/high/max routes medium to high instead of the nearest lower tier, and a thinking-off request still sends a tier the route accepts (#17395 by @Maziar123)
  • Computer-use scripts can wait for a window opened by an action and read it in the same call with a window filter's optional wait (#17391 by @will-bogusz)
Changed
  • read of a web page keeps the title, description, author and dates of its <meta> tags and lists the others by name only, so pages cost about 6% fewer tokens (#17393 by @will-bogusz)
  • On the Anthropic API, the newest message now keeps all its images up to the 128 MB request limit, past the 120 MB image budget (#17492 by @will-bogusz)
Fixed
  • Fixed account-policy recovery repeatedly rotating through denied credentials instead of surfacing the error or using the configured model fallback, including unnecessary sibling-unblock waits after the account allowance is spent (#17439 by @wolfiesch)
  • Startup prewalk now arms a later fallback candidate of the role named by prewalk.into when its first candidate is unavailable, matching /prewalk and /new (#17373).
  • Fixed omp install git:github.com/user/repo treating git as the host instead of installing the GitHub plugin (#17436).
  • Fixed read

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.14.0
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Breaking Changes Removed the Bun event-loop workaround utilities from @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core/utils/yield; agent loops no longer insert cooperative sleeps while streaming or between tool calls. Added Added…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Breaking Changes
  • Removed the Bun event-loop workaround utilities from @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core/utils/yield; agent loops no longer insert cooperative sleeps while streaming or between tool calls.
Added
  • Added AgentTool.approvalRestrictionPaths so tools can report the paths they read, allowing restricted-folder approvals to cover those paths without remembering approval separately for each path.
  • Added Agent.logContext, which adds custom context fields to every log record written during an agent run.

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Breaking Changes
  • Moved Anthropic header and endpoint helpers, along with Codex session/transport inspection and OpenAI Responses replay/storage helpers, to dedicated provider modules. Update imports from the previous locations.
  • Updated auth-gateway model resolvers to receive ModelResolveOptions, including the route's native API wire and the scoped client's accepted grants. Scoped client IDs no longer fall back to scanning all models; resolvers now select the best permitted candidate.
Added
  • Added mTLS support for Anthropic connections through the CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT and CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY environment variables.
Changed
  • Provider implementations are now loaded on demand, reducing startup and memory overhead while preserving existing stream timeouts, cancellation, and host overrides.
  • Account policy priority now takes precedence when usage information is temporarily unavailable, keeping new sessions on the preferred account.
  • Improved provider-specific credential usage lookups so they no longer wait for unrelated providers, while preserving cache freshness, cancellation isolation, and complete aggregate reports. The corresponding server-side latency improvement requires an updated auth broker.
  • Credential usage is now prefetched during session setup without selecting, pinning, or advancing the OAuth account rotation.
Fixed
  • Fixed Mistral thinking-message replay requests that could be rejected by LiteLLM with a 422 extra_forbidden error.
  • Fixed native Judge API requests missing the omp/<version> User-Agent, so omp usage is correctly identified in upstream statistics.
  • Fixed Codex capacity-error retries over WebSocket and SSE ignoring provider-supplied Retry-After delays and retrying too early.
  • Fixed cancelled OAuth refresh requests aborting the entire session, and ensured requests joining an existing refresh can still use the refreshed credential when the original request is cancelled.
  • Fixed Cursor models losing omp system-prompt context, including context files, skills, and rules, on subsequent turns or when earlier messages precede the active turn.
  • Fixed short-lived commands that refresh OAuth credentials, such as omp token --force-refresh, remaining open for several seconds after completing.
  • Fixed TypeSafe authentication when TYPESAFE_BASE_URL is configured by validating keys against the correct /v1/models endpoint.
  • Fixed forced tool calls on non-reasoning models causing an unhandled reasoning-effort error.
  • Fixed interrupted turns reporting a transport error instead of the caller-provided cancellation reason.
  • Fixed long-running pi-native turns being terminated before their first event by fetch or proxy timeouts by supporting keepalives and the configured first-event timeout.
  • Fixed pi-native clients crashing when the auth gateway reports an upstream failure during streaming.
  • Fixed Cursor turns failing after a mid-turn stream interruption when an automatic retry receives a zero-token provider error; retries now continue on the rotated conversation.
  • Corrected auth-gateway debug logs so they no longer claim a retry occurred when a usage-limit error was returned without retrying.

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Breaking Changes
  • Removed the raw @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog/models.json export; use the bundled model registry APIs instead.
Added
  • Added nextBuildPriceChange(cost, now) to identify when a model's dated pricing card may change, allowing callers to safely reuse earlier builds until that time.
  • Added the selector-revision-suffix catalog axis for Google Vertex, so google-vertex/claude-opus-4-8 resolves exactly to claude-opus-4-8@default.
Changed
  • Reduced the bundled model catalog size and loading overhead.
  • Updated role defaults so Factory Droid image models are preferred for the image role, allowing generate_image to work with only a Factory login.
  • Updated smol and slow role defaults to use the currently bundled Cerebras and OpenAI Codex model identifiers.
Fixed
  • Fixed Mistral reasoning models so streamed thinking appears in the transcript and is preserved for subsequent turns.
  • Fixed later-turn HTTP 422 errors in Mistral-hosted DeepSeek conversations when assistant reasoning history is included.
  • Fixed DeepSeek V4.1 Flash image attachments being dropped for publisher-namespaced model IDs such as ds/deepseek-flash.

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Breaking Changes
  • Custom tool loaders now resolve the injected host SDK themselves; constructors take cwd as their first argument instead of a pi namespace.
  • WebMCP now uses Chrome's native WebMCP support through WebMcpController, which accepts a Puppeteer Page. The former page-hook installation helpers, bridge constant, and page-hook types have been removed; Tern tabs no longer support WebMCP.
  • Provider-qualified model selectors in --model, settings, roles, and task agents must identify an exact model ID or alias. Near matches now fail with a helpful error and suggestions instead of silently selecting a sibling model. Bare selectors such as opus retain fuzzy matching, and the Google Vertex Claude alias remains supported. Older migrated web fallback chains replace the retired Codex entry with openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.
Added
  • Agents can send an interim response without ending the current task by writing Markdown to out:// (or using > out:// in bash), with streaming output up to 64 KiB. This is enabled by default in the interactive TUI and can be configured with out.enabled; it is disabled by default in print, RPC, and ACP sessions.
  • Added computer-tool approval modes: tools.approval["computer.control"] can allow unattended foreground control on dedicated machines or deny the request without prompting. The approval mode does not itself grant access.
  • Added optional task-file input (task.file=true), allowing subagent instructions to be loaded from an absolute UTF-8 file path or local:// URL with the submitted path and SHA-256 recorded (#17133 by @iliaal).
  • Sessions can be pinned or unpinned from the resume picker with Alt+K and Alt+Shift+K, or the remappable app.session.pin and app.session.unpin actions. Pinned sessions move to the top and take priority in search results (#9837 by @zhang17-24).
  • Added PI_LINK_SCHEME and optional PI_LINK_HOST, allowing file links from SSH or tmux sessions to open through a desktop protocol handler (#15855 by @KunoLu).
  • Extensions and RPC clients can start live voice sessions using their own WebRTC peer, including phone-browser clients, through ctx.startLive({ sdpOffer }) or live_connect (#17013 by @materemias).
  • Extensions can customize assistant-text rendering and rerender individual replies through the opt-in extensionRenderers.assistantText setting (#16238 by @materemias), and can register interactive link schemes with extension callbacks and renderer fallbacks (#16239 by @materemias).

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Changed Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4 Fixed Fixed chat-completions context estimates counting past thinking that the request drops (no reasoning replay), which triggered compaction far below the threshold (#15797, #17231 by…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Changed
  • Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4
Fixed
  • Fixed chat-completions context estimates counting past thinking that the request drops (no reasoning replay), which triggered compaction far below the threshold (#15797, #17231 by @ghisguth)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Changed
  • Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

@oh-my-pi/browser-relay

Changed
  • Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 to the Factory Droid provider for accounts with Factory's 1017 flag; turning thinking off on its Baseten route disables reasoning instead of falling back to low effort (#17234 by @skipper019)
Changed
  • Made Kimi Code model discovery authoritative and cached per credential, added K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed to the bundled Kimi Code catalog, and preserved live thinking metadata there (#17224 by @trukhinyuri)
  • Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4
Fixed
  • Codex model refresh now lists models available to an entitled account even when other saved accounts return HTTP 402 (#17198).
  • LiteLLM discovery now reads every /v2/model/info page before selecting the proxy's model roster, rather than caching only the first 50 entries; malformed or incomplete pagination falls back without caching a partial page (#17237 by @maykonmichel).
  • Fixed hosted web search on OpenAI Responses and Codex Responses selecting GPT-5.6 Luna instead of GPT-6 Luna (#17202 by @mateo-bolanos).

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Manual compactions (RPC compact, /compact, extension ctx.compact()) emit manual_compaction_start and manual_compaction_end session events, so RPC hosts can show compaction progress; docs/rpc.md documents these with the other progress events (retry_fallback_applied, ttsr_triggered, goal_updated) (#17247 by @Quelaan1)
  • Added retry.rateLimitWalksChain (default false): with it on, a 429 rate limit after a turn with signed Claude thinking moves to the next model in retry.fallbackChains at once instead of retrying the throttled model until retry.maxRetries is spent (#17232 by @sjawhar)
  • Sessions can be renamed from the resume picker: the new title persists as a user title without loading the session, and renames of live sessions are refused instead of forking the transcript (#17262 by @Twilight0)
  • Added display.advisorCollapsedLines (Settings → Appearance → Display) to cap how many note lines a collapsed advisor card shows; the default keeps the full preview (#17228 by @bluecapone)
  • omp config list --scope global|project lists only the keys that layer sets, with the values as written: path-scoped enabledModels, enabledProviders and disabledProviders entries ({ path, … }) stay unresolved, so a host can edit the global value without dropping them (#17246 by @Quelaan1)
  • tools.xdevNotices: false hides the xd://: mounted … notices shown as MCP servers connect, without turning on startup.quiet (#17263 by @MaisonnatM)
Changed
  • Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4
Fixed
  • A running job's glance keeps the whole a meter counts instead of the bare numerator: a widget whose headline restated 140 beside a 140/190 bar now draws 140/190 in the job card, the HUD pill and the status line (#17226 by @iacore)
  • Fixed the managed-skills root guard rejecting a symlinked store outright; a root that resolves to a directory now accepts writes inside its target, while a broken link or a link to a non-directory is still refused (#17201 by @iacore)
  • Fixed experimental context rollover repeatedly running during tool calls when the fixed prompt and tool schemas already exceed the recovery band (#17205)
  • Fixed Ctrl+D during deferred extension startup falsely reporting an extension exit error and exiting 1 instead of closing cleanly (#17259).
  • Resuming a session, or reviving a parked or restored subagent, after a prewalk or plan-yolo handoff continues on the model and effort the handoff switched to instead of falling back to the planning model (#17229 by @shgew)
  • Fixed one interrupt silently stopping a session from ever waking on its own background job results again: an interrupt (Esc, the RPC abort command, an ACP cancel, a collab guest stop, an extension's ctx.abort()) that stops no run and no queued work no longer suppresses those wakes, and after an interrupt that did stop a run they come back once a later turn has run and ended. Esc on the "waiting on background jobs" row still ends that wait: its results land in context for your next prompt, as before (#17243 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed ! commands on zsh/fish waiting forever at interactive prompts (e.g. the Oh My Zsh update question on !code .); keystrokes now go to the running command while it runs, and Esc still cancels (#17210)
  • Fixed auto-compaction firing early on OpenAI-compatible chat-completions models that don't replay past reasoning (#15797, #17231 by @ghisguth)
  • Eval's tool.<name>(…) now accepts xd://<name> and the Claude Code mcp__<server>__<tool> spelling like direct tool calls, and reports registered but unavailable tools instead of "Unknown tool" (#17250)
  • Updated the ask prompt to encourage assistants to show missing decision context before the dialog opens (#17242 by @jasonharrison)
  • Custom LiteLLM providers now refresh cached model rosters after paginated /v2/model/info discovery was fixed; cached first-page-only lists no longer hide later-page models (#17237 by @maykonmichel).
  • Fixed hosted search repeating the same request when the active model is also its search target but uses a cloned or refitted model object (#17202 by @mateo-bolanos).

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.13.2
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Added AgentTool gained the optional handlesToolInterrupt flag: an interruptible tool that sets it (such as wait) still runs, without blocking, when a loop-owned interrupt is already queued, so it can drain the queued wake event instead…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added
  • AgentTool gained the optional handlesToolInterrupt flag: an interruptible tool that sets it (such as wait) still runs, without blocking, when a loop-owned interrupt is already queued, so it can drain the queued wake event instead of being skipped; user cancellation still skips it (#17174 by @alphastorm)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed
  • Fixed OAuth logins shared by several processes being disabled with invalid_grant when they refreshed at the same time or one of them quit mid-refresh (#17128 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed transient Google 429 rate-limit and capacity responses retrying in place without blocking or rotating credentials, while daily caps and zero-entitlement limits still rotate (#17127 by @GTanger)
  • Fixed Aliyun DashScope's multimodal gateway failing a turn on its intermittent InvalidParameter 400s for valid inline images ("provided URL does not appear to be valid", "Download multimodal file timed out"); they are now retried (#17101 by @shuairongzeng)
  • Fixed a revoked or rejected GitHub Copilot credential continuing to show its last cached usage quota instead of being dropped (#17081)
  • Fixed Devin requests compressing the request body on the UI thread, which briefly froze the TUI on long conversations; requests under 1 KiB are now sent uncompressed

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added LM Studio decision models to discovery: models LM Studio reports as type: "decision" are listed as judge models served over its /v1/decisions endpoint, alongside its chat models (#17169 by @richiestanaway)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Extensions in the interactive TUI can read and directly switch plan, vibe, goal, and loop modes with ctx.sessionModes and observe changes with the mode_changed event, without submitting slash commands; extensionHandlers.modeControl: false turns off extension-driven mode changes (#15753 by @Shadorain)
  • RPC hosts can capture draft-only speech-to-text with live previews when speech input is enabled, without submitting an agent turn; slow flushes have adjustable deadlines, and failed transcription does not block a session change after capture closes (#17158 by @felipe-santos-aya).
  • Added discovery.advertisedReasoning to let a custom provider opt out of the reasoning ladder its /v1/models rows advertise (default true); discovery: proxy now reads that ladder, its none off-switch, and an explicit reasoning: false instead of building every model's thinking surface from the bundled catalog reference alone (#15255, #17077 by @Youwenqwq)
  • WATCHDOG.yml advisor entries now accept scope (main, subagent, or all, default all) to attach an advisor only to the top-level session or only to advised subagents, and includeReasoning: false to omit primary assistant _thinking:_ blocks from advisor review deltas (#17058 by @trukhinyuri)
  • Added session.worktreeScope to keep the resume picker scoped to one directory (#17061 by @Dante-dan).
  • LM Studio decision models can now serve the judge role (modelRoles.judge: lm-studio/<model>); they answer over LM Studio's /v1/decisions endpoint instead of being offered as chat models (#17169 by @richiestanaway)
  • Extensions' getAllTools() now reports mcpServerName, mcpToolName and mcpReadOnlyHint for MCP-backed tools, so an extension can tell read-only connector tools from ones that change things (#17120 by @cfpperche)
  • RPC: navigate_tree (move the leaf in the same session file, optionally summarizing the abandoned branch), abort_branch_summary and set_label, with matching RpcClient methods (#17138 by @andrebrait)
  • RPC: delta message_update frames (messageUpdates: "delta") now carry the block on start/end events and the message on a restart, so a client can rebuild the streaming message from deltas alone (#17137 by @andrebrait)
  • ctx.ui.input now accepts { secret: true } to mask typed characters as bullets in the TUI, forward an optional secret host hint on RPC extension_ui_request frames, and refuse plaintext form elicitation in ACP mode (#17080 by @GTanger)
  • Added opt-in gc.autoCompress (default off): interactive launches start a detached, low-priority omp gc --compress --apply at most once a day, so idle sessions are stored compressed without running the command; volumes where compression does not shrink a probe file (e.g. macOS 27) are skipped, and the latest run's output or skip reason is in gc-auto-compress.log in the agent dir (#17189 by @wolfiesch)
  • Added withFatLto to the Nix package: omp.override { withFatLto = false; } links pi-natives with thin LTO for faster builds (#13752 by @n3oney)
Changed
  • Bundled scout subagents now include ast_grep in their default tool list, matching the agent prompt's AST-search directive; scout stays read-only, so lsp (which can rename and apply code actions) is not added (#17151 by @sinhduc01)
  • Clearing a draft now brings back the idle recap and idle compaction it held off, a subagent view you return to gets the recap it still owed, and prompts, turn-starting messages and IRC wakes that arrive during idle compaction wait for it to finish; SDK owners can opt a session in with AgentSession.enableIdleMaintenance({ isBlocked, scheduledTurn, onRecap }) and refreshIdleMaintenance() (#17136 by @andrebrait)
  • TTSR interrupts include a bounded excerpt of the text that matched the rule, quoted as untrusted data with harness tags escaped; excerpts are retained once per stream, preserved alongside AST matches, and omitted for zero-width matches (#17099 by @shgew)
  • Sessions that load several provider-registering extensions into a shared model registry (subagents, /tan, SDK hosts) start faster: the model catalog is rebuilt once instead of once per extension (#17088

items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added
  • Hosts can distinguish safely paused agents from turns still draining with Agent.isPaused (#17073 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed
  • Codex accounts whose spend cap is used up are no longer picked through credit overage or from usage cached before the upgrade (#16973 by @DusKing1)
  • Fixed Codex capacity 429s (turn_rate_limit_exceeded, "Codex is at capacity") reporting "Try again in ~N min" from the plan's usage-window reset, which made retries wait hours instead of the response's Retry-After (#17087 by @H4vC)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added GPT-6.1 Terra: openai/gpt-6.1-terra ships bundled ($1/$5, $0.05 cached, >272K long-context tier, 1.05M window), and Codex-discovered gpt-6.1-terra/-wm get API-equivalent pricing, the 922K extended-context maximum, and routing to Plus-or-higher accounts.
  • Added Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed support on Kimi Code (k3.1-pro, k3.1-pro-highspeed) and the Moonshot API (kimi-k3.1-pro, kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed): official pricing ($2/$10 and $4/$20 per MTok), a 131K output cap, and K3's reasoning and wire contract (#16901 by @eggpeat)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Added tools.restrictedFolders: every action on a listed folder (the folder and everything below it) asks for an explicit Approve/Deny in every approval mode, yolo included, and no remembered grant, session approval, or ACP "Always allow" covers it; recursive searches rooted above a restricted folder ask too, commands are matched by the directory they run in, and a deny policy still denies (#16049 by @Peribunt)
  • /pause shows draining turns and running jobs across the main agent's subagent tree, without waiting on finished turns, safely parked agents, or suspended advisor reviews (#17073 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).
Changed
  • Reduced redraws during background subagent progress while keeping elapsed previews and native checklists current (#17131 by @iliaal, based on #16647 by @Komzpa).
  • Restoring a session with many subagents refreshes the running-subagent badge and lists once per burst instead of once per agent (#16642 by @Komzpa)
  • ask answers now name the option a note is on (m: [X, Y] (note on Y: …), User added note on Y: …) (#17126 by @H4vC)
Fixed
  • Fixed advisors dropping their review and showing a rate-limit error when the provider returns a timed 429 such as Codex's turn_rate_limit_exceeded; the advisor now waits out the Retry-After (within retry.maxDelayMs) and retries like the main agent (#17087 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed a hashline PUT being refused with "would hold one more copy of line N … than the range did" when its body restates the line next to the range, fills the range, and adds a new line equal to that neighbour (a second @property or #[test], or a break; above a new case); it applies again, dropping only the restated line (#17028)
  • Fixed task subagents receiving AGENTS.md files, including the user-level ~/.omp/agent/AGENTS.md, when the session has additional workspace roots (--add-dir, /add-dir, workspace.additionalDirectories)
  • Fixed an ask note added right after picking an answer landing on the next question's answer, in Tern and the TUI; Note now goes to the answer just picked until the next question gets other input (#17126 by @H4vC)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Added
  • ANSI and TSP /pause screens show unsettled turns and jobs, hide settled counters, and preserve counts and resume controls on short terminals (#17073 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).
  • Added noteOption to ExtensionAskDialogResultItem and QuestionResult: the label of the option an ask note is on (unset for a note on the custom answer) (#17126 by @H4vC)
Changed
  • StatusLineComponent.setRunningSubagents() and setSubagentTreeCost() now report whether their state changed, allowing callers to skip redundant redraws (#17131 by @iliaal).
Fixed
  • Fixed the ask dialog's Note (button or n) right after a pick moved to the next question annotating that question's highlighted row instead of the answer just picked (#17126 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed the ask dialog's Next button reopening the custom-answer editor after Other was cancelled instead of moving on to the next question or Review tab

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Added
  • Added an optional maxFractionDigits to formatNumber() that caps decimals on values below 1,000 (#16973 by @DusKing1)

What's Changed

  • fix(ai): report Codex spend-cap credits for credit-billed workspace seats by @DusKing1 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16973
  • fix(advisor): wait out timed Codex capacity 429s instead of dropping reviews by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17087
  • feat: show live pause settlement status in TUI and Tern by @anatoli-tsinovoy in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17073
  • fix(ask): keep a note on the answer just picked and name the noted option by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17126
  • perf(tui): coalesce running-subagent badge refreshes on registry bursts by @Komzpa in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16642
  • perf(tui): skip redundant subagent redraws without stale previews by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17131
  • feat(catalog): add Kimi K3.1 Pro pricing and K3 contract on Kimi Code and Moonshot by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16901

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.13.0
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Added Added SummaryOptions.remotePromptCacheKey and remoteCompactionPolicyModel() so remote compaction can carry a cache key gated against the request it actually sends (#16988 by @rafalopilowski1) Changed Remote compaction now sends…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added
  • Added SummaryOptions.remotePromptCacheKey and remoteCompactionPolicyModel() so remote compaction can carry a cache key gated against the request it actually sends (#16988 by @rafalopilowski1)
Changed
  • Remote compaction now sends cache and session headers for the endpoint and model the request actually uses, so a configured compaction override no longer inherits the live turn's routing (#16988 by @rafalopilowski1)
  • Aside providers (AgentLoopConfig.getAsideMessages, Agent.setAsideMessageProvider) now receive which boundary is polled, "work" after tool calls or "stop" at the end of a turn, so they can keep a message out of a finished turn (#16583 by @will-bogusz)
Fixed
  • Fixed --max-time values above about 596 hours (such as 600h) aborting the first turn with "Deadline exceeded" right away (#17054 by @trukhinyuri)
  • Fixed repeated compaction on small or provider-capped context windows: compaction keeps only as much recent history as fits under the configured trigger, and no longer counts stale pre-compaction usage (#16904 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed native compaction token estimates counting opaque encrypted-state bytes as conversation text (#16904 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed split-turn compaction leaving session.compacting context out of the turn-prefix summary (#16707 by @integrITsolutions)
  • Fixed compaction failing as a whole, and discarding the completed summary, when the optional short summary fails or returns no answer; the compaction now completes without a short summary, and cancellation still cancels it (#16942 by @Mouriya-Emma)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Breaking Changes
  • OpenAIRequestSetupModel now requires the catalog-policy fields (api, reasoning), so callers building a reduced model for resolveOpenAIRequestSetup must pass them (#16988 by @rafalopilowski1)
Added
  • Added PI_ANTHROPIC_API_VERSION=2026-10-21 to send Anthropic API version 2026-10-21 to the official Anthropic API; sampling parameters are omitted under that version, which rejects them (#16706 by @H4vC)
  • OpenCode Go requests on lanes that opt into shared prompt caching send an explicit prompt-cache key as x-opencode-session, so Task siblings, forks and their parent reuse one gateway cache; custom providers declaring providerType: "opencode-go" get the same OpenCode headers (#16988 by @rafalopilowski1)
Changed
  • Reduced the CPU spent preparing tool schemas on every model call, so requests with many tools start faster (#16780 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Fixed tool schema normalization modifying the caller's schema in place, which added the folded const value to a tool's own enum array (#16780 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Google Antigravity requests now carry the same request labels as the official 2.26.0 client (cascade_id, root_cascade_id, request_id, used_non_gemini_model), and image model lookup sends the account's project (#17012 by @apoc)
  • Google Antigravity requests now send each model tier's own model_enum label, output cap and thinking setting from the serving account's model list, as the official client does: Claude 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon tiers send a thinking level, Gemini 3.8 Flash tiers the tier's thinking budget (#17012 by @apoc)
  • Google Antigravity requests now number conversation steps like the official client (the first request is step 1, and each model turn and tool result adds one), send Accept-Encoding: gzip without an explicit Accept, and no longer send the Claude thinking beta header to Claude 5.5 (#17012 by @apoc)
Fixed
  • Anthropic-compatible endpoints that require a thinking block on every turn of the current turn no longer replay a 400 when the history holds a turn an upstream answered without reasoning; the serializer pads those turns (#16739 by @lz37)
  • Fixed an Anthropic stream that a gateway or proxy cuts after message_start, substituting an in-band error frame, being reported as a completed-turn provider failure instead of a retryable stream truncation (#16990 by @Maziar123)
  • Fixed Kimi Code, Z.AI, and ClinePass usage polls logging a warning every poll for accounts without a metered plan (#17057 by @trukhinyuri)
  • Fixed Codex usage showing no limits for credit-billed ChatGPT Business/Enterprise seats: /wham/usage returns rate_limit: null for them, and their per-user credit cap (spend_control.individual_limit) is now reported as a Spend cap (credits) limit that also gates chat requests when no plan windows exist (#16973 by @DusKing1)
  • Fixed overlapping OpenAI Codex requests in the same session (e.g. concurrent auth-gateway requests) closing the WebSocket another request was still streaming on; the later request now goes over SSE (#16812 by @Abelo9996)
  • Fixed Codex WebSocket turns dying with unsupported_native_inflight_message when the native turn lane was still busy; the turn is now retried as an independent full-context request instead of surfacing the error (#17065 by @AgileInnov8tor)
  • Fixed OpenRouter native failures appearing as successful empty stops and malformed Responses being replayed before corrective recovery; metadata permission/rate-limit failures no longer trigger malformed-response recovery (#17063 by @martijnberger)
  • Fixed Xiaomi MiMo API-key login failing with Unsupported model mimo-v2.5 after the V2.5 retirement (#16727 by @LiPu-jpg)
  • Fixed Xiaomi MiMo login rejecting ttp- Token Plan keys with 401 Invalid API Key; they now validate against the regional Token Plan hosts like tp- keys (#17045)
  • Fixed Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan login reporting 401 Invalid API Key

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.12.6
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog Added Added the prompt-cache-persistent catalog axis (isPromptCachePersistent) for providers whose own endpoint never expires prompt caches; logged-in OpenAI Codex declares it Changed Updated the bundled Yolo-Auto catalog to its current…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added the prompt-cache-persistent catalog axis (isPromptCachePersistent) for providers whose own endpoint never expires prompt caches; logged-in OpenAI Codex declares it
Changed
  • Updated the bundled Yolo-Auto catalog to its current models, qwen3.8-27b (now the default), yolo, yolo-small, and yolo-128k, and removed the retired deepseek-flash-v4 and qwen3.8-flash

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Added the _session/steering ACP extension (advertised as _meta.steering.supported), so clients such as agent-shell can steer a running turn; a steer sent while a permission dialog is open cancels that dialog, and _meta.steering.queue: "followUp" queues a follow-up instead (#15885 by @marcintustin)
  • /mcp reauth <name> now works over ACP, RPC, and print mode (omp -p '/mcp reauth <name>'): it opens the browser, prints the authorization URL, reconnects the server in the running session, and print mode exits 1 when reauthorization fails (#16046 by @marcintustin)
Changed
  • ACP session/cancel now also cancels prompts that are queued or still dispatching, and stops autonomous runs, instead of being ignored when no client turn is streaming (#15885 by @marcintustin)
  • Idle compaction no longer runs on logged-in OpenAI Codex accounts, whose prompt cache never expires; compacting while idle only threw away a warm cache
  • ACP sessions no longer fail to start when a client-declared MCP server cannot connect; the failure is reported in the session, and an HTTP/SSE server can be repaired with /mcp reauth (#16046 by @marcintustin)
  • /mcp reauth, /mcp test, and /mcp unauth now pick the project entry when a server is defined in both project and user config, and skip project config when mcp.enableProjectConfig is off (#16046 by @marcintustin)
  • /mcp reauth removes the server's stale Authorization header from its config when it writes the new OAuth binding (#16046 by @marcintustin)
  • omp -p '/compact', /handoff, and /retry given as CLI arguments now run the command instead of sending the text to the model, and exit 1 when the command fails; slash text arriving on stdin or from @file is still sent to the model (#16387 by @marcintustin)
  • Interactive startup no longer waits for extensions that register only tools, commands, flags, renderers, or event hooks (for example MCP bridge plugins): they load once the composer accepts input, and your first message waits for them instead. An extension is deferred only after one launch has confirmed it registers no providers, shortcuts, composer shapes, or file fallbacks. Launches that resume a session, pass --tools, or pass flags omp does not recognize still load every extension first (#16684 by @H4vC)
Fixed
  • Fixed subagents whose role has an explicitly empty fallback chain falling back through the default chain when the default role uses the same model, including after a retry fallback, prewalk or context promotion briefly switched models or the subagent was revived (#16548 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed /usage and omp usage --json listing identity-less OAuth accounts such as Devin as missing usage beside their working reports (#16549 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed releasing or reaping a browser tab returning while Chromium still listed the page; the close now waits until Chromium reports the tab destroyed (#16680 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed the advisor prompt forbidding all repeated advice, including real escalations: advisors may now re-raise a prior nit or concern as a blocker once new evidence makes it one (#13887, #16484 by @pjh890321)
  • Fixed Esc no longer interrupting in the TUI after a second MCP OAuth login replaced an unfinished first one (#16046 by @marcintustin)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Changed
  • In Tern, centered sheets (/context, reports, keyboard shortcuts, BTW history, session info, the pause screen) fill the pane when it is narrower than 100 columns instead of floating with margins (#16676 by @H4vC)
Fixed
  • Fixed the /agents and /models hubs in Tern squeezing the left sidebar as long lines (such as a streaming new-agent draft) widen the body pane

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Added
  • Added RpcConnection.requestCancellable() and Client.requestPermission(params, { signal }); client connections abort a handler and answer -32800 when the peer sends $/cancel_request, while agent connections keep running the request and return its real result (#15885 by @marcintustin)

What's Changed

  • fix(coding-agent): clarify blocker escalation in advisor prompt by @pjh890321 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16484
  • feat(coding-agent): support ACP _session/steering for mid-turn client steering by @marcintustin in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15885
  • feat(acp): support /mcp reauth outside the TUI by @marcintustin in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16046
  • feat(tui): fill narrow Tern panes with centered sheets and pickers by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16676
  • fix(coding-agent): confirm browser tab close and repair red CI tests by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16680
  • perf(coding-agent): load startup-safe extensions after the composer accepts input by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16684
  • fix(coding-agent): keep explicitly empty subagent fallback chains empty by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16548
  • fix(coding-agent): stop listing identity-less OAuth accounts as missing usage by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16549

New Contributors

  • @pjh890321 made their first contribution in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16484
  • @marcintustin made their first contribution in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15885

Full Changelog: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.12.5...v18.12.6

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-ai Added Added OpenAI 12-hour prompt caching for GPT-5.6+ on the Responses API: cacheRetention: "long" now requests prompt_cache_options.ttl: "12h" (instead of the ignored legacy prompt_cache_retention: "24h"), and promptCache.ttl accepts "12h"…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added OpenAI 12-hour prompt caching for GPT-5.6+ on the Responses API: cacheRetention: "long" now requests prompt_cache_options.ttl: "12h" (instead of the ignored legacy prompt_cache_retention: "24h"), and promptCache.ttl accepts "12h"
Fixed
  • Fixed every OpenAI Codex request failing with HTTP 404 {"detail":"Not Found"} on personal ChatGPT accounts whose token is not region-pinned (#16493)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Fixed
  • Fixed Moonshot kimi-k3 pricing cache writes at $0; usage cost now includes cache writes at Moonshot's $3/M 5-minute rate (#16508)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • providers.cacheRetention: long now keeps OpenAI GPT-5.6+ prompt caches for 12 hours (Responses API; cache writes cost 2.5× input instead of 1.25×)
Fixed
  • Fixed subagents spawning at a caller-supplied effort (e.g. hi → max) while task.enableEffort is off; the field is now ignored and the agent's configured thinking level (including :auto) applies (#16402)
  • Fixed omp update --check failing against JFrog Artifactory registries that add empty dist-tags to a tagged manifest; the update check now uses the registry's curated latest version (#16375)
  • Fixed <path>:conflicts on a file past the 10 MiB scan cap reporting no conflicts with no hint: it now names the line the scan stopped at and the ranged read that registers the blocks after it (#16269)
  • Fixed the ts-set-map rule stalling tool-call streaming for seconds on a long single-line Map literal, and missing Map entries written ["key", value] as const (#16242)
  • Fixed the ts-import-type rule missing inline type imports whose member name is non-ASCII, such as import("./units").温度 (#16242)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Fixed
  • Fixed a macOS background action leaving its target in front of your app after you clicked another of your windows, when placing the click took longer than the click itself (#16217)

What's Changed

  • fix(update): handled empty Artifactory dist-tags on tagged manifests by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16379
  • fix(task): ignored caller effort while task.enableEffort is off by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16406
  • fix(catalog): stopped declaring no_constraint codex residency by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16501
  • fix(catalog): priced moonshot kimi-k3 cache writes at the 5min rate by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16529

Full Changelog: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.12.4...v18.12.5

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.12.4
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Fixed Enabled native compaction for supported Bedrock Claude models (#16343 by @anatoli-tsinovoy) @oh-my-pi/pi-ai Added Added opt-in reclaimAbovePct to auth.accountPolicies: sessions automatically moved to a lower-priority account…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Fixed
  • Enabled native compaction for supported Bedrock Claude models (#16343 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added opt-in reclaimAbovePct to auth.accountPolicies: sessions automatically moved to a lower-priority account return to the preferred one once it has that much quota left (#14237 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added reachesBudgetedHost(): whether the catalog's host request budgets (inline image bytes, official image count) apply to a request, true on a model's official endpoint and on Factory Droid's own hosts (#16288 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added Inception API-key login (/login inception) and INCEPTION_API_KEY environment authentication (#16439 by @eggpeat)
  • Added image support for native OpenAI Decisions and Workers AI judgments, prompted vision chat, and auth-gateway System One requests; images exceeding a judgment API's documented caps (e.g. Clef's 4 images, 4 MiB each) are rejected locally (#15471 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).
  • isSurvivingAssistant in providers/transform-messages: whether an assistant turn reaches a replay, malformed tool calls dropped first, so callers outside transformMessages pick the same latest turn (#15791 by @will-bogusz)
  • Broker account-pool files (OMP_AUTH_BROKER_ACCOUNT_POOL_FILE) can hide whole providers and API keys: "*": false makes the file an allow-list, and an entry can be true, false, or { "accounts": [...], "apiKeys": false } (#14235 by @will-bogusz)
Changed
  • cursorRawReadPath() writes a bare start line as raw:N- (file:10 → file:raw:10-), so Cursor exec reads of such a path still read from line N onward now that read takes N:raw as one line (#16438 by @will-bogusz)
Fixed
  • Fixed Anthropic and Bedrock logging one warning per dropped thinking block (hundreds for one request) after a conversation change; the drop now logs one warning with the count (#16392 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Factory Droid Core models (Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek and others) dropping calls to tools with names over 64 characters and their results from later requests; such names now shorten to 64 characters, and shorter names are sent unchanged (#16384 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Devin /usage showing no data for accounts signed in with /login devin, and Devin chat sending a failing extra auth request for legacy Windsurf Enterprise keys (#13677 by @will-bogusz)
  • Turns stopped for a thinking loop now keep the tokens and cost the provider had reported, the response id, the request's start time, and its time to first token and duration, instead of recording zero usage and no timing (#16437 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Claude requests answering a turn whose attachment is a video, PDF, HEIC or other format sent outside a JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP image as if nothing were attached; the turn now fails with an error naming the format (#16407 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed the repeated-tool-call guard missing a loop the model interleaves with a wait that elapses with nothing new; a wait that returns finished work still ends the repetition (#11874 by @dickyudhandika)
  • Fixed Google Antigravity chat and image requests failing with false 429 quota-exhausted errors (#11849 by @jotafurtado)
  • Fixed the stream loop guard never stopping a model stuck repeating punctuation or symbols (?!?!, ✓✓✓) until the output limit; such runs now trip once they repeat for 1 KB, while digit and whitespace runs such as padding and hexdumps are left alone (#14436 by @F0Rextasy)
  • Fixed native remote compaction for supported Bedrock Claude models without changing ordinary Converse turns; a custom non-AWS baseUrl needs remoteCompaction.enabled: true (#16343 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)
  • Fixed Anthropic compaction blocks dropping their signed tool_changes, which made the replayed block fail its signature (#16343 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added native Inception support with Mercury 3, Mercury 2.5, and Mercury 2, live chat-model discovery, API-key login, reasoning controls, and Mercury 3 launch pricing while its catalog reports none; Mercury 3 waits up to 10 minutes for its first output, since high-effort reasoning streams nothing (#16439 by @eggpeat)
Changed
  • Changed Devin model discovery to send legacy Windsurf Enterprise keys unprefixed in one request, dropping the Windsurf-editor retry that returned a smaller model list (#13677 by @will-bogusz)
Fixed
  • Factory Droid now carries Droid's 3.5 MB inline-image budget (inline-image-byte-budget) for its hosted routes, under their 4.5 MB request limit, and the new request-body-byte-limit axis (resolveRequestBodyByteLimit) records that limit; it applies on Factory's own hosts through pi-ai's reachesBudgetedHost (#16288 by @will-bogusz)
  • DeepSeek V4.1 Flash images are now priced by DeepSeek's own billing (994 tokens for a snapcompact frame) instead of a GPT or Claude rate (2,882 to 3,136), so a 25-frame archive no longer counts about 50k tokens the provider never bills and triggers compaction early (#16418 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Amazon Bedrock Kimi K3 (global./us.moonshotai.kimi-k3) offering Anthropic-style thinking budgets it ignores; it now offers low, high and max effort, defaulting to max (#13697 by @alblez)
  • Marked supported Bedrock Claude models as eligible for native compaction (#16343 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • bash tool commands now see PI_SESSION_ID and PI_SESSION_FILE, so a script can find the running session's ID and transcript path (#16442 by @johnrichardrinehart

…

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Added AgentTool gained the optional approvalCacheTargets hook, which the always-ask-cached approval mode uses to check and record per-file grants (#16049 by @Peribunt) Changed Tools with lenientArgValidation now receive unknown root…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added
  • AgentTool gained the optional approvalCacheTargets hook, which the always-ask-cached approval mode uses to check and record per-file grants (#16049 by @Peribunt)
Changed
  • Tools with lenientArgValidation now receive unknown root arguments that their closed schema would otherwise drop, so they can reject them (#16317)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added validateToolArguments(tool, call, { keepUnknownRootKeys: true }) to keep unknown root keys that a closed schema would otherwise drop during argument repair (#16317)
Fixed
  • Fixed Claude streams that a gateway cut off before message_delta failing the turn instead of being retried (#16341 by @lz-lunzi)
  • Fixed Gemini pairing parallel same-name tool results with the wrong call when history stores them out of call order (sessions from before 18.4.2, SDK-built contexts) (#16259 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Factory Droid Gemini dropping calls to tools with names over 64 characters (most MCP tools) and their results from later requests, so the model called the tool again; such names now shorten to 64 characters (#16283 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Factory Droid Gemini requests failing with 400 "For schema with items, schema type should be ARRAY" when a tool parameter accepts a string or a list, as the default task tool's model field does (#16249 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed PI_REQ_DEBUG=1 request dumps writing your API key, bearer token and response cookies to disk in plain text: credential headers now read [redacted], as in rejected-request dumps (#16293 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed finalized signed reasoning disappearing from displayed thinking when no deltas streamed (#16227)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Changed
  • MiniMax MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (the launch id) now gets the always-on low–max thinking the bundled MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview rows have, and omits sampling params (temperature, top_p, top_k) it rejects (#16315 by @SaladDay)
Fixed
  • Gemma 4 models on Google AI Studio (google/gemma-4-31b-it, google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it, …) no longer fail every request with Thinking budget is not supported for this model; thinking is now toggled with thinkingLevel (on = high, off = minimal) (#16350)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Added the Ask and remember approval mode (tools.approvalMode: always-ask-cached, --approval-mode always-ask-cached): it also asks before file reads, and file prompts can remember the folder or the file, for this session or across sessions, through approval-cache.db (#16049 by @Peribunt)
  • Added /forget-approvals to forget every file and folder approval Ask and remember has recorded (#16049 by @Peribunt)
  • Extension ui.approve() hosts can render the new prompt.grants choices and answer { grant, always }; hosts that ignore them keep answering once/session/deny (#16049 by @Peribunt)
  • Extension and custom tools can declare approvalCacheTargets to take part in Ask and remember grants (#16049 by @Peribunt)
  • Added proc://<id>/streams for bash jobs: it lists the command's pipes, and proc://<id>/streams/<n> shows what has crossed pipe n so far, so cmd | tail -5 can be followed live without rerunning cmd
  • Background job widgets are designed per job by the new widget model role (resolves like smol until you assign it): one request writes rules that read the job's output and its pipes (cmd | tail included), and every later update is computed locally with no further model calls or messages to the agent; a subagent gets a widget only once it says which output shows its progress, and a job with nothing worth charting gets none; turn them off with async.widgets: false
  • Running subagents now show their current step, in their own words, on the task card; the periodic completion check also asks the subagent which output shows its progress, so the job widget knows what to chart
  • The wait card shows the watched jobs as a row of tiles, each with its status, name (a subagent's in full), what it is doing, and its headline figure and live widget when it has one (a throughput chart with its target line, per-model bars, CI job status, trial progress), and a subagent's own completion estimate as a ring that turns from blue to green as it fills (hover the tile for the percentage); the HUD jobs pill shows the freshest job's headline and a mini chart, and hovering it opens a card with the running jobs as tiles; the jobs sheet shows the selected job's widget above its output, and the terminal status line appends the headline to the jobs count
Changed
  • While a subagent is focused, /model, /switch, /effort, Alt+P, Ctrl+P, and Shift+Tab change that subagent's model and thinking level (session-only) instead of telling you to return to the main session; /model and Alt+M open the session-only picker there, since role assignments configure the main session
Fixed
  • Fixed omp skill list omitting skills from a skills.customDirectories entry that starts with ~; such an entry now resolves against your home directory, matching the skill loader (#16347 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Fixed grep treating a ;-separated list of internal URLs (e.g. artifact://44;artifact://43) as one URI and refusing to search it; every listed resource is now searched (#14091)
  • Fixed grep refusing a web URL that carries a :raw (or :conflicts) selector before the page was fetched; the selector now reaches the fetch, so :raw searches the verbatim response body (#14092)
  • Fixed browser role/<role>[name="…" exact] selectors in Chromium and Tern tabs matching nothing for many names copied from observe(); a button or link with visible text is no longer matched by its title (#16252 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed /tan clones with Mnemopi auto-recall re-sending the parent's recalled memories as an extra system-prompt block, which duplicated them and missed the parent's prompt cache (#16337)
  • Fixed legacy pi extensions that import contentText from pi-ai or formatSkillsForPrompt

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Changed The failed-tool-call correction sent to DeepSeek models now also covers chat-template tool-call tokens written out as text, not only malformed DSML (#16216 by @H4vC) Fixed Fixed Ollama chat history estimates counting stripped…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Changed
  • The failed-tool-call correction sent to DeepSeek models now also covers chat-template tool-call tokens written out as text, not only malformed DSML (#16216 by @H4vC)
Fixed
  • Fixed Ollama chat history estimates counting stripped native thinking and missing foreign thinking replayed as text, which skewed compaction after model switches (#16164)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added nativeJudgmentImageBounds(): the image bounds a native judge enforces, its wire's transport limits tightened by the catalog's model bounds
  • Added Box judgment questions (BoxQuestion/BoxAnswer, TypeSafe Jev 1.14+ direct or through OpenRouter): each names the request image it searches by image index, and comes back as that image's edges as 0–1 fractions; text, OpenAI Decisions, and Workers AI judges reject them
Fixed
  • Fixed Muse Code usage going stale whenever its 5-hour window sits idle: the idle window now reports as unused, and weekly usage carries over from the last active window until its reset (#16193 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed DeepSeek tool calls never running when the model writes them as chat-template tokens with _ in place of ▁, a missing ｜, or no per-call close (e.g. <｜tool_calls_begin｜>…<｜tool_calls_end｜>): they now run as tool calls, and any that still cannot be parsed are removed from history and reported to the model as a failed call (#16216 by @H4vC)

@oh-my-pi/browser-relay

Fixed
  • Fixed a relay tab close failing when Chrome refuses it for a moment (a tab being dragged); the extension retries it (#16119 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed tabs created for a relay request whose connection dropped mid-create staying open, and answers to such requests going to a later connection (#16119)
  • Fixed the relay resolving an old tab id to a different tab after a browser restart; the extension now reports each browser run (#16119)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Changed
  • Seeded TypeSafe jev-1.14.0 and OpenRouter typesafe/jev-1.14, and made them the judge role defaults and TypeSafe's default model; TypeSafe discovery keeps seeded ids its alias-only /v1/models listing omits

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Added computer.backgroundFallback (takeover by default, or refuse): when a computer window input call has no background route, the tool reruns that one call in takeover, hands focus back to your app and says so in its result; refuse fails the call instead and also refuses the agent's own foreground requests (takeover: true, raise(), an activating apps.open, desktop input, and on macOS menus and AXOpen) (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added DeepSeek as a web search engine (web/deepseek), using DeepSeek's new Search API with your existing DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or stored deepseek credential
  • Added el.selectText(text, { prefix?, suffix?, select? }) to the macOS computer tool: it selects text (or places a caret) in a background app's text field without taking focus, moving the pointer or sending keys, so typing into that field replaces it (#15175 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added { takeover: true } to computer-use win.move, so a hover that a window refuses in the background can be retried in the foreground (#15173 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added a menu option to the computer tool's win.click, el.click, el.press and el.perform, so on macOS the call that opens a menu also chooses its item, e.g. menu: ["Add to", "Fonts"] (#15185 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added el.type(text) and el.press(chord) to the computer tool, which send text and keys to that element instead of wherever its window's focus is; on macOS and Windows nothing is sent when the element cannot be addressed without taking your focus (#15563 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added: pressing Escape during takeover input now stops computer use for the rest of the turn, and that session's later computer calls are refused, unsent, until your next message (#15564 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added the computer tool's UserIntervened error on macOS: input into an app you have used since the agent last read its window fails without sending, and the agent is told to read the window again and keep your edits (#15562 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added tui.completeScrollback: rows a growing HUD or dialog pushes off screen go straight to scrollback instead of missing from it until it shrinks (#15692 by @Ilm-Alan)
Changed
  • The computer tool and its errors no longer tell the model to retry with takeover: true, and its instructions tell it never to call raise() or apps.open(…, { activate: true }) to make input work (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Computer-use window input with takeover omitted now stays in the background after computer.control.acquire, so an acquired grant no longer activates the target app or moves the user's pointer; pass takeover: true for foreground input (#15173 by @will-bogusz)
  • Pressing Escape in your own app no longer stops the computer tool's background window input unless task control is held; Escape in omp still interrupts it, and physical Escape still stops takeover input (#15176 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added Box questions to ChainJudge: they go only to Jev judges that answer them, and the box edges measure the image you passed even when it was padded to fit Jev's size bounds
  • A relay browser.open without app.target now opens its own background tab instead of adopting the visible one (after reinstalling the relay extension; older ones select it), and browser.close closes it; app.target still borrows an existing tab (#16119 by @nnnnoel and @will-bogusz)
  • Computer-use win.menu.items now needs exec approval and is rejected in read_only runs, since on macOS it makes the window key in its own application before reading its menus (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • The computer
